tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nyams len zab mo'i rim pa rnams/ /gsal 'debs ting 'dzin gong 'phel bzhugs// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ bslu med bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ /byang chub bar du snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /tshe sgrub la sogs nyams su blang bir bsrung / lam zab/ dkar cha bzhi/ dbyug gu ma'i chang bu 'bul ba/ bar bgyi/ /mdun du bla ma rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba bzhugs par bsam la/ /mchod cing 'dud do tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ rlung sbyor a ma ra ṇi ci nus/ /mdun bskyed rang thim rang yang de 'drar gzungs ring bzla/ gyur/ dge ba bsngo/ /yang ni nam mkhar rnal 'byor dbang phyug gsal/ ye shes pa thim par bsam/ /gsol ba 'debs so bar chad kun sel mdzod/ ang gu li bzla/ /mdun bskyed rang thim gang ga gyen bzlog gi phyag rgya bcas la rlung ro 'bud/ rang yang de 'drar dge ba bsngo/ gyur/ rlung sbyor dang bsrung ba bya/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma kye rdo rje/ /gdan gsum tshang ba mngon sum gsal bar gyur/ /phyi zas nor longs spyod dgra gnyen bar ma la sogs pa/ nang rang lus/ gsang rig ma/ ba de bzhin nyid kyis mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba'o/ mchod/ /dbang bzhi mtha' skor bla ma yi dam sogs thim zhing rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las/ stsal bas sku bzhi'i 'bras bu smin/ /bla ma thim pas rang sems dbyer med gyur/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs bya/ lta ba bskyang ngo / /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs gtor ma 'di/ gtor mgron rnams byon par bsam/ so so'i gtor sngags kyis phul/ mi g.yo sgrol ting bshags brdung / ma klu gnyan yi dwags dang / /gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul lo dgyes shing tshim/ par bsam mo/ /chu yis sbyin pas yi dwags klu rnams dang bar dor yang /

rnams tshims/ tshims par bsam mo/ /kun kyang rang rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ dge ba bsngo/ /oṃ aḥhūm̐ gis chang bu 'dod dgur gyur/ gtor sngags so sos phul/ /lha mo mched ting shags brdungs shing / gsum gsal bar bsgom la bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /mchod sprin 'di bzhes la/ /khams gsum dbang sdus zas nor char ltar phob/ dge ba bsngo/ /dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir lam bzang bsgom/ /rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes ltung ma lus sbyangs/ yig brgya bzlas la rdor sems thim par bsam mo/ /rang nyid lhar gsal 'od kyis tshogs zhing byon/ /mchod cing sdom pa ma lus bzung bar bgyid/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i srung 'khor ye shes pa thim zhing rgyas btab par bsam/ gyis/ /rang dang bsrung bya'i bar gcod thams cad uṣ+ṇi kha dang bha ya sogs bzla/ dmon mo yid tsam gyis byas kyang chog bcom/ /rang nyid zhu bas rnam snang rang bzhin gyi/ /gzhal 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor sogs zhu ba las/ yas khang pa dur khrod rnam snang gi yan lag bskor ba'i nang / nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags brjod/ /mngon byang lnga las rang nyid rgyu'i rdor 'dzin/ /'khor gyi lha spros rang nyid thig nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags brjod/ ler zhu/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag /zhu ba glus lha mo bzhi'i/ bskul 'bras bu rdor 'dzin du gsal bar/ bzhengs/ /snod gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis/ bcud thams cad lha dang gzhal yas gyur/ /skye mched byin brlabs snying kha'i 'od kyis/ ye shes spyan drangs thim/ / par bsam/ rang lus srung 'khor gzhal yas khang gi nang / /pho brang lnga dang skye mched tshigs kyi lha/ /gsal bar gyur cing rang gi bla ma dang / /dbyer med dbang lha nam mkhar byon par gyur/ /mchod cing bstod do bdag la dbang bzhi stsol/ maṇ+ḍal phul bar bsam/

/bum pa'i nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ dbang gi rig pa'i dbang lnga rdo rje brtul zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rnams stsal bar bsam/ phung khams skye mched sogs/ /rigs lnga yab yum byang sems lha mo dang / /khro bor gyur cing snang stong bskyed/ rtsa nyid sprul skur gyur/ bum dbang gi brda rnams yid kyis sbyongs/ /gsum pa'i nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ dbang stsal bar bsam/ gi khams nyid dga' bzhi'i lhan skyes bskyed/ chos skur gyur/ dbang gsum pa'i brda rnams yid kyis sbyongs/ /bzhi dbang ngo sprad par bsam la/ pa'i rlung nyid ngo bo zung 'jug bskyed/ nyid skur gyur/ dbang bzhi ba'i brda rnams yid kyis sbyongs/ /gtso 'khor dbang lha rnams thim par bsam mo/ thams cad rigs kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags brjod/ bdag pos mi bskyod pa'i yan lag brgyan/ /bdud 'od dpag med kyi yan lag rtsis tshims shing snying kha nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ mchod cing don yod grub pa'i yan lag bstod par rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag gyur/ rlung dang gtum mo gang rigs sgom/ /nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags rnams brjod/ /dag pa rnams dran/ pa'i sgo nas/ rang bzhin yin snyam du bsgom la/ bzlas pas dngos grub sngags ring thung ci nus bzla/ bsdus/ par bsam/ /dkyil 'khor rim thim rang nyid kye rdor skye mched sku gsung thugs lhar/ gsal/ /kun kyang kye rdo rje'i/ dag pa'i 'khor lo'i rol par gyur/ / dge ba bsngo/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir lam bzang bsgom/ /rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes ltung ma lus sbyangs/ yig brgya bzlas nas rdor sems thim par bsam/ /dag pa lus lha ngag sngags sems ye shes te/ gsum ldan rang nyid he ru ka'i/

/snying kha'i 'od kyis bla ma bde mchog gi dbu la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bzhugs shing / /sku la drug cu rtsa gnyis lha tshang pa/ /spyan drangs phyag 'tshal snying kha sogs nas spros pa'i/ phyi dang yid 'byung mchod/ /tshogs zhing gi rigs bdag rang gi spyi bor bzhugs shing bcom ldan 'das/ rang la thim pas rang lus kyi/ /srung 'khor gzhal yas khang rnams gsal ba'i nang / /snying kha'i hūm̐ dang lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐ dang / /spyi bo sogs kyi khams dang rtsa rnams ni/ /pu dzā u a go ra de ma dang / /ka o tri ko ka la ka hi dang / /pre gri so su na si ma ku dang / /snying kha'i phyi bskor hūm̐ ring brgyad rnams ni/ /bde mchog lha tshogs rnams su gsal bar gyur/ /dag lha rnams byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par/ pa'i rang bzhin du dran par byas la/ pho nya rnam sngags skyes/ zhing skyes/ lhan skyes/ gsum 'brel/ / oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sogs brjod/ go cha'i phyi nang gi lha kun la/ lha rnams/ gsal bar gyur cing / ye shes snying ka'i 'od kyis/ mngon sum du byon nas/ thim/ /dbang dbang lha byon par bsam/ bskur bas gtso bo yab yum la rdo rje sems dpa'/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi la rin 'byung / thugs gsung sku'i 'khor lo rnams la mi bskyod pa/ 'od dpag med rnam par snang mdzad/ dam tshig 'khor lo la don yod grub pas/ dbu brgyan par bsam/ mchod pa drug gis/ sngags dang phyi nang gsang ba yi mchod bstod pa ste/ mchod/ /snang stong sku yi rang bzhin la sngags kyi spro bsdu'i ngang nas/ bzlas pas dngos grub bsdus/ gtso bo'i snying po nye snying dang lam̐ mam̐ sogs bzla/ /snang skabs 'dir go cha rnams tsham rngam sngags kyi bsrung ba byas la/ srid thams cad bde mchog 'khor lo'i sku/ /sgra rnams thams cad yi ge bdun ma'i sgra/

/rtog 'gyu thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog thugs/ /nam yang dga' ba gsum gyi rol bar 'gyur/ /dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir lam bzang bsgom/ /rdor sems yig brgya bzlas la/ bdud rtsis nyes ltung ma lus sbyangs/ /bla ma nam mkhar gsal ba la lus 'dud byas la/ rang la thim/ /rang nyid 'od phung ngang nas skad cig gis/ /mkha' spyod dbang mo rgyan dang go char bcas/ /bla ma rang rdor sems rang la thim par bsam shing rang rnal 'byor bsal ba'i snying kha'i bam̐ yig mchod par bsam pas bdud rtsi myang la/ sems dbyer med bde stong ngang / /bstan g.yo kun kyang de 'dra gsal bar gyur/ /ye shes rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyis spyan drangs/ pa thim zhing dag pa dran par bya/ bzlas pas byin oṃ gsum ma bzlas shing yid bzlas bya'o/ /gyis brlabs/ /khams gsum rang la 'od dkar dmar mthing gsum rnam pas zhi/ nyid lhar gsal bam̐ la thim/ /de yang 'od gsal thim par bsams la lta ba bskyang ngo / /nas slar yang ni/ /rang nyid mkha' spyod dbang mo'i skabs 'dir 'pho ba sbyong la slar yang rang mkha' spyod mar gyur par bsam zhing spyi bo'i bla ma rang la bstim ste tshams rngam sngags kyi srung ba rnams dang / de'i sngon du go cha chen po rnams bya'o/ /skur gsal zhing / /snang mthong rig gsum de yi rol par gyur/ dge ba bsngo/ /yang ni rang nyid 'byung 'dul gsal ba yi/ /tshogs zhing spyan drangs snying kha nas 'od zer spros/ mchod cing bshags pa bgyid/ /srung 'khor dbus su rang nyid khro bor ye shes pa thim zhing rgyas btab par bsam/ gsal/ /sngags kyi sngags ring thung bzla/ 'od kyis bar chad thams cad bsregs/ /dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir srung 'khor bsgom/ /rang nyid nag po chen por gsal ba yis/ /tshogs zhing spyan drangs mchod cing bshags par bgyi/ /thun rdo rje ra gur 'khor lo sogs/

/mong thun mong min pa'i srung 'khor nang / /rang nyid gur mgon khro bcur gsal bar gyur/ che zhing cher 'bar ba mthong ba tsam gyis dgra bgegs brlag par nus par bsam/ /ye shes snying kha'i 'od kyis/ spyan drang / dngos sum du thim dbang bskur thams cad la mi bskyod pa'i/ rgya yis btab/ skabs 'dir bsrung bya sba ba sogs bya'o/ /rang dang bsrung bya sogs gsal bar bsgom la/ bsrung bya bsrung zhing bar chad bsrung bzlog bsad gsum gyi dmigs pa rnams gang gsal gsal du bsgom mo/ /bzlog bha ya na sogs bya'o/ /snang srid kun kyang gur snod bcud srung 'khor la thim zhing lha rnams rang la thim par bsam pa dang mgon por gsal ba'i ngang nas/ mgon rol par gyur/ dge ba bsngo/ /dkon mchog la skyabs bla ma rin 'byung bsgom/ /rang gi mdun du skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i/ /bla ma rin 'byung gi mtha' skor du bla ma yi dam sogs dang khyad par nor lha mang po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ mngon sum gsal bar gyur/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul gyis/ mchod bstod gling bzhi ri rab sogs/ phyi sems kyi gnas lugs/ nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal dngos su 'bul na nas 'bras sogs dang dngul sogs kyi maṇ+ḍal chu gtsang sogs sta gon gong du byas la maṇ+ḍal gyi grangs brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs pa 'bul zhing / rang gang 'dod pa'i dngos po maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhag cing phul bar bsam pas dngos po de lag tu yong ba sogs byin rlabs gzhan las che nges pa'i rtags 'byung ba myong bas grub lags pas rjes 'jug rnams the tshom spongs la nyams len mdzod dang man ngag zab mo 'dis mchog gi dngos grub kyang myur du 'grub na dbus gtsang khams gsum dbang du 'du ba la tshegs ci yod/ 'bul/ /snang srid dbang bsdus skabs 'dir bla ma'i gsol 'debs ci nus rang la 'bad de bya'o/

/'phrin las rab rgyas mdzod/ 'gro kun dbang du bsdus nas bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin nus pa zhig bla ma mkhyen snyam pa bya'o/ /bla ma rang thim rang yang de 'drar gyur/ skabs 'dir gsal btab cing lta ba yun ring du bskyang bar bya'o/ /nyams myong skye bar srid/ /gzugs dang sgra dang sems kyi rtog 'gyu kun/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol pa'o/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir srung 'khor bsgom/ /stong shu n+ya ta sogs/ pa'i ngang las kham̐ nag po zhu ba las/ lcags kyi khang khrom nang / /gnod byed kun gnas snying kha'i 'od kyis/ de dag lhar bcas thim/ /snying kha'i 'od kyis mdangs phrog mog por gyur/ /de rnams steng du 'byung bzhi rlung me chu sa rnams rim par brtsegs pa'i steng / ri rab steng / /rlung chu me dang phyag mtshan gur gang nang / /sde brgyad zhing skyong yum chen gur khang rnams/ /dmar skya dmar po 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i nang / /'khor lo rtsibs drug sra zhing brtan par gyur/ tsakra rak+ṣa sogs brjod/ /'khor lo'i dbus su rang nyid gur mgon du/ /gsal ba'i thugs kar rin chen gzhal yas nang / /dbus na bla ma mi bskyod phyogs bzhi ru/ /hrīḥlas byung ba'i tshe dpag med pa re/ /bla ma'i thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor nang / /hriḥlas tshe dpag med mgon de'i thugs kar/ /nyi zla kha sbyar nang du rang sems hrīḥ/ /g.yas steng dang / g.yon mdun rgyab rnams su bsrung bya gsal/ /de yi mtha' skor sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ dpal mgon stobs 'phrog nag po'i gzungs ring gzungs thung sogs/ /'khor lo rtsibs drug rnams su zhal bzhi re/ pa sgrub dus kyi zhal khra can shin tu rngam pa/ /rtsibs bzhir yum bzhi zhing skyong gur khang du/ /lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa drags pa pho bdun mo bdun sogs dang bcas pa/

pho mo dang / /sde brgyad gur du lha klu gza' phyogs skyong / /rgyal chen 'jigs byed rgyu skar gnod sbyin rnams/ /kun kyang bdag dang bsrung byar bcas pa la/ /dgyes shing 'dzum pa gus pa'i tshul du gyur/ /snying kha'i 'od kyis ye shes mngon sum thim/ /dbang bskur rigs bdag so sos dbu brgyan gyur/ tshe dpag med rnams la 'od dpag med gur/ mgon dang bla ma mi bskyod pa la mi bskyod pa/ zhal bzhi pa rnams la rdo rje rtse lnga pa re dang / gzhan rnams la rtse gsum pa re res dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /dbus kyi tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i/ 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs kyi tshe dpag med/ rnams bskul de rnams thugs ka nas/ /tshe yi lha mo dmar mo bum pa sogs/ /thogs pa dpag med spros nas gnod bcud kyi/ /tshe dang dpal 'byor bsdus nas rang nyid kyi/ /spyi bor blugs pas rang dang bsrung bya yi/ /lus rnams 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsis rlung bum pa can 'dzin zhing yi dam gur mgon dpal mgon gyi sngags ring thung sogs bzla/ gang / bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas gur nang lha rnams kyis/ /bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la brtse bas gzigs/ /bsrung ba'i sngags bzlas bsgo ba nyan pa dang / /'khor lo g.yas 'khor 'od kyis gnod byed bsrung ba'i sngags bzla/ bcom/ /dpal mgon 'khor bcas bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung zhing skyobs par mdzod/ /yang ni hūm̐ zhes brjod la tshe 'dir bsam don thams cad 'grub la phyi ma nged dpon slob bde ba can du skyol cig snyam du bsam nas byas na/ 'di la yid ches khyad par can zhig yod pa legs/ pas lha tshogs rnams/ /rngam zhing 'khrugs pa'i tshul gyis zhal phyir gzigs/ /'khor lo g.yon 'khor yum chen sogs/ pho nyas byad ma bkug /rtsibs kyis gtub cing mes bsregs rlung gis stor/

/ro rnams lho phyogs hwam̐ khung blugs par gyur/ /gnod byed rnams kyi dmag drangs te bdag cag rnams la/ gnod par/ sems la/ /rang gi srung mas mtshon cha'i char phab pas/ /phar log gnod byed kho rang la bzlogs te/ /lha rnams bdud du bab ste rlog par byed/ /yang ni rang gi srung mas dmag drangs te/ /gdug pa can rnams bzung zhing brdegs pa dang / /mes bsregs rlung gtor rnam shes chos dbyings bsgral/ bzlog pa'i sngags bzla/ /bdag la bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /lo zla ma 'gyang gtan brlag thong par mdzod/ thal mo gdab/ /rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyis snod bcud dang / /srung 'khor lhar bcas snying kha'i hrīḥl thim/ /de yang 'od gsal la thim de'i ngang nas/ spros bral gyi lta ba la 'jog ci thub rang bzhag go /rang nyid gur gyi mgon por gsal bar gyur/ /dge 'dis zhing skyong dbang pos rjes 'dzin shog /bla rang gi sems dang bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs dang gshin po rnams kyi sems kyi gnas lugs rnams gdod ma nas ro gcig pa la nges shes bskyed la/ ma'i thugs rjes gshin po ltos bcas rnams/ /da lta bde ba can du skye bar shog gshin po rnams la bzod med kyi snying rje dung dung pa dang bdag la ni nus pa med bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen bsam pa yang yang bya'o/ /srung 'khor dbus su rang nyid seng gdong ma/ /sngags kyi 'od kyis bar chad byad kha rbod gtong sogs/ thams cad bsregs/ sngags bzla zlog pa bya/ /dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir chos spyod bgyi/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod dang gtor rdzas rnams/ /byin rlabs 'dod dgus nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ /rang nyid thugs rje chen por gsal ba la ye shes pa thim zhing dbang bskur rgyas btab par bsam nas snying rje chen/ po 'i ngang nas sngags kyi spro bsdus/ sa dngos grub bsdus/ par bsam/

ma ṇi bzla/snying kha'i 'od kyis/ /'khor 'das mgron rnams sprin phung 'thib pa dang kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar/ nam mkhar byon par gyur/ /mchod cing yi dwags klu dang bar do rnams/ /chu sbyin gyis tshims nor lha ser nag gnyis/ /mngon sum gsal ba gtor ma chu sbyin gyis/ /mchod cing bstod do dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /'khor ting shags brdung / 'das ma lus dgyes pa'i mchod sprin rgya chen po sa dang bar snang thams cad khyab ste 'khor 'das kyi mgron thams cad la gang la gang dgos zad mi shes pa phul bar bsam/ 'di/ sam bha ra nyer gcig nas brgya'i bar brjod la ar+gham̐ sogs dang de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod par bya'o/ /gzhi bdag bla sogs mkha' sogs dge sbyong dang / /lha sogs gzhi sogs 'brog gnas bgegs sogs dang / /rigs drug yi dwags gnod byed ma thob dang / /srung ma drug cu slar yang gzhi bdag sogs/ bar do dang bcas pa'i/ /kun la ci la ci dgos gang la gang dgos kyi tshul du/ 'bul gyi dgyes shing tshim par gyur/ nas rang gis bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po thob/ /slar yang chu yi sbyin pas mgron rnams tshim/ ye dhar dang sdig pa ci yang sogs brjod/ /'khor 'das mgron rnams bdag dang sems can rnams la 'bral mi phod pa tsam gyi byams brtse'i ngang nas dgos 'dod thams cad 'khor 'das kun gyis stsol bar bzhed bzhin par/ dgyes shing so sor gshegs/ par bsam/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya/ /de nas nyams len gtso bo'i thun mtshams kyis/ /rnal 'byor rol par kun kyang gsal bar gyur/ /rang gi de nas rnam rgyal 'joms/ 'dzam nag u tsa'i sngags ring thung / rme brtsegs khyung nag dbang sdud dang drag sngags rnams bzla/ phur chung gtor bsngo bskang gso gtor sgrub sogs kyi don bsdus ni ma bris la/ snga dro mi byed la dgong mo byed pa'i nyams len 'ga' zhig gi don bsdus bris na 'di yin te/

dgong mo'i thugs dam skabs gong du bshad pa'i skyabs 'gro tshe sgrub kyi mgo na yod pa de dang / sems bskyed la/ lam zab ma sogs nyams su blang bar bgyid/ ces sbyar bar bya'o/ /snying kha'i 'od kyis bla ma dang / /dbyer med he ru ka dpal nam mkhar byon/ /phyi zas nor longs spyod dgra gnyen bar ma sogs/ /nang rang lus dum bur gtub pa bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa/ /gsang ba de rig ma mtshan ldan/ bzhin nyid spros bral gyi ngang la gnas pa/ kyi mchod/ /yang ni mchod bstod smin dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang khyod ni rnal 'byor sogs kyi/ mtshams thim pa las/ /rang lus srung 'khor gzhal yas pho brang lnga/ /skye mched tshigs kyi lha rnams gsal bar gyur/ /rang gi spyi bor rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams/ /rnam pa kye rdor 'og ma'i spyi bo ru/ /gong ma bzhugs par bsam la/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs bsdus/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rim pa bzhin du 'og ma 'og ma la gong ma gong ma thim par bsam mo/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar thim/ /gsol ba 'debs rtsa ba'i bla ma de la blo lhing gtad de/ so rang gi spyi bor thim/ /dbyer med rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma'i sku gsung thugs/ 'dres shing dbang bzhi thob pa las/ /lus dkyil lha rnams shin tu gsal ba sogs dbang bzhi'i lam thams cad tshang tshul la nges shes bskyed la/ bar gyur/ rlung bum pa can 'dzin zhing shes pa dwangs cha dang bcas 'jog /gnad 'dis dbang bzhi'i lam rnams mthar phyin shog /yang ni dur khrod dbus su gdan gyi steng / /rang nyid rnal 'byor dbang phyug tu gsal ba'i mdun du tri shu la ṭa ma ru 'chang ba dang bcas pa/ g.yas su bum thod bdud rtsis gang ba/ g.yon du rig ma gdugs 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu dpag bsam gyi shing rnams shin tu gsal bar bsgom par bya'o/

/rtsa gsum dang / /pho brang lnga yi lha yi sa bon bcas/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar kye rdor lha dgu bzhugs/ /gtum mo'i me dang byang sems/ 'bar 'dzag sbyor rlung gi bas 'khor lo pho brang lnga'i/ rnams gsal zhing / /rlung sems thams cad dbu mar thim par gyur/ nyi ma gtong 'dzin gyi phyag rgya bcas la rlung ro 'bud/ rlung bum pa can bzung bsrung ba rnams bya/ /dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir lam bzang bsgom/ /rdor yig brgya brjod cing rdor sems thim par bsam/ sems bdud rtsis nyes ltung thams cad sbyangs/ /tshogs zhing rang 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ spyan drangs snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyi/ mchod cing sdom pa bzung / /srung 'khor rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra gur/ nang du drag po'i khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du/ gzhal yas khang / /dur khrod bskor ba'i dbus su rang dhi yig nyi ma'i mdog can las/ 'jam dpal/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kun 'jam dpal gyi thugs kar ā yig bsam pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku dpag tu med pa dang / gsung gi rang bzhin 'jigs byed kyi sngags dang / a l̥ ka l̥ sogs dpag tu med pa dang / thugs kyi ngo bo phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas rang 'jam dpal du gsal ba la thim pas/ 'od phung hūm̐ yig rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams su gyur/ de las kyang 'od 'phros pas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad 'jigs byed du gyur par bsam mo/ /bsdus nas/ /snod bcud lhar gsal thim zhing zhu ba las/ /rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed dbu dgu pa/ /sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag can zhabs bcu drug /phyag mtshan rgyan dang gdan sogs gsal bar gyur/ /snying ga'i 'od kyis/ dbang lha spyan drangs rgyas gdab dbang lha rang la/

thim/ /sems dpa' gsum brtsegs rang 'jigs byed kyi thugs kar 'jam dpal dang de'i thugs kar rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i mthar sngags so sos bskor ba bsam/ nang dang phyi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ yis mchod/ /bstod par bsam/ cing bzlas pas sngags kyi 'od zer gyis/ byin rlabs 'phrin rgyud la zhugs shing / las bzhi/ sgrub/ par bsam mo/ /sngags rnams bzla'o/ /snod bcud gdan gyi bar du rang la thim/ /rang nyid 'jigs byed snang srid de'i rol pa'o/ dge ba bsngo/ /dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir lam bzang bsgom/ /rang nyid nag po chen por gsal ba yis/ / snying kha'i 'od kyis/ /tshogs zhing spyan drangs mchod cing gshegs par bgyi/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong chos 'byung rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ 'khor lo'i/ nang / /rang nyid gur mgor khro bcur gsal ba yi/ /dbus kyi lte bar rang nyid kye rdo rje/ / de'i skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab par bsam zhing / ye shes pa spyan drangs/ thim pa la brten nas/ snying kha lte ba mgrin pa spyi bo rnams kyi rtsa 'khor rnams dang gsang gnas su chos 'byung / rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga/ /gsal ba'i snying kha'i hūm̐ nyid yum chen gyi/ /lto bar mgon po lha mo gnyis gsal bar bsgom pa'i thugs ka nas sa bon lnga spros te lcam dral gnyis kyi mdun du las mkhan lngar gyur pa bsgom la de rnams shin tu gsal ba rang ma byung bar du gsal yang yang 'debs pa gal che ba yin/ las mkhan lnga/ /yum chen steng du bla ma kye rdo rje/ /kun gyi thugs kar sa bon sngags kyis bskor/ /ye shes skye mched sku gsung thugs byin brlab cing thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ pa thim yang dbang lha spyan drangs nas dbang bskur/

rgyas gdab pa las phyi nang gi he ru ka gnyis la mi bskyod pa dang gzhan rnams la rdo rje rtse lnga re res/ dam la bzhag pa gtor bsngo'i skabs ltar byas par bsam/ nang rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyi phyi nang gi dgra bgegs tshar bcad de sha khrag gi phung po bdud rtsir bsam pa'i gtor 'bul lo mchod cing / bstod par bsam la/ dgyes par gyur/ /bzlas kye rdo rje yab yum gyi sngags sha sa na nas bod rbad bsad gsum gyi bar sbrel ba tshar gsum brjod rjes yi dam gyi sngags thung dang / lcam dral lha gsum gyi sngags dang / las mgon rnams kyi bod rbad gtso bor bzla/ pas 'phrin las bla ma kye rdo rje'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pa sngags gang bzla ba'i chos skyong de la phog pas de skrag ste 'dar phri li li byas nas bgo ba'i las sgrub par bsam mo/ /sgrub cing dgra bgegs tshar gcod par/ gsol ba 'debs/ /'od kyis bla ma kye rdo rje'i thugs kar/ bskul bas mgon po 'khor bcas/ de dag dag gi sprul pas/ pho nyas dgra bgegs de thams cad/ bsgral/ /'od sngon 'dus nas rang 'khor bcas la/ rnam par thim pas gzi brjid 'bar/ /slar yang bla ma kye rdo rje'i thugs ka'i/ 'od kyis 'khor 'das snod bcud dang / /srung 'khor nang gi lha rnams rim thim ste/ /kun kyang yum chen lte ba'i mgon por thim/ /mgon po de yang thig le sngon por zhu/ rlung bum pa can 'dzin/ /de yang cha gnyis su gyur pa/ hūm̐ yig re rer gyur/ pa de gnyis/ /kye rdo rje snying kha lha mo/ gsang gnas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i/ kye rdor lha mo yi/ /bla ma kye rdo rje'i/ thugs ka dang lha mo'i/ gsang gnas su sngar gyi hūm̐ yig gnyis po re re/ 'khod pa 'od dmar mos/ /sbrel ma bsams la/

'di la gur gyi mgon po'i/ lha tshogs kun bdag byang chub bar du/ gnas mdzod/ cig ces chos skyong khyad par can rnams la blo lhing bkal bar bya'o/ /snang srid rang ye shes par gsal ba'i/ brtan g.yo thams cad kyang / gur mgon rol par gyur/ par bsams la de'i ngang la yug cig bzhag par bya'o/ /nam mkhar pad+ma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ shar du yi dam lha tshogs/ lhor sangs rgyas/ nub tu chos/ byang du dge 'dun/ mtha' skor chos skyong srung ma/ skyabs yul mngon sum bzhugs pa la/ /yan lag brgyad sogs sgo nas skyabs su mchi/ /skyabs yul rang thim tshad med rnam bzhi la/ /'gro kun 'god gyur kun gyi sdug bsngal rnams/ /bdag la smin cing bdag dges gzhan bde shog /spyi bor bla ma seng khri pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid 'od me re bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis skyabs yul thams cad spyan drangs nas thim par bsams la/ bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /rang la thim pas dbyings rig ro gcig tu/ 'dres pa'i dgag sgrub thams cad dang bral ba'i bzo med gdod ma'i rang babs gshis lugs ye 'jam chen mo/ /ma bcos lhug pa'i rang mdangs de'i ngang la yengs med tsam gyi rtog med/ chos skur bzhag 'dir yun mi thung tsam 'jog pa yin no/ /rang gi spyi bor ma cig ye shes kyi/ mkha' 'gro ma/ sku mdog dkar mo/ phyag g.yas/ /ḍā ma kha ṭ+wam̐ bsnams par gsol ba 'debs/ /sdig pa kun thams cad phyir dud khu'i rnam pas thon nas/ byang bar bsam/ phaṭ phaṭ rang sems dang / /nam mkha' dbyer med dbyings rig ro gcig ngang / /rang gi phung po'i steng du ma gcig byon/ rang gi sems rkang pa gnyis kyi rgyu ma gnyis po'i 'og tu 'od me long tsam zhig hrig hrig yod par bsam nas phaṭ dang po brjod dus 'od de gnyis sum mdor 'dres te bya ngang mo'i sgo nga tsam dmar mer mer yod pa yar song thod pa'i 'og tu hrig hrig yod pa la phaṭ gnyis pa brjod pas 'od de tshangs pa'i bu ka nas thon te nam mkha' dang 'dres nas nam mkhas khyab tshad sems kyis khyab par bsam la spros med kyi ngang du lhod klod la bzhag go

/phyag g.yon pa'i/ bdud rtsi blugs nas/ pas 'khor 'das ma lus pa/ /dgyes shing tshim pa'i 'dod dgu'i rgya mtshor gyur/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong nor lha sogs/ /mchod yul thams cad kyi spyan sngar mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bar skad cig gis gyur nas/ mchod do dgyes par gyur/ /gnas 'di'i gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor bcas dang / /'gro ba rigs drug lan chags bu lon dang / /sha 'khon gnyer ba'i mi dang mi ma yin pa'i/ tshogs rnams kun la sbyin/ so so'i mdun du 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gter chen por gyur te 'bru 'dod pa la 'bru/ rin po che 'dod pa la rin po che/ zas 'dod pa la zas/ gos 'dod pa la gos la sogs pa gang 'dod pa de dang der gyur pa rnams ltos pa med par/ /thams cad tshim nas sgrib bral sangs rgyas gyur/ /kun kyang smra bsam brjod bral rol pa'o/ de'i ngang la ci gnas su bzhag go /bsod nams 'di yis bdag gis ci bgyis pa/ /kun kyang sems can don du 'gyur bar shog /nyal dang khams gsum snod bcud rang phyi'i he ru ka la thim/ de snying ka'i lha bcu gsum la/ de lha lnga la/ de gtso bo yab yum la/ yum yab la/ de snying kha'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ yang thig le la/ de yang bye phye phra mi dmigs pa'i ngang la/ nam mkha' nas ḍā ma ru'i sgra yi ge bdun ma'i sngags su dran pas/ gzhan yang zas dang btung ba'i rnal 'byor la ni 'bru gsum gyi rnal 'byor byin gyis brlabs pa kha thab khung / lag pa gzar bu/ kha zas sogs bsreg rdzas su bsam la lte ba'i gtum mo'i mes lus dkyil gyi lha rnams gsal bar gyur pa la mchod pa'i bsam pas thog mar lag pa g.yon pas longs spyad de rjes su lhag ma gtong ngo / /ldang dang thun mtshams bya ba kun/ /nyams len gtso bo'i rnal 'byor zab mo dang / /'bral med bya phyir yang yang gsal 'debs bgyid/ /snang srid bla ma lhag pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor/

/sgra rnams bla ma yi dam gsung rang bzhin/ /rtog 'gyu thams cad bla ma yi dam thugs/ /kun kyang snang stong gsal stong bde stong ngang / /yin lugs gzhi med rtsa bral ye 'byams che/ /'gag med snang ba thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor/ /snang thog nyid du stong pa bde ba che/ /'dzin med ngang du srol ba zung 'jug lam/ /gnad 'di shes pa mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin/ /da dung bdag dang slob mar bcas pa yis/ /'di phyi'i don rnams ma lus mthar phyin par/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan bla mas mdzad du gsol/ /thams cad bkra shis bde legs kyis khyab par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dpal nag po chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub thabs kha'u brag rdzong gi rgyun gyi nyams len snyan rgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i snying po bzhugs so/ /dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir srung 'khor bsgom/ /rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes ltung ma lus sbyangs/ /rang gi spyi bor rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams/ /rnam pa gur mgon 'og ma'i spyi bo ru/ /gong ma bzhugs par gsol 'debs rim bzhin thim/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol 'debs rang la thim/ /rang nyid nag po chen por gsal ba yis/ /tshogs zhing spyan drangs mchod cing bshags par bgyi/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i srung 'khor nang / /rang nyid gur mgon khro bcur gsal bar gyur/ /ye shes pa thim dbang bskur rgya yis btab/ /skabs 'dir srung ba'i dmigs pa dang sngags bzla ba sogs bya ba'i rjes sam/ yang rbod bsad sogs dang 'brel na dmod pa 'dor zhing thal mo gdab pa sogs kyi rjes su/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas khro bo rnams zhal nang du gzigs/ 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor zhing brdar bar bsam la/ rang nyid dbus kyi mgon por gsal ba yi/ /snying kha'i 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs te/ /rang la thim pas rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga/ /gsal zhing lte gsang chos 'byung smug nag nang / /yum chen de las 'od zer sngon po gsum/

/chad de rtsa gsum nang so chos 'khor dbus/ /dbu ma nyid dang dbyer 'dres pa las/ /rtsa 'khor dbus su bla ma he ru ka kye rdo rje dpa' gcig gi rnam pa can/ /de yi 'og thad g.yas kyi ro ma dang / /dbyer med gur mgon g.yon gyi rkyang ma dang / /dbyer med lha mo bla ma'i thugs ka nas/ /'od sngon 'phros pa snying kha chos 'khor dbus/ /hūm̐ yig gyur pa ber nag zangs gri can/ mgon po lha brgyad dang ber nag zangs gri can te lha dgu'i rjes gnang ma thob pas 'dis khrid zhu ba dang bsgom du mi rung bar snang ngo / /lcam dral gnyis las yam̐ mam̐ ro rkyang thim/ /dbyer med 'dres pas gnod sbyin yab yum gyur/ /yab las tri yig gnyis chad ro mar thim/ /dbyer med 'dres pas pu tra bha ṭar gyur/ /yum las bh+yoḥchad rkyang ma sring mor gyur/ /bla ma'i 'od kyis ye shes mngon sum thim/ /dbang bskur slar yang thugs kha'i hūm̐ gis dbang lha spyan drangs/ bla ma dang gur mgon la mi bskyod pa gzhan rnams la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa res/ dbu brgyan dam bzhag bla ma'i phyag tu dam tshig rdo rje thogs nas/ rdo rje 'di ni sogs sngags zhes brjod la/ rdo rje de 'dra ba re lha so so'i spyi bo nas thim pas snying gar bsam mo/ /gtor ma 'bul/ /phyi nang gis mchod bla ma'i thugs ka ru/ /hūm̐ yig yi dam chos skyong sngags kyis bskor/ /lha rnams thugs kar rang rang sa bon gsal/ /bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis rang lus gang / /nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus kun sbyangs nas/ /bde chen ye shes skyes shing chos skyong rnams/ /cung zad skrag pas skabs 'dir yi dam gyi snying po bzla/ bka' las 'da' med gyur/ /de nas 'od zer chos skyong so so yi/ /thugs ka'i sa bon la phog rab mnyes shing / /'dzum pa'i mdangs bcas bdag gi dbang 'dus gyur/ / ces brjod cing bsam nas mgon po lcam dral las mkhan rnams la so so'i sngags de dang de'i sku la dmigs pa gtad la mgon po la yi ge bdun ma ji tsam bzlas pa'i phyed lha mo la bzla/

oṃ mahā ka la ru pa sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ zangs gri can de dang mnyam pa/ las mkhan mo'i bod pa lha mo'i de'i phyed dang / pho'i bod pa de'i phyed bzla'o/ /de yan ni bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas rlung ro lan gsum bus la/ yum chen 'od tsha zhing bsreg pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ kyis ro ma'i pho rgyud bskul/ /sna bug g.yas 'phros mkha' khyab dgra bgegs bcom/ /pho rgyud du byas rang bzhin pho rgyud dang / /'dres nas tshur 'dus sna bug g.yas nas zhugs/ /ro ma'i pho rgyud la 'dres dbang du 'dus/ /'byung 'jug gnas pa'i rlung gis gsal bar gyur/ /rlung de gsum bsdom pa la phreng ba re bskyur la grangs bzung nas bya/ yang ni 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems kun/ /spyan drangs sna bug g.yas zhugs ro ma yis/ /pho rgyud la thim byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /'di yang 'byung 'jug gnas pa'i rlung gis gsal/ /rlung gsum gcig tu bsdom pa'i grangs gong gi dbang bsdus dang mnyam par bya dgos so/ /de ltar dbang du bsdu ba dang byin gyis brlab pa'i dmigs pa de rnams g.yon ma'i mo rgyud dang / dbu ma'i gnyis med rgyud rnams la yang tshig 'don pa bsgyur zhing sgom pa'i sgrub pa'o/ /de nas yum chen bla ma'i thugs ka nas/ /'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ /mgon po 'khor bcas la phog 'dar zhing skrag /dgra bgegs la phog rang 'dra'i sprul pa'i tshogs/ /stong gsum gang ba spros nas dgra bgegs rnams/ /rjes med btang nas bsgral bya'i rnam shes dang / /rang sems ro gcig gshis lugs 'dzin med ngang / /slar yang sprul pa tshur 'dus so sor thim/ /skabs 'dir sha sa na dang lha mo dang las mgon rnams kyi rbad bsad rnams bzla'o/ /mi shes na bsnyen sngags rnams kyi mjug tu dgra bgegs ma ra ya phaṭ ces btags pa bzla'o/ /bla ma'i 'od kyis pu tra ming sring bskul/ /mkha' khyab spros pas dgra bgegs tshar bcad de/

/sems can thams cad ming sring gsum du gyur/ /tshur 'dus nang gi ming sring gsum la thim/ /ming sring gsum po gnod sbyin yab yum thim/ /bla ma'i 'od kyis gnod sbyin yab yum spros/ /khams khyab dgra bgegs/ tshar bcad sems can rnams gnod sbyin yab yum gyi/ skur gyur yab yum nang gi gnod sbyin la/ thim/ /gnod sbyin yab yum lcam dral sogs la thim/ /bla ma'i 'od kyis lcam dral la sogs spros/ /khams dgra bgegs khyab tshar bcad lcam dral zangs gri can dang bcas pa'i/ skur gyur nang gi lcam dral sogs la/ thim/ /lcam dral zangs gri can rnams bla mar thim/ /bla ma he ru ka las de 'dra ba/ /dpag med spros pas sems can sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /sems can rnams/ rdo rje 'chang gyur 'khor 'das brtan g.yo kun/ /bla ma he ru ka yi skur gyur nas/ /tshur 'dus nang gi he ru ka la thim/ /de nyid dregs pa rgyud gsum kun 'dus pa'i/ /thig le sngon po sngo ba 'tsher ba 'dril ba/ sran ma tsam du gyur/ skabs 'dir rlung ro bus te thig le la sems gtad nas bum pa can lan kha yar 'dzin/ /thig le de nyid bla ma yi dam dang / /chos skyong kun 'dus yi ge hūm̐ sngon po/ du 'gyur/ /de las chos skyong ngo bo nas 'bru tsam zhig dbu zhabs zlog ste/ hūm̐ gcig chad/ /'od zer dmar po'i sna la nar gyis byung / /lte ba'i yum chen spyi bo nas thogs med du/ zhugs te/ /gsang gnas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad/ /kha phye ze'u 'bru'i dbus nas phyi rol tu/ /hūm̐ yig de yi phyed tsam thon pa la/ /phyi rol dregs pa can rnams thim par gyur/ /ces brjod cing yum chen gyi pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i dbus kyi hūm̐ yig de sngo tsher gyis thon byung ma thag phyi rol na gnas pa'i dregs pa pho mo gnyis med kyi rgyud thams cad pad+ma'i tshal du ngang pa 'du ba ltar rang dbang med par 'ub kyis 'dus te/

la la hūm̐ la thim/ phal cher rang gi mtha' skor na sprin 'thib pa bzhin du yod par bsam mo/ /de ltar gsang rten gnad 'di med na phyi nang rten ji tsam bzang yang mgon po 'du ba dka' la/ gnad 'di yod na phyi nang gi gi rten ril 'bru tsam med na'ang mgon po lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'du nges pa yin te/ dmigs pa 'di nyin zhag re la yid la dran pa thengs drug byas na chos skyong lus dang grib ma bzhin du mi 'gro ri zhes/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos gzhan gyis ma bsgags pa'i dbu bsnyung thengs gsum bzhes pa yin/ zab mo'i dmigs pa 'di/ /dus drug dran pas rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs gyur nas/ /bstan pa mchog tu 'phel ba'i mthu ldan shog/ ༈ //rig byed ma'i bskyed rdzogs mnyam su len tshul thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs so/ / 'di nas thar rtse paṇa chen gyi sgrub dkyil bar sa skya pa kun blos be bum dras la bcug cing bkris ma gtogs tshang mar lung rgyun yod/ /na mo gu ru rat+na war+dha ya/ rig byed ma sgrub par 'dod pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ zhe thag pa nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang skad cig gis ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hriḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dbu la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥku ru kul+le bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ om̐ ku ru kul+le badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shū n+ya ta'i sngags brjod pas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pas stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu 'phros pas 'phags pa rnams mchod/

sems can thams cad rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis ut+pala'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs shing / g.yas 'og mas khams gsum 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu dang / g.yon 'og mas ut+pala'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs shing 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing lang tsho bcu drug lon pa lta bu/ dbu skra kham pa gyon du brdzes pa/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yas pa'i brang ba gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu'i 'od zer gyis yongs su mdzes shing snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gyur/ de'i spyi bor om̐/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i ut+pal dmar po'i lte bar nyi ma la hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rig byed kyi phug nas rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba om̐ badz+ra sa mā dza/ zhes pas spyan drangs la gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ om̐ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba brtsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas om̐ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de la rang gi snying kha nas sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis/ dkar mo ri dwags la sogs pas mchod/ yi ge sngags rnams rnam par spangs/ /sgra dang thig le sems kyang med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa nyid/ /ces pas bstod/ bdud rtsi kyai rdor ltar byin gyis brlabs pa 'bru gsum brjod cing myang ste bde bas mnyes par bsams la/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba mar me'i phreng ba lta bu las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi stobs sogs kyi yon tan thams cad dang / skye 'gro bsod nams can rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang thams cad 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim par bsams la/ om̐ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes ma yengs par tsan+dan dmar po'i phreng ba ming med kyi steng nas drangs shing / bgrang rab bya'o/ thun 'jog pa na/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ man ngag thob nas rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs bsgoms te/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsams la dge ba bsngo'o/ /rang byin rlabs kyi rim pa mdor bsdus pa tsam bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ bzlas pa'i rjes su lus gnad bcos te rlung ro bsal la/ rang gi lus kyi dbus drang por yar rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dbus kyi yig 'bru rnams dang bcas pa kye rdor bzhin gsal bar bsgoms nas/ rang gi snying kha nas hrī las bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'ba' zhig snying las langs te 'od zer gyi rnam pa rtsa dbu ma'i lam nas gyen du byon pas mgo bo'i g.yon nas bskor te rna ba g.yas kyi bu ga nas 'thon/

mda' zhu rna drung du bkang ba'i mda'i ltong nas zhugs te/ ut+pala'i mde'u rgyas par byas nas/ 'od zer de mar 'phros pas srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi snying la zhugs pas de thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'dus te 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par 'gyur pa tshul 'dus te ut+pala'i mde'u nang du zhugs pa mde'u'i nang nas brgyud de rna ba g.yas pa'i bu gar zhugs/ mgo bo'i g.yas su bskor te spyi bo'i haṃ yig la thim pas byang chub kyi sems kyi spyi bo'i 'khor lo gang zhing rgyas par byas/ haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa a wa dhū ti'i lam nas byon te/ mgrin pa dang snying kha'i 'khor lo yang gang zhing rgyas par byas lte ba'i am̐ yig gi steng du bab par mos te 'bar 'dzag la yid drag tu gtad cing rlung bum pa can bzung / mthar byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gsang gnas yan chad du khyab cing gang ba la brten nas byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bzhi thob cing / yas 'bab kyi dga' ba bzhi'i rtog pa skyes te/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dri ma med pa las byung ba'i dam pa'i bde ba bla na med pas rang gi lus dang snod bcud thams cad la khyab par mos te/ gang la thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang yod ma yin/ /zhes pa'i don rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum stong pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / 'khor 'das gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'i mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par snang tsam dbyer mi phyed ba'i bde stong dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /snyam du nges pa byas la shes pa khongs lhod kyis slod nas mnyam par gzhag ldang bar 'dod par gdan bsdus te dge rtsa bsngo ba sogs byas la lha'i nga rgyal gyi spyod lam la 'jug

gtor ma 'bul na nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun ma mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / sngags kyi mthar/ om̐ a kā ro btags la phul/ nyer spyod lnga dang / bdud rtsi dang / lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /mda' gzhu ut+pa la dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs ci shes pas bstod/ 'dod don zhus/ lhag chad kha bskang / bzod par gsol/ bris sku sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs su gsol ba/ bsngo ba smon lam ci shes bya'o/ /rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len mdor bsdus pa 'di ni/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas/ mdzad pa'i gzhung gi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du las dang po pa rnams nyams su blang bde ba'i phyir btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis sbyar ba'o/ /mad+ga laṃ// ༈ //na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ya/ rig byed ma'i rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul ni/ gzhi dmar po'i steng du tsan+dan dmar pos byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la me tog dmar po'i tshom bu bkod/ bris sku yod na dgram/ chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang / smug rtsi byugs pa'i gtor ma gcig slob dpon gyi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu me tog rnams bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyai rdo rje bzhin byas la/ bdag bskyed bzlas dang bcas pa bya/ tshom bu lha mo yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor ma phul la thugs rgyud bskul ba'i bzlas pa bya/ dbang gis smin pa'i slob ma nyer lnga yan lag khrus byas/ phyag dang rigs mthun gyi yon phul nas gral la 'khod pa la sems bskyed gsal btab/ 'dir dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams nas bshad pa'i rje btsun ma'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/

sngon gyi lo rgyus ni/ sngon rgyal po lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pa zhes bya ba/ rgyal srid che zhing mtho ba cig la/ 'bangs 'khor g.yog dang btsun mo mang du yod pa las/ btsun mo gnang chen zhes bya ba'i gam du rgyal po 'khor du ma 'dod pa las/ btsun mo des g.yog mo zhig la rgyal po dbang du bya ba'i rig pa tshol cig ces bsgos nas btang bas/ bran mo des tshong 'dus rnams dang / khyad par skud pa tshong ba'i tshong 'dus su phyin pas/ bud med dmar smug shin tu mdzes pa zhig dang 'phrad de/ de la rgyal po dbang du bya ba'i rigs pa yod dam zhes dris pas/ de 'dra ba yod srid zer/ der de la gsol ba btab pas/ gang dmigs pa de la 'di byin cig bza' rgyu'i rigs shig bskur ba btsun mo la gtad de lo rgyus bsnyad pas/ btsun mo'i bsam pa la 'di 'dra ba rgyal po la drangs na ma legs pa zhig byung srid snyam nas/ pho brang gi nye logs na mtsho zhig yod pa la skyur bas/ de'i nub mo klu'i rgyal po zhig btsun mo'i sar 'ongs nas brtse zhing dga' mgur spyad pas btsun mo de srog chags dang ldan par gyur pa na/ rgyal po na re/ bud med de'i rtsar ngas ma phyin pas/ de la chad pas chod cig ces bsgo bas na/ btsun mos sngar gyi lo rgyus bsnyad pas rgyal po na re/ re zhig brtag par bya yis zer nas/ sngar gyi bran mo de tshong 'dus su bud med de 'tshol du btang bas/ rnyed de pho brang du spyan drangs 'ongs pas/ rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das ma yin par shes te rjes su gzung bar zhus pas des rjes su gdams shing byin gyis brlabs nas mchog gi dngos grub thob ste/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pa zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de lta bu'i slob dpon des 'di'i sgrub thabs mdzad cing / de las rim par brgyud pa'i gdams pa yin/ 'di ma brjod kyang rung /

rjes gnang dngos la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad grub/ slob ma'i bya ba la rjes gnang gi sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs nas gnang bar mdzod/ ces gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams steng gi cha la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar om̐ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la/ phyag dang mchod pa phul bar mos pa byas te thal mo sbyar nas 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥku ru kul+le bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag byas tshogs zhing ltar mchod nas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pas yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog /ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ tshogs zhing rnams mdun bskyed kyi lha mo la thim par mos pa mdzod/ de rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi lha mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang gi lus la zhugs pas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs te lus dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos pa mdzod/ ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod pas slob ma lhar bskyed/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyis om̐ shū n+ya ta sogs nas/ snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gyur par mos pa mdzod/

de nas slob dpon dang khyed rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pa lho phyogs rig byed kyi phug na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phog pas de'i thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs kha nas 'od zer dmar po'i phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dmar khrig khrig byon te khyed rang gi lus la thim pas lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pa brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la phog pas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang bcud thams cad rje btsun ma'i skur gyur te slar tshul 'dus nas khyed rang la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pa lho phyogs rig byed kyi phug na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i sku la phog pas/ de las de 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod ces dang sngags kyi mthar dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod/ dril bu gsil zhing gu gul gyis bdug des rje btsun ma'i sku'i rjes gnang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lus lhar bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu rje btsun ma'i sku dang rang gi lus dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥyig gcig bsams te slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma la gus 'dud drag po dung pa byas pas/ de gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung / zhal nas 'thon khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs thugs ka'i hrī yig gi mthar g.yas bskor du 'khod par mos pa byas/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mam nyi shu rtsa lnga mdzod/ om̐ nas swā hā zhes bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pa man gyis brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

bcom ldan bdag gis sogs lan gsum brjod nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byin gyis brlabs te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs lan gsum gyi mthar rdo rje slob ma 'di'i rgyud la rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig des rje btsun ma'i gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag ngag sngags zlos pa la dbang / 'bras bu rje btsun ma'i gsung dang rang gi ngag dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang / stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / ma 'dres pa'i chos la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad hrīḥyig gam 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang gi thugs kar thim pas de rnams kyi byin rlabs thams cad rgyud la zhugs par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lung dang mngon pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad hrīḥyig gam sogs 'gre/ slar yang slob dpon nam thugs ka'i hrīḥde las 'od zer 'phros pas tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang thams cad gong ltar hrīḥyig gam spyan drangs te khyed rang la thim pas tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang thams cad rgyas par mos pa mdzod/ slar slob dpon gyi yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / paṇ+ḍi ta dang / skye 'gro bsod nams can rnams kyi lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan dang /

tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad kyang gong ltar spyan drangs te/ khyed rang la thim pas lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ om̐ ku ru kul+le hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ a we sha ya hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥzhes gang mang brjod cing gu gul gyis bdug dril bu'i sgra res 'jog tu bya/ des rje btsun ma'i thugs kyi rjes gnang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag sems ye shes su bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu rje btsun ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod de nas bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bstan la ngo sprad/ rjes spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de tsam mi nus na/ gsol gdab kyi mthar rgyun bshags tsam bya/ sku bskyed bstim dang rol mo/ gsung bzlas lung / thugs mdun bskyed las hrīḥyig bstim la dril gsil bya/ rjes gtso bos/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs 'dra/ tshom bu la mchod bstod/ dngos grub blangs la gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa bsdus te gnas bsrungs la dge ba bsngo/ rig byed ma'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa dang / thun mong ba ji ltar bya ba'i tshul 'di ni btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis e wam̐ chos ldan du sbyar ba'o/ /snod min la gsang zhing sba bar bya ba'i chos so/ dge legs mchog tu gyur cig ༈ /'di lugs kyi rjes gnang yig cha so so'i lung rnams spyan snga rin po che'i drung du sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi thos so/ /bkra shis/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ 'di'i gsang sngags la bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig dang khri tsho gcig kha skongs dang bcas pa bzhi thog bla brang ba'i yangs rtse mkha' spyod bde ba can smon gnas yid 'ong tshal du song ba bkra shis/ 'di'i bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor dang bcas sngags 'bum phrag gcig kha bskong dang bcas pa song //

//shu bhaṃ// //ku ru kul+le'i bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi lam nyams su len tshul gyi gnad bsdus tshig bcad ma sa skya pas smras pa dge bar bzhugs pa yin/ swasti sid+dham̐/ dkon mchog la skyabs lam bzang bsgom/ /tshogs zhing spyan drangs sdom pa gzung / /srung 'khor pad nyi ro steng du/ /hriḥlas byung ba'i lha mo ni/ /kha dog dmar zhing phyag bzhi ma/ /mda' dang gzhu yi lag pa ma/ /ut+pa la dang lcags kyu 'dzin/ /g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs nyi dkyil bzhugs/ /ye shes pa thim rgya yis btab/ /mchod bstod snying gar nyi dkyil dbus/ /hriḥyig sngags 'phreng byu ru'i mdog /'od zer dmar po 'bar bar gyur/ /oṃ ku ru kul+le hriḥswāhā/ dge 'dis snang srid dbang 'dus nas/ /chos srid dpal 'byor rab rgyas shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ rang nyid rig byed sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi/ /hriḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu rnam pa/ zhags pa 'dra ba/ 'phros/ /dmigs yul las rlung dmar po 'tshub cing 'khyil bas/ gis bskyod mdun du bkug /mda' 'phangs snying gar phog pas dran pa gzhan/ /'gags nas bdag nyid kho na sems par gyur/ /'od dmar gyis btum chags pas 'dar zhing gnas/ /hriḥlas 'od 'phros dmigs yul bha ga nas/ /zhugs 'og rlung 'then/ te lte rang gi ba'i pad+ma dmar po/ 'dab brgyad dbus/ /tsog pur thal sbyar gnas par snying kha nas/ /ye shes sems dpa'i bha ga'i khrag rgyun gyis/ /phyi nang kun bkrus rang la ma dad sbyangs/ /rang sems dbyer med dbang du 'dus par gyur/ steng rlung mnan la kha sbyar thub tshad bzung / /ces brjod cing sngags bzla'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //bde mchog nag po pa'i mngon rtogs kyi sgom don bsdus pa ting 'dzin rab gsal bzhugs/ dkon mchog la rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bde mchog skyabs yul gsal bar bsgom la/ skyabs skyabs yul rnams 'od sngon dmar dkar gsum du zhu nas/

rang la thim/ /rang bde mchog tu bsal ba'i/ zhal bzhi'i 'od kha dog dang mthun pa'i/ kyi tshad med sems can thams cad/ bzhi la bkod/ par bsam zhing sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i sogs brjod/ bdag dang /gzhan gyi/ phyir dpal/ 'khor lo bde mchog 'di lam zab mo/ bsgom par bgyid/ /rang bde mchog tu gsal ba'i spyi bor/ rdor sems yab yum bsgom pa'i/ bdud rtsis rang gi shes rgyud kyi/ nyes ltung ma lus sbyangs/ yig brgya dang bla ma bdag ni sogs brjod/ lus ngag yid gsum /dag pa gsum ldan rang nyid bde mchog gi zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i/ /snying ga'i 'od kyis rang bzhin gnas nas/ bde mchog dkyil 'khor gyi/ /steng gi cha la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa la/ brgyud pa'i/ bla ma rnams dang /ra bcas/ /spyan drangs phyag 'tshal phyi dang yid 'byung mchod/ 'dir dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs brjod cing tshogs zhing rang la thim par bsams/ /stong pa'i oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sogs dang / oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra sogs brjod cing / ngang las rang sems hūm̐ du gyur/ /de las 'og tu/ pad nyi sna tshogs/ rdo rje lte bar/ hūm̐ bcas chad/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i/ hūm̐ las phyogs bcur sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ khro mo spros/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod/ /yang ni sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir gur mda' drang mo 'od dang bcas pas yongs su rdzogs pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ srung 'khor gsal bar gyur/ oṃ me dā+e ni sngags rnams brjod/ /khro mo pho nya rnams kyis sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i/ phyag mtshan phur bu thogs pa/ dang bcas pas/ /phyogs bcu'i bgegs bkug dkar phyogs rnams skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed la bkod/

nag phyogs phur bus gdab/ oṃ gha gha sogs brjod/ /pho nya rnams rdo rje ra ba'i kha khyer la 'khod nas/sa sgrub po sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi dus/ rtag tu bsrung bar gyur/ /srung 'khor gyi nang du/ chos 'byung 'byung bzhi lugs sa chu me rlung / ldog ri rab bcas/ /zhu bas 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung rlung me chu sa/ ri rab steng / /gzhal yas khang pa lte ba bde chen/ thugs gsung sku dam tshig 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i pho brang / dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis/ bskor ba'i nang / /mngon dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ byang lnga las rang nyid rgyu'i rdo 'dzin/ sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ /mkha' gsang yum gyi mkha' dang yab kyi gsang gnas/ byin rlabs rjes chags thig ler zhu/ bar bsam la oṃ mahā su kha sogs brjod la/ zhu ba de nyid nam mkha' nas/ bskul bas rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ 'bras bu rdo 'dzin bzhengs/ /yab yum gnyis kyi gnas su/ go cha'i lha rnams/ gsal bar bsams/ ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams bde mchog yab yum gyi rnam par/ spyan drangs thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sogs brjod la/ /dbang lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas/ spyan drangs rgyas gdab pa ni yab la mi bskyod pa dang yum la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyi nang mchod/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i ar+gham̐ sogs kyi phyi mchod dang / snying po gnyis kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pa nang mchod phul bar bsam/ /slar yang mkha' yab kyi gsang gnas yum gyi mkha'/ gsang byin rlabs oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rak+ka sogs brjod par bsam la/ phyogs bcu yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams/ /yab kyi zhal zhugs bha gar thig ler 'dres/ pa las cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig gzhal yas khang dang cha gcig lha tshogs rnams su gyur par bsams/

/de las bha ga'i nang du/ rten gzhal yas khang / dang brten pa lha rnams/ gsal bar gyur/ /rang gi lus dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo/ lha 'khor lo sdom par/ gnas pa'i lus dkyil gyi lha'i 'god gzhi rnams/ rtsa yi ge 'i/ rnam pa'o/ /yab yum snyoms zhugs 'og rlung bskyod pa yis/ yum gyi /bha ga'i nang gi rten dang brten pa rnams/ /spyan drangs rang gi gtso bor gyur pa'i/ phyi rol gyi bde chen thugs gsung sku dam tshig 'khor lo rnams/ nang gi rang gi lus dkyil gyi/ dkyil 'khor rnams/ /'ja' tshon lta bur snang la rang bzhin med pa/ gsal bar gyur pa ni/ /snying rnam par shes pa'i rten khams las yab dang phyi shun gyi rtsa la yum/ kha'i hūm̐ dang nang skor gyi rtsa yig lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tam̐ dang / mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa rnams dang gzhan yang / /spyi bo sogs kyi nang gi khams dang phyi shun gyi/ rtsa rnams ni/ /spyi bor rtsa yi ge su dang po dang sen mo'i khams/ spyi gtsug gi rtsa yi ge dza dang skra dang ba spu'i khams/ rna ba g.yas kyi rtsa yi ge au dang lpags pa dang dri ma'i khams/ ltag par rtsa yi ge a dang sha'i khams/ rna ba g.yon par rtsa yi ge go dang chu rgyus kyi khams/ smin dbus rtsa yi ge ra dang rus pa'i khams/ mig gnyis su rtsa yi ge de dang mchin pa'i khams/ phrag pa gnyis su rtsa yi ge ma dang snying ga'i khams/ mchan khung gnyis su rtsa yi ge kā dang mig gi khams/ nu ma gnyis su rtsa yi ge o dang mkhris pa'i khams/ lte bar rtsa yi ge tri dang glo ba'i khams/ sna rtser rtsa yi ge ko dang rgyu ma'i khams/ khar rtsa yi ge ka dang gnye ma'i khams/ mgrin par rtsa yi ge la dang lto ba'i khams/ snying gar rtsa yi ge ka dang dri chen gyi khams/ 'dom bar du rtsa yi ge hi dang mtshogs ma'i khams/ mtshan mar rtsa yi ge pra dang bad kan gyi khams/

gshang lam du rtsa yi ge gṛ dang rnag gi khams/ brla gnyis su rtsa yi ge so dang khrag gi khams/ byin pa gnyis su rtsa yi ge su dang rngul gyi khams/ sor mo bcu drug tu rtsa yi ge na dang tshil gyi khams/ bol gong gnyis su rtsa yi ge si dang mchi ma'i khams/ mthe bong bzhir rtsa yi ge ma dang mchil ma'i khams/ pus mo gnyis su rtsa yi ge ku dang snabs kyi khams/ snying kha'i phyi skor sgo mtshams ma'i bskyed gzhi/ hūm̐ ring brgyad rnams ni/ /'khor lo/ bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha/ tshogs rnams su gsal bar gyur/ /phyi dkyil gyi bde chen thugs gsung sku dam tshig 'khor lo ste/ 'khor lo lnga yi lha rnams kyang / /gsal bar gyur cing rang gi lus nyid kyi/ /spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje nas skra sen mo me ri 'bar ba'i bar/ srung 'khor gzhal yas khang rkang mthil rlung nas lus kyi bu ga dgu dur khrod brgyad du gyur pa'i bar/ rnams gsal bar gyur/ /dag pa'i rang bzhin dus dran par byas/ pho nya sngags skyes/ rnam zhing skyes/ gsum/ lhan skyes/ 'dres/ / oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba wi ra sogs dang oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sogs lan gsum brjod/ go cha'i phyi nang gi lha kun las/ lha gsal bar gyur cing snying kha'i 'od kyis/ ye shes dngos su thim/ / par bsam/ slar yang snying kha'i 'od kyis dbang lha byon nas/ dbang bskur bas gtso bo yab la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang / phyogs g.yon bskor kyi lha rnams la mi bskyod pa/ don grub/ 'od dpag med/ rin 'byung / mtshams g.yas skor gyi lha rnams la/ rnam snang / rin 'byung / 'od dpag med/ don 'grub kyis/ dbu brgyan par bsam la sngags mchod nas bstod pa'i bar gyi/ mchod pa drug gis mchod/ rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas/ /lha rnams thams cad drug cu rtsa gnyis/

byang chub kyi/ phyogs kyi chos/ lus rjes su dran pa ni mkha' 'gro ma sogs/ /sum cu rtsa bdun gyi/ ngo bor rnam par/ dag pa yin/ la/ /byang chub kyi/ phyogs kyi/ chos sum cu lus rjes dran dgos/ rtsa bdun yang / /mkha' 'gro ma sogs 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha yi ngo bo rnam par dag pa'o/ zhes brjod cing bsam la skabs 'dir bskyed rim la sems 'dzin yun ji ltar rigs par bya/ de nas rdzogs rim ni rang gi /snying kha'i 'od kyis snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang du gyur pa rnams dang / bcud kyi sems can/ lhar gsal rnams/ 'od du zhu nas/ /rang gi bsgom pa 'i rten dang brten pa/ la thim zhing / de lus kyi rten la rten dang lha rnams phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis sna bug g.yon dang g.yas nas/ thim/ par bsam/ rang gi lte ba'i aṃ /yum dang zhal rang gi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams/ rtsa bar gyur pa'i zhal phyag la/ thim/ /rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i/ lhar gsal ba'i lte ba nas snying kha'i bar la/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo rnams/ /gsal zhing gtum mo'i me dang byang sems/ 'bar 'dzag sems gtad bde drod 'bar/ zhes brjod cing lte ba nas snying kha'i bar la rtsa a wa dhu ti zhes pa nas/ 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems gtad/ ces pa'i bar brjod cing bsgom la rlung ro bus nas bum can bzung / /hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang gi snying ga nas/ /rten dang brten pa yongs rdzogs sngar bzhin du/ /spros shing gnas pa'i rang gi snying ga nas/ na gnas pa'i hūm̐ las/ /sngags kyi phreng ba byung nas rang / yab tu gsal ba'i zhal nas/ yum gyi/ zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ nas brgyud/ mar byung ba yum gyi/ /pad+ma nas byung rang rang 'khor lo bde mchog

gi skur gsal ba'i/ gsang gnas zhugs/ /snying kar gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig la/ thim pas sngags kyi 'od zer gyis/ /snod sngags phreng phye la 'gro ba'i 'od zer gyis brtan g.yo/ bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du/ra gsal sngags phreng nang du 'jug pa'i 'od zer gyis/ bla ma yi dam dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi/ byin rlabs ma lus pa/ /bsdus nas rang la thim pas gzi brjid rgyas/ zhes brjod cing bsam la rtsa sngags nas sgo mtshams ma'i bar gyi sngags dang go cha'i sngags rnams kyang bzlas la/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs brjod cing bzlas pa bsdus la yig brgya gsum dang de nas/ /snying ga'i 'od kyis snod kyi gzhal yas khang dur khrod srung 'khor/ rnams/ /rang gi bsgom rten gyi dkyil 'khor/ pa la thim zhing / de yang / lus kyi dkyil 'khor gzhal yas sogs la/ thim/ /bcud kyi/ sems can 'khor lo bde mchog lhar gsal ba rnams 'od du zhu nas/ 'khor gyi lha rnams/ la thim/ /de rnams kyang 'od du zhu nas/ rnams phyogs mtshams g.yas bskor g.yon bskor gyis/ /rang gi lus bde mchog 'khor lor gsal ba'i/ sna bug g.yon dang g.yas nas thim/ /rang nyid zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i/ lhar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su/ go cha gsum gyis bsrungs/ shing de yang pu dza sogs go cha chen po brjod pa'i tshe/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams yig 'brur gyur par bsam la/ sum+bha ni lan gnyis phyag rgya dmigs pa dang bcas pas mtshams rngam sngags kyis bsrung / de nas hūm̐ lan gcig dang hriḥha ha sogs yi ge bdun ma lan gcig dang yang hūm̐ lan gcig brjod/ /snang srid thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog sku/ /sgra rnams thams cad yi ge bdun ma'i sgra/ /rtog 'gyur thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog thugs/ /nam lus ngag yid gsum lha'i sku gsung thugs su dran pa'i/

yang dga' ba gsum gyis rol ba 'o/ /dge 'dis 'khor lo bde mchog zhal mthong shog /'di yang rnal 'byor a nan+das/ /gnad bsdus kyis nyams len bsdus pa'o/ /sarba dā oṃ// ༈ //bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi nyams len snying po'o/ /dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir tshe sgrub bgyid/ /swa bha wa sogs brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis/ dang mdun nyid du/ /'byung bzhi ri rab sna tshogs/ pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /rdor sems 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog dkar/ / po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum zhal/ mche gtsigs phyag gnyis kyis/ rdo dril thugs kar bsnol/ /dbu skra ral pa'i/ thor cog nor bu dang / sna tshogs rdo rjes mdzes/ /rin chen sna tshogs kyi/ rgyan dang stag lpags sham thabs can/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum 'jigs byed dang / /dus mtshan mnan pa'i thugs kar āḥdamar re/ /mdun bskyed thugs ka'i āḥlas 'chi med tshe'i/ /rang bzhin sngags phreng byung nas zhal nas thon/ /rang gi zhal zhugs thugs ka'i āḥyig la/ /thim pas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ /oṃ hriḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ci nus bgrangs pa'i mjug tu/ ma ma a yur puṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes pa yang gang mang bgrangs la/ bzlas pa 'jog par spro na/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad sogs brjod cing phreng ba mgo thog tu bzhag mdun bskyed rang thim 'chi med 'grub par shog /ces brjod pas dge ba bsngo/ 'di rang gi bsnyen tshad 'bru 'bum yin zhing / 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug kun tu gong gi dmigs pa rnams gsal btab nas sngags la bye bsnyen bsags na/ dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / phyi ma mkha' spyod 'grub pa sogs 'di phyi gnyis ka'i don bde blag tu 'grub par nges so// ༈ //sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dpal ster bzhugs/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir tshe sgrub bsgom/

/rang sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i tam̐ yig gi 'od kyis/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs gu ru dang ar+ya ta ra sogs sngon 'gro'i phyag mchod/ mchod cing dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyi/ sdom pa bzung / /swa bhā wa sogs stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rje btsun ma/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan sogs gsal bar gyur/ ye shes kyi spyan bdun dang ldan par/ /ye shes pa thim dbang bskur rgya yis btab/ /ar+ya ta ra sogs sngon 'gros/ mchod cing bstod do 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis/ lha skur rang sems bzung / /snying gar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ /lte bar tam̐ yig mdun rgyab oṃ dang hā/ /mdun nas g.yas skor ma ma a yu dang / /puṇ+ya dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku rus bskor/ /rtsibs brgyad rnams la ta re tud tā re/ /tu re swa rnams shin tu gsal bas bskor/ /de yi phyi rol mu khyud rim lnga la/ /nang nas rim bzhin a li ka li dang / /ye dhar rdor phreng 'od zer 'phreng bas bskor/ zhes brjod cing bsam la yi ge bcu pa dang spel tshig can/ dbyangs gsal gnyis/ ye dhar rnams ji ltar rigs pa bzlas/ /snying ga'i 'khor lo sngags dang bcas pa las/ /'od dkar 'phros pas rang gi phyi rol tu/ /'khor lo sbubs can zhwa theb kha sprad bzhin/ /steng 'og rtsibs med yin pas phra seng nge / /phyogs mtshams rtsibs brgyad sbubs can rtser mu khyud/ /rang nyid sgrol ma'i g.yas g.yon oṃ dang ha/ /rtsibs brgyad sbubs stong bar nang ta re sogs/ /lte bar rang gi mtha' skor ta re la/ /spel tshig can gyis bskor zhing rtsibs mtha' yi/ /mu khyud gsum la a li g.yon skor dang / /ka li rten 'brel snying po g.yas skor 'khod/ /'khor lo'i gur khang nang du bu slob dang / /sbyin bdag kun gsal dus mtha'i rlung gis kyang / /gzhom par mi nus 'od dkar 'khor lo de/ /g.yas su 'khor zhing rang nyid lhar gsal dang /

/phyi nang yig 'bru 'khor lo gur khang las/ /shel dang zla 'dra'i 'od zer 'phros pa las/ /'khor lo'i phyi rol 'dom gang tsam gyi sar/ /skya sgor 'khor zhing 'od dkar gur du gyur/ /de yi nus pas nad gdon sdig sgrib kun/ /zhi sogs zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par gyur/ / ces brjod cing bsam la yi ge bcu pa dang spel tshig can dbyangs gsal gnyis rten 'brel snying po rnams ji ltar 'os pa bzla/ yang ni sngags kyi gur khang sngags phreng las/ /'od zer ser po gser btso ma lta bu'i 'od/ 'phros shing 'od ser po/ /gur du gyur pas de yi nus pa yis/ /rang gi tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rnams/ /rgyas sogs rgyas pa'i las kun 'grub par gyur/ / yi ge bcu pa dang spel tshig can dbyangs gsal gnyis ye dhar rnams ci rigs bzla/ yang ni sngar gyi gur khang sngags 'phreng las/ /'od zer dmar po 'phros shing 'od dmar po'i/ /gur du gyur pas de yi nus pa yis/ /snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad rang dbang du/ /'dus sogs dbang gi las kun 'grub par gyur/ / zhes brjod cing bsam la yi ge bcu pa dang spel tshig can dbyangs gsal gnyis/ ye dhar rnams ci rigs bzla/ yang ni sngar gyi gur khang sngags 'phreng las/ /'od zer dngul dwangs pa'i kha dog la g.yu'i mdangs phog pa lta bu/ lcags skya 'phros shing 'od lcags skya'i/ /gur du gyur pa de yi nus pa yis/ /rang la mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad kun/ /tshar bcad drag po'i las kun 'grub par gyur/ / ces brjod cing bsam la yi ge bcu pa dang spel tshig can dbyangs gsal gnyis ye dhar rnams gang 'os bzla/ yang ni sngar gyi gur khang sngags 'phreng las/ /mar gad lta bu'i/ 'od zer ljang gu 'phros shing 'od ljang gu'i/ /gur du gyur pa de yi nus pa yis/ /rang gi 'phrin las sna tshogs kun 'grub gyur/ / yi ge bcu pa dang spel tshig can dbyangs gsal ye dhar rnams ci rigs bzla/

yang ni sngar gyi gur khang sngags 'phreng las/ /'od zer rin po che nal gyi mdog lta bu/ mchin kha 'phros shing 'od mchin kha'i/ /gur du gyur pas de yi nus pa yis/ /rang gi las bzhi'i 'phrin las brtan par gyur/ /'od kyi gur khang drug po thams cad kyang / /dum bu gcig gyur sgo nga'i dbyibs lta bu/ /dus mtha'i rlung gis gzhom gzhig mi nus pa'i/ /gur khang drug gi bar la 'dom re tsam/ /yod pa'i bar mtshams thams cad ut+pa la/ /sngon po gsar pa mnyen lcug ldan pa yis/ /bun long gang zhing kun kyang gsal stong zhes brjod cing bsam la/ yi ge bcu pa spel tshig can/ dbyangs gsal gnyis/ ye dhar rnams ci rigs pa bzlas so/ /ngang / /rang gi spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med/ /tshe dpag med gyur de yi thugs ka nas/ /'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi/ /tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal 'byor thams cad/ bsdus nas bla ma'i/ phyag gi bum par thim/ / 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chur gyur/ bum pa lud de rang gi tshangs bug nas/ /bdud rtsi zhugs pas lus gang nad gdon dang / /sdig sgrib dag nas 'chi med dngos grub thob/ /thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags 'phreng bcas las kyang / /tshe chu bdud rtsi zil dngar rgyun bzang dang / /'od dkar sngags kyi sgra bcas dpag med 'phros/ /lus gang 'chi ba dag nas 'chi med thob/ /ba spu'i bu ga'ang bdud rtsi'i zil par bcas/ /slar yang thugs ka'i tam̐ yig sngags 'phreng gi /'od kyis snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas gyur/ /ut+pal steng gi hūm̐ ngam tam̐ yig las/ /'od 'phros sems can kun dang khyad par du/ /bu slob sbyin bdag bsrung bya rnams la phog /sgrib pa kun/ sbyangs lhar sgrol ma'i skur/ gyur so sor 'chi med thob/ /slar yang 'od zer sna las mchod pa spros/ /bla ma sogs/ mchod yul kun mchod tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag

/bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /khyad par bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ /mkhyen brtse nus gsum yon tan ye shes dang / /khyad par 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub rnams/ /'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i/ /rnam par byung nas rang gi snying ga'i/ yig 'bru rnams la thim/ /de yi nus pas tshe dang bsod nams dang / /ye shes rgyas nas 'chi med dngos grub thob/ /ar+ya ta re sogs sngon 'gros/ mchod cing bstod yi ge bcu pa dang spel tshig can brgya stong sogs bzlas/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs/ do dngos grub ma lus stsol/ yig brgya gsum dang / /snying kha'i 'od kyis 'od kyi gur khang rnams/ /phyi nas rim bzhin bsdus te rang la thim/ /rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka'i tam̐ la thim/ /tam̐ yig klad kor la thim 'od gsal thim/ /slar yang rang nyid chu las nya 'phar gyi/ /tshul gyis tshe sbyin dpal mor gsal bar gyur/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun 'grub shog /ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa a nan+da tshe'i rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub thob pa dpon slob rnams kyi nyams len gyi yang snying ngo / /sarba dā oṃ// ༈ //rmi lam brtag pa ni/ rang nyid 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor gsal/ /snying kha'i pad+ma kha phye lte bar tam̐/ /de las 'od 'phros rang lus khong stong khengs/ /tam̐ yig phyogs bzhir dngul gyi me long bzhi/ /shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhi g.yas skor du/ /a nu ta ra'i yi ge'i gzugs brnyan shar/ /tam̐ las 'od 'phros 'og min sgrol ma bstim/ /rten 'brel mngon sum 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ /rang don gang yin yi ge tam̐ du gyur/ /de yi 'od kyis rgyal khams 'gro ba dang / /khyad par rang gi don byas tam̐ gi 'od/ /skar mda' lta bu byung nas smin mtshams zug /dngos grub zhu ba'i 'dun pa drag po yis/ /tam̐ de khyur mid byas pas snying ga yi/

/tam̐ la thim pas gang 'dod rmi lam 'char/ /zhes brjod cing bsgom nas rmi lam dgugs pas as mtshon pa'i ming gi snang ba byung tshad don mi 'grub/ nu'i ming gi mtshon pa'i snang tshad don 'grub/ ta'i yi ge'i mtshon pa'i snang ba byung na mi mtshon pa'i rnam par shar tshad mi 'grub/ mtshon pa'i gzugs su byung tshad 'grub/ ra'i ming gi snang ba byung na/ srog chags snang ba shar tshad don 'grub/ srog chags ma yin pa gzugs su shar tshad mi 'grub ces bstan/ sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs kyi snying po 'chi med dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir tshe sgrub bgyid/ rang rnam rgyal du gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba'i steng gi bh+rum̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs kyi/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ni dza sogs sngon 'gro'i ar+gham̐ sogs kyis /tshogs zhing spyan drangs mchod bstod sdom pa bzung / /oṃ shun+ya tā dz+nyā na sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zlar bh+rum̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa/ las/ /seng khri pad gdan bang rim zlum po gsum/ /brtsegs pa'i steng du zla gdan bum pa zlum po yang zhing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas dang / /bre dang gdugs rim char kheb tog dang bcas/ /de lta'i mchod rten me tog phreng ba dang / /dar gyi lda ldi mdzes pa'i bum nang du/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte bar zla dkyil dbus/ /bh+rum̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje bh+rum̐ gyis mtshan/ /'od zer 'phros 'dus 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ yongs su gyur pa las/ /dpal mo gang zhig gtsug tor sprul pa'i sku zhes pa'i bar brjod cing gsal gdab pa'am bsdus pa la dga' na/ la/ rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag sogs sh+lau ka gcig po brjod pas lha dgu gsal btab/

/de rnams dpral spyi bo/ mgrin snying kha lte ba dang / /brla gnyis rnams la oṃ spyi bo/ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hriḥ dpral ba/ am̐ a dkar dmar sngo ser dmar ljang mdog /gtso mo'i thugs ka'i bh+rum̐ las 'od 'phros te/ /lha dgu'i ye shes spyan drangs gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar/ mchod cing thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ sogs kyi/ /dbang lha spyan drangs mchod cing pañca ku la sngon 'gro'i ar+gham̐ sogs kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ra ta sogs kyis/ gsol ba btab/ /dbang bskur gtso mo spyan gzigs khro bo sogs/ phyag rdor/ /lha bu rnams la rnam snang 'od dpag med/ /mi bskyod rin 'byung dbu brgyan gong tshogs zhing ltar la dharma ra ṇi btags pa'i/ mchod cing bstod/ /snying khar pad zla bh+rum̐ las byung ba yi/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rum̐ yig dkar/ /de yi steng mdun g.yas g.yon rgyab rnams su/ /bla ma ste/ pha ma mdun/ bu slob spun g.yas/ zla dang / /mched g.yon/ grogs 'khor rgyab/ g.yog de rnams las gang bsrung bya'i yul yin pa de bsam/ bsrung bya gang yin 'khod/ /mtha' skor sngags kyis bskor las 'od zer 'phros/ /rang dang bsrung bya'i lus gang 'gal rkyen dang / /sdig sgrib kun sbyangs 'od zer phyir 'phros pas/ /'phags mchod sems can rnam rgyal go 'phang bkod/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /byin rlabs 'od zer rnam par spyan drangs nas/ /thugs kar thim pas rang dang bsrung bya yi/ /tshe dpal bsod nams ye shes rgyas par gyur/ /ces brjod cing yid kyis bsam la thal mo sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gnyis kyis tshigs bar ma bcag ste mthe bong gnyis dang rtse sbyar ba legs so ster ba'i phyag rgya bcas te gzungs ring tshar gcig brjod/ de nas phyag rgya bkrol la sngags sum cu'am nyer gcig la sogs pa ci nus dang /

oṃ a mi te/ a mi tod+bha we/ a mi ta bi kran+ti/ ma mi ta ga tre/ a mi ta gā mi ni/ a mi ta ā yurta te ga ga na kirta ka re/ sarba kle sha k+ṣa yam̐ ka rī ye swāhā/ zhes pa 'di ci nus dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ tram̐ hriḥ.am̐ aḥmā ma sarba sa twam̐sh+tsa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru/ zhes lan gsum bzlas la/ mchod cing gong ltar/ bstod do dngos grub ma lus yig brgya tshar gsum/ stsol/ /mchod rten rten dang brten pa rang la thim/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun 'grub shog /ces pa 'di yang tshe'i rig 'dzin a nan+das myur bar sbyar ba'i dge bas bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig/ ༈ //rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi sgrub thabs snying po rgyal 'gong kun 'dul bzhugs pa yin/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir rta mgrin bsgom/ /swa bhā wa sogs dang / stong pa'i e las byung ba'i/ ngang las chos 'byung mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba/ me phung kha dog sna lnga 'khrug cing / 'bar nang / /rang sems hrīḥ dmar po/ las 'od 'phros gdon bgegs rnams/ /tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ /rang nyid rta mchog rol pa sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs dbu tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du sleb cing zhabs rgya mtsho'i bar non pa/ brgyad brjid pa'i sku/ /rtsa zhal dmar po g.yas ljang g.yon dkar ba/ /zhal gsum steng na rta mgo ljang khu 'tsher/ /rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pa yis/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas bzung dmyal khams bar/ /ye shes me yi ra ba dra ba dang / /gur dang bla res bar mtshams med pa khyab/ /phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje kha ṭ+wam̐ ga /ral gri 'dzin cing phyag g.yon rnam gsum ni/ /sdigs mdzub mdung dang rgyu ma'i zhags pas mdzes/ /zhal gsum ka yang re re bzhin/ gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril spyan rnams bgrad/

/ba spu'i bu ga thams cad tshon gang pa'i/ /khro chung sku yis go mtshams med pa gtams/ /dur khrod chas brgyad kyis sbrul dang mi mgo skam rlon khrag zhag tshal chen glang lpags zhing chen stag lpags sogs/ brgyan zhabs brgyad kyis/ /klu brgyad mnan cing me phung dbus na bzhugs/ /ye shes gnas gsum yi ge gsum bsam zhing de'i 'od kyis/ pa thim khro dbang dngos su gsal/ /oṃ hri pad+ma ta krita badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭ/ dge 'dis sde brgyad rgyal 'gong kun 'dul shog /'di lta bu'i nyams len 'di ma chag par byas na byin rlabs gzhan las che zhing / khyad par lha'i nga rgyal gsal zhing brtan pa'i ngang nas/ sku'i ba spu'i bu ga re re nas rta mgrin dpag med spros/ gdon bgegs log 'dren rnams bsad bskrad rengs par byas/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyis slob dpon pad+ma sogs 'phags pa mchod nas rang gi 'dod don bsgrubs/ dmyal khams kyi sdug bsngal zhi ba sogs sems can gyi don byas/ sngags kyi 'od zer g.yon phyogs 'khor bas gdon bgegs rnams rtswa'i sbur pa rlung gis ded pa bzhin khyer ba la/ sngags kyi 'od zer me'i spu gri dkar po g.yon phyogs su 'khor bas/ gdon bgegs rnams la la brgyal/ kha cig rengs par gyur/ la la mgar gyi sol mal du sbur ba shor ba bzhin btul btul tshig par bsam/ srog bdag rgyal 'gong gi gnod pa'i cho 'phrul bar chad thams cad rang zhir 'gyur nges lags pas/ skal ldan snying gi bu rnams nyams len mdzad pa zhu/ sa skya pa gdod nas rang grol ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gzhan gyi don du bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //gur drag nyams len bsdus pa bzhugs/ byang chub bar du/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi/ sems bskyed rang nyid gu ru drag por gyur par bsam/ khro bos rol mtshams bcad/

/rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs yan lag bdun 'bul bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs snying gar thim par bsam/ byin dbab gyur/ /de bzhin nyid/ ting 'dzin gsum las drag po'i/ gzhal yas srung 'khor lha rnams gsal/ /sku gsung thugs go cha'i lha so so las 'od 'phros pas/ yon tan 'phrin las lha rnams spyan drangs/ thim pas/ /rang nyid/ ye shes pa/ dngos su/ gyur cing / rdo rje gsum dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan 'phrin las/ sogs dbang thob gyur/ /me khro bo yak+ṣa/ dbal spros shing rang nyid lhar gsal ba la/ mchod bstod snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi bar byas/ bzlas pas gu ru'i/ byin rlabs rang la/ zhugs/ par bsam la sngags bzla zhing mjug tu dge ba bsngo/ /'di yang ngag dbang kun dgas bris// ༈ //sa paṇa dang 'jam dbyangs sbags sgrub chos rgyal ma'i 'don thabs bzhugs/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir lam bzang bsgom/ /spyi swa bha wa sogs/ bor 'jam phyag gnyis kyi chos 'chad kyis pad+ma'i yu ba bzung nas snyan gyi thad kar/ 'jam dbyangs pad+ma stong ldan pa dang bcas pa'i gdan la/ sa paṇa pod ral 'dzin/ /gnas oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum byin rlabs de'i 'od zer gyis/ ye shes mngon sum thim/ /gsol gang drin ma dang chos rgyal ma tshar gang mang gis/ 'debs lus nang drang por rtsa dbu ma/ /phyi dkar nang dmar sbom 'phra sba lcag tsam/ tshangs bug gi dbu ma'i nang du spyi bo'i gdan pad+ma stong ldan gyi yu ba zug pa/ /dbang bzhi sa paṇa gyi gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las 'od zer dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar dmar sngo gsum 'dres pa dang bcas pa babs rang gi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bsam pa la thim pas/
