lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag cing dbang bzhi rim par thob par bsgom/ bskur nas sa paṇa snying gar byon/ /rang sems lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i snying gar pad+ma stong ldan ze'u 'bru'i steng gi gdan la/ sa paṇa bzhugs pa'i/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ par bsam la spros bral ngang du bzhag /dge 'dis sa paṇa 'dzum zhal mthong bar shog / slob ma la byed na mchod gshom drung du rang gi bsgom rjes maṇ+ḍal/ kun mkhyen ye shes/ rgyun bshags/ gtso bos/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs mdzad/ yang 'di la brten nas 'jam dbyangs la bsnyen pa byed na/ spyi bo'i sa paṇa gyi thugs kar zla gdan la dhiḥyig dmar ser gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs nas a rā pa tsa na bzla/ mjug tu bstod pa gsol ba btab/ dbang bzhi len pa/ dge ba bsngo ba/ nyin mo spyi bo'i gtsug dang / mtshan mo snying khar pad zla'i gdan la 'od sna lnga'i gur khang du bzhugs par mos la mos gus 'du 'bral med par byas na/ bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing byin rlabs 'jug par gsung ngo / /zhes pa 'di yang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi blo mtsho las so/ /mastu sarba dza ga tam̐// ༈ //slob dpon rin po che'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus pa bzhugs/ byang chub bar du/ dkon mchog la skyabs ma gyur 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi/ sems bskyed rgya/ mtsho chen po'i/ nang rang gi gnas khang dag pa'i zhing khams su gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar/ pad sdong yid du 'ong ba'i/ steng / /rang gi rtsa ba'i/ bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i/ pad+ma 'byung gnas sku blta bas chog mi shes pa/ ā tsar+ya gzhon nu'i tshul/ /dbu la sha ba'i/ mnyen zhu ste rgod sgro'i rtse rgyan dngul gyi me long gser gyi nyi zla rdo rje rtse lnga pas mdzes shing dar sna lnga'i phod can/

gsol zhing rdo rje thod pa 'dzin/ /rdo sems gsang gos te gos mthing nag gi phod kha dang gru mo g.yon par/ kha ṭ+wam̐ ngur smrig chos gos bsnams/ /bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang / yi dam chos bka' brgyad sogs dang / skyong nor lha mang po/ mkha' 'gro pho mos bskor/ /mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bsam pa'i/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbu rgyan gnas nas ye shes thim/ spyan drangs la/ /rang nyid rjes 'dzin zhal bzhes gu ru'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyed kyi 'di phyi bar do'i skyabs gnas dang mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad ngas stsol par byed do gsung lhang lhang yod par bsam la/ lus dang longs spyod dbul/ thams cad ltos pa med par/ /gsol ba snying nas 'debs so gu ru'i thugs ka nas/ /sngags phreng rang sgra 'u ru ru/ sgrog pa 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sna la 'phro bzhin pa dang / bcas/ /byung ba rang la rang gi spyi bo snying kha sogs pa nas sib sib/ thim pas gu ru'i/ thugs dang rang gi yid gcig tu 'dres/ pas bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la skyes par bsam la/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes brgya stong la sogs pa bzla zhing spro na bde bar gshegs pa sogs gzhan dang rigs 'gre sbyar la brjod cing phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug pa la kha rlangs phog pa byas nas mgo thog tu bzhag slar yang gsol 'debs brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam bka' brgyad chos srung nor lha sogs/ mdun bskyed kun zhu pad 'byung thim/ /gu ru rin po che 'od kha dog lnga ldan du ltem zhu ba/ de nyid rang thim dbang thob bzhi po yongs rdzogs nas/ sku lnga mngon du gyur/ par bsam la rang sems gsal stong dbyer med chos sku bde ba chen po'i ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du bzhag la dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o/

/zhes slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus pa 'di yang chos med snyom las mkhan za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gi kha don du sug bris bgyis pa 'dis bdag cag dpon slob 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid la re ba ji lta ba bzhin 'bad med 'grub par gyur cig/ ༈ //tshe sgrub nye brgyud kyi nyams len snying po bsdus pa bzhugs/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir tshe sgrub bsgom/ /baiḍūr sa gzhir rma bya'i khri steng du/ /rang nyid tshe dpag med mgon gsal bar gyur/ /spyi bor rtsa brgyud bla ma rta mgrin dang / /'od dpag med rnams 'og ma'i spyi bo ru/ /gong ma bzhugs pa'i 'od kyis ye shes thim/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hriḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su skyong / /tshe dpag med mgon 'gro la 'chi med ster/ /rta mgrin dbang rgyal 'gro ba'i bar chad sel/ /pad ma 'byung gnas snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /thang stong rgyal por gsol btab bslu ba med/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ /byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /rang gi bla tshe nyams pa thams cad dang / /rgyu 'bras 'byung ba las gyur snod dang bcud/ /'khor 'das kyis bsdus tshe dpal bsod nams dang / /mkhyen brtse nus gsum thams cad spyan drangs nas/ /spyi bo'i lha tshogs la thim de rnams kyi/ /sku las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa/ /rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus gang bas/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib 'chi ba'i las ngan dag /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi puṇ+ya dzā na a yu sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes brgya rtsa sogs bzlas la/ spyi bo'i lha tshogs rang la thim par gyur/ /'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing /

/rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang / /srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang legs pa/ /de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig 'grogs/ /sku tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan/ /skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis shog /ces sogs bkra shis mang du brjod/ thams cad dge zhing bkra shis/ zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dgas rang gzhan gyi don du smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //khyung khra'i bsgom bzlas snying po ni/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir lam bzang bsgom/ /klu shu n+ya ta brjod/ brgyad ngo bo sbrul brgyad gdan steng du/ /rang nyid mkha' lding g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs can/ /phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin klu yi gtsug nor 'dzin/ /g.yon pa mgo bo/ rkang lag mgul rgyan dang / do shal rnams sbrul gyis byas pa/ sdigs mdzub me phung dbus na bzhugs/ /de yi mgrin par khyung chen rigs lnga yi/ /thugs kar k+ṣi oṃ swa pa hā dang bcas/ /ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ thim dbang bskur rgya yis btab/ don yod grub pa'i/ /lha tshogs 'od kyis don byas tshur 'dus shing / /lus kyi phyi nang ye shes me 'bar bas/ /nad gdod khyad par sa bdag klu gnyan gyis/ /gnod pa thams cad bsregs shing bcom par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ /oṃ pak+ṣi swāhā/ dge 'dis klu nad thams cad zhi bar shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ /rang nyid khyung khra'i sgom don snying po gda'o/ /rdo rje nam mkha' lding / /ser gzhan nas sked pa man/ dkar bar nas lte ba yan chad/ dmar lte ba nas mgrin pa yan chad/ nag de nas mgrin pa man chad/ ljang 'od de yan chad sna tshogs pa/ 'phro/ /oṃ pak+ṣi swāhā// ༈ //gur drag sgom don snying po ni/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir gu drag bsgom/ /rang nyid lhar gu ru drag po/ gsal khro bos nam mkha' gang / bar bsam ste mtshams bcad/

/tshogs zhing snying kha'i 'od kyis/ spyan drangs yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ /rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis/ bde gshegs byin rlabs rang thim chos kun dang / /rang sems spros bral snying rje'i ldang can de/ /gzugs rnams hūm̐ yig rgyu yi ting 'dzin las/ /sa bon e yam̐ ra su kam̐ ram̐ bh+rūm̐/ chad pas 'byung bzhi keng rus kyi/ /ri rab steng du drag po'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i/ gzhal yas khang / /nang du 'khor lo rtsibs sngon po/ bzhi chos 'byung zla gam dmar nag gsum dang / bcas/ /phyi rol gzhal yas khang gi 'khor lo ser po sdig pa yis/ /mtshan pa g.yas su 'khor zhing me'i 'khor lo/ /g.yon du 'khor ba'i bar du rtse bsnol/ dgra bgegs 'joms/ /rdo rje'i de'i rgyab/ gur khang me phung 'bar ba'i nang / dang bcas/ /pad nyi zla ba srin po pho mo'i steng / /hūm̐ dmar 'od zer spro don gnyis byas/ bsdus gyur pa las/ /bdag nyid zil gnon pad+ma sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse dgu sdig pa/ phyag mtshan rgyan cha dpal gyi chas brgyad sogs/ lugs/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i spyi gtsug mdzod spu khro gnyer steng 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bzhi'i dbus/ dang / /mgrin pa ra pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi dang / /snying kha ra mchod rten ser po bang rim bum pa bre sogs dang bcas pa'i nang du/ rnams su rim bzhin du/ /snang mtha' bya khyung 'jam dpal rta mgrin dang / /phyag rdor gsal zhing de rnams 'od zer gyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs nas rang gi go cha'i lha so so la/ thim/ /slar yang yi ge gsum las 'od zer 'phros pa'i/ 'od kyis snang mtha' rigs lnga sogs/ /spyan drangs nas rang gi spyi gtsug gi snang ba mtha' yas/ thim zhing rig pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ dmar las/ /'od zer nag po grangs med pa/

hūm̐ nag grangs med 'phros/ /de rnams 'od du/ zhu bas la/ yak+sha me dbal gyi skur/ gyur/ /de 'dra'i khro bos gnod byed kun tshar bcad/ /ye shes pa thim phyi nang mchod cing bstod/ /snying khar nyi steng hūm̐ yig sngags phreng bskor/ /de las 'od 'phros nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi/ /gu ru'i byin rlabs rang la zhugs par gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ dge 'dis pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal mthong shog /bsnyen tshad 'bum gyis mchog gi dngos grub 'grub pa dang / khri tshos dregs pa sde brgyad thul ba dang / thos pa dang dran pas 'jig rten lha srin rnams las la bskul nus par bshad do/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //tshe dpag med mda' 'phen ma'i sgom bzlas snying po 'chi med dpal 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir tshe sgrub bsgom/ /rdo rje'i lte bar bum pa pho brang che/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi lcags ri bcas pa'i nang / /pad nyi zla gdan steng du a yig las/ /rang nyid tshe dpag med mgon yab yum dmar/ /phyogs bzhir pad zlar rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro rnams/ /mthing ser pad rag in+ḍa bum pa 'dzin/ /mtshams bzhi'i 'dab mar sgeg phreng glu gar rnams/ /sngo ser dmar ljang bum 'dzin gtso bor lta/ /gzhan yang me tog bdug spos mar me dang / /mchod yon 'dzin pa'i mchod pa'i lha mos bskor/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang sgo skyong bzhi/ /sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang gar stabs bzhugs/ /gtso 'khor thams cad sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal bar gyur/ /rang nyid yab yum gnyis med thugs ka ru/ /pad+ma snying gi ze'u 'brur tshe'i ngo bo/ /a dkar 'od 'tsher tshe yi snying pos bskor/ /rlung ro lan gsum bus pas dug gsum dag /'dir rlung bus shing bzlas/ snying khar steng 'og rlung gnyis kha sbyar bzung /

/snying kha'i pad+ma kha bye a 'od kyis/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes gu ru tshe dpag med/ /rigs kyi lhar bcas mngon sum byon pa la/ /yan lag bdun 'bul 'chi med thob par mdzod/ /gu ru'i phyag gi bum pa'i tshe chu'i rgyun/ /tshe dpag med mgon phyag gi bum par babs/ /de nyid bdag gi tshangs bug nas babs te/ /ye shes pa 'dres bla mas dbu brgyan gyur/ /lha dang sngags kyi 'od kyis mchod yul gyi/ /thugs rje byin rlabs khams gsum sems can gyi/ /tshe dpal bsdus nas rang la thim pa'i mthus/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra rat+na a yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ tshe bh+rūm̐/ ga phu bh+rūm̐/ ṇi bh+rūm̐/ ban+dha bh+rūm̐/ a yu dz+nyā na bh+rūm̐/ am̐ a ma rat+na dzi win+ti sid+dhiḥpha la hūm̐/ci mang bgrangs/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ snod bcud rten dang brten pa rang la thim/ /de nyid ar thim de yang 'od gsal ngang / /slar yang rang nyid tshe dpag med mgon gyur/ /bcom ldan tshe dpag med kyi phyogs skyong dang / /bstan ma pad 'byung man+dha ra ba yi/ /phyag nas tshe khug tshe mda' la ring thung gi mtho tshad gzung / rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /sngo ser dmar ljang rang 'khor 'bum bcas pa/ /tshe bum thogs pas rigs bzhi'i tshe khug cig /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i tshe dang nyes skyon gyis/ /ma gos tshe dang mi 'gyur brtan pa'i tshe/ /las kun ma lus 'grub pa'i tshe khug cig 'dir gzungs lan ci rigs bzlas rjes tshe mda' la sngags 'debs pa dang mtho tshad btab/ /'ja' lus bum dbang ye shes gsang dbang dang / /bde chen thig le'i shes dbang rig pa yi/ /stsal dbang bskur gsol rigs lnga spyi gtsug byon/ /dbang bskur rigs lnga'i tshe yi dngos grub thob/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ ci mang bgrangs bar bya/ spyi bor tshe dpag med mgon tshon gang pa/ /de yi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/

/tshe dang ye shes hūm̐ yig dkar dmar du/ /byung nas tshe dpag med thim de 'od zhu/ /tshangs bug nas zhugs snying gar rigs lngar gyur/ /de rnams 'od zhu lus kyi nang khyab pas/ /'chi med tshe yi rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ a ma rat+ni dzi win+ti sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ de ltar tshe dpag med mgon mda' 'phel ma/ /bsgom bzlas bgyis pas dpon slob tshe ring ba'i/ /mthar thug gyur nas don gnyis kun 'grub shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //tshe sgrub zab mo mda' 'phel ma'i sgrub thabs dang dbang bskur bya tshul 'chi med lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru badz+ra ā tsar+ya sa pa ri wa ra ye/ 'dir u rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po la dngos su gnang ba'i tshe dbang nye brgyud kyi phyag len ni/ lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon ma'am/ yang na maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon nam 'bras sogs kyi/ yang tshom bu tsam mdzad pa'i phyag len yang snang / ras bris bkram la/ de'i mthar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis bskor/ mdun ngos su zlum gtor dmar po gcig mdun nam g.yas gang bder tshe ril dang tshe chang / tshe mda' mda' gtsang ma mi rta khyi gsum ma bsad pa/ bla ma la tshigs gsum yod pa dar sna lnga'i kha dog sna lnga tshang ba'i mda' dar dgos gsungs/ gtsang ma spos kyis bdugs pa la dar dmar dang g.yu tshe dpag med kyi bla rdo dang me long chung ngu re 'dogs pa'i phyag len yang 'dug btags pa dkyil 'khor gyi steng du man dz+nya khar bum pa dri bzang gi chus gang ba kha rgyan dang stabs gang bder/ gzungs thag mdzad pa'i phyag len yang 'dug cing / dang rin chen sna bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang bcas pa bsham/ yang sgrub thabs rkyang pa bsgom pa tsam la dkyil 'khor bum pa tshe mda' sogs ma bshams kyang rung ba tsam dang / tshe sgrub rgyas par byed na rang don gzhan don gnyis ka la dkyil 'khor bum pa tshe mda' sogs ji ltar bshad pa'i yo byad rnams tshang bar bsham par bya'o/

/rdor gzungs mi gzungs thag de bum pa tshe ril tshe chang tshe mda' rnams la bskor nas bzlas pa'i dus su slob dpon gyi thugs kar 'dzin/ dbang bskur dus dpon slob kun gyis gzungs thag nas 'dzin pa mdzad/ dgos/ de nas slob dpon rang nyid stan la 'khod nas/ mchod pa byin rlabs tshe dpag med lha dgu bzhin bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang nyid mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bum pa gsum ka la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gsum ka tha mi dad du bsgrub pa ni/ skad cig tsam gyis rdo rje ra 'dir skabs kyi bsgom don la/ gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa yar rtse srid rtser sleb pa/ mas rwa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa/ yang na dma' na rag dmyal ba'i gnas la zug pa/ lte ba shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum tsam gyi nang du/ maṇ+ḍal bum pa pho brang gzhal yas khang / /zhes pas gzhal yas khang sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su bdag cag dpon slob rnams dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor tshe rdzas thams cad ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i lha tshogs su bskyed pa ni gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal bar bsgom mo/ /ba'i nang / /maṇ+ḍal bum pa pho brang gzhal yas khang / /'dab brgyad gru bzhi sgo bzhi lcags rir bcas/ /pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /de yi dbus su rang byung a gcig bsam/ /de las 'od 'phros 'khor 'das bcud bsdus nas/ /tshur 'dus a las rang nyid tshe dpag med/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar la dwangs/ /gser dngul rin chen mu tig phreng bas brgyan/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bza'i sham thabs gsol/ /phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams/ /de nyid pang na gnyis med gsang ba yum/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar mo bum pa 'dzin/ /rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo yab dang mtshungs/

/de yi shar sogs pad nyi zla steng du/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro rin chen mkha' 'gro dang / /pad+ma mkha' 'gro las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams/ /mthing gi bum pa gser gyi bum pa dang / /pad+ma ra ga in+d+ra ni la yi/ /bum pa rim bzhin tshe yis gang ba 'dzin/ /mtshams bzhir 'dab mar sgeg phreng glu gar rnams/ /sngo ser dmar ljang mdzes ldan bum pa bsnams/ /nang du zhal gzigs gtso mo'i zhal la lta/ /gru chad bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi/ /me tog bdug pa snang gsal mchod yon bsnams/ /dkar ser dmar ljang gar stabs tshul gyis bzhugs/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /dkar ser dmar ljang sgeg pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /de ltar lha rnams snang stong rang bzhin med/ /gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal bar gyur/ /gtso bo yab yum gnyis med thugs ka ru/ /pad+ma snying gi ze 'bru lta bu'i steng / /tshe yi ngo bo dkar la 'tsher ba la/ /yi ge āḥni dkar pos mtshan par gyur/ /de la tshe yi snying po 'od dang ldan/ /me tog phreng ba lta bus bskor bar bzhugs/ /zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas rlung ro lan gsum phyi la sangs kyis bus/ /dug gsum rtog pa ma lus sangs kyis dag /steng 'og rlung gnyis snying khar kha sbyar bzung / /zhes brjod/ 'dir dbang bsgrub dus slob dpon rkyang pa dang / dbang bskur dus dpon slob thams cad kyis sna bug g.yas nas rlung thengs gcig bus pas nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi rtog pa thams cad sngo bun bun thon par bsam/ g.yon nas thengs gcig bus pas nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi rtog pa thams cad dmar bun bun thon par bsam/ dbus nas thengs gcig bus pas nyon mongs pa gti mug gi rtog pa thams cad nag bun bun thon par bsam/ de ltar lan gsum bus rjes bum pa can snying gar thengs gcig bzung la/ ngag tu/ snying kha'i pad+ma kha bye nas āḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba'i yul mahā gu ru u rgyan pad+ma rigs bdag tu bzhugs pa'i pad+ma'i rigs kyi lha tshe dpag med lha bcu bdun la phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ye shes kyi spyan ldan sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa ltar byon par bsam la/

snying kha'i rnam shes pad+ma kha bye nas/ /a las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar rang 'dra'i ye shes pa/ /mahā gu ru tshe dpag med pa yi/ /rigs kyi lha tshogs thams cad byon par gyur/ /de la yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ mahā gu ru u rgyan pad+ma dang / /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa yi/ /rigs kyi lha tshogs 'khor bcas thams cad la/ /kun nas bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su bshams dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho rnams/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho ltar/ /bdag gis ma lus kun la dbul bar bgyi/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nyid nas/ /da lta'i dus kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /phra rags sbom gsum sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /bdag nyid gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas bshags/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan dpag med dang / /sems can kun gyi dad dang brtson 'grus kyi/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthar thug pa/ /dge ba kun la'ang bdag ni rjes yi rang / /dus gsum 'gyur med rdo rje tshe yi lha/ /kun la khyab pa byams chen thugs rje'i dpal/ /byin rlabs chen po'i sku gsum 'phrin las kyis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bdag gis bskul/ /sku gsum 'phrin las rgyun chad med pa ru/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong bar/ /mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /bcom ldan khyed la phyag 'tshal mchod sogs pa'i/ /'gro kun dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed pa/ /rnam mkhyen kun mkhyen go 'phang thob bya'i phyir/ /bla med byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi/ /zhes pa lan gsum mam gcig brjod la/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ nam mkhar byon pa rnams la dmigs nas/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa yi/ /rigs kyi lha tshogs 'khor bcas thams cad kyis/

/bsgrub mchog bdag la dbang dang byin rlabs pa'i/ /rdo rje tshe mchog dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ gu ru'i bum pa nas tshe dpag med kyi bum par bdud rtsi babs/ de nyid bdag gi tshangs pa'i bu ka na mar babs te tshe dpag med rigs lnga bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi spyi gtsug tu byon nas dbang bskur zhing / dam tshig sems dpa' so so'i lha tshogs la/ /ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug gnyis med bstims/ /gnyis med dgyes pa lha yi spyi gtsug tu/ /mahā gu ru rigs kyi bdag por gyur/ /de ltar bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi lha tshogs kun gsal bar bsgom pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kha'i āḥ'i 'od zer las snying po'i sngags kyi 'khor lo rang sgra sgrog bzhin pa byung pa las/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs dang / khams gsum gyi sems can ma lus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba rnams bsdus nas rang la thim pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam zhing / de ltar lha tshogs gsal bar bsgom pa yi/ /gtso bo'i thugs kha'i āḥyig 'od zer las/ /snying po'i sngags 'khor rang sgra byung ba las/ /yab yum zhal nas snying po'i sngags 'di bzlas/ zhes brjod cing sngags kyi rang sgra la dmigs pa gtad nas sngags ci mang bzla/ de nas lha dang sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs bcud dang / /khams gsum sems can kun gyi tshe dpal rnams/ /bsdus nas tshur 'dus rang la thim pa yis/ /'chi med ye shes tshe yi ngo bor gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam/ 'phro 'du la dmigs pa gtad nas yang sngags ci mang bzla/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra rat+na ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rum̐/ tshe bh+rum̐/ g.yu bh+rum̐/ ṇi bh+rum̐/ ban+dha hūm̐/ ā yu dz+nyā na bh+rum̐/ oṃ a ma ra ṇa dzī wan+ti sid+dha pha la hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags ci nus su bzlas/

de nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ snod bcud srung 'khor gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha rnams dang bcas pa rang gtso bo yab yum la thim/ yum yang yab la thim/ yab thugs kha'i a la thim/ āḥyang nam mkhar du ba yal ba bzhin chos sku skye ba med pa ma bcos spros bral 'od gsal chen por thim/ a 'khor 'das snod bcud a yig 'od gsal thim/ /ni skye ba med pa chos kyi sku gsung thugs/ /ma bcos spros bral 'od gsal chen por bzhag /zhes brjod cing de'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par gzhag slar yang chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyis rang nyid tshe dpag med gtso 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur/ sgrub thabs rkyang pa bsgom na/ skabs 'dir/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas/ /zhes sogs kyi bsngo ba dang / 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /sogs kyi bkra shis byas la spyod lam la 'jug go /dbang bsgrub dang 'brel dus gong bzhin gyi rdzogs rim bsgom pa'am/ yang na dkyil 'khor bsdu ba sogs mi byed par bzlas pa grub 'phral/ sems ma bcos pa spros bral 'od gsal chen po'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par gzhag pa tsam byas la/ de nas tshe gzungs mang du bzlas shing / mda' la phu btab la tshe 'gugs la 'jug go /lugs phyi ma 'di la ni/ spros bral gyi ngang las rang nyid tshe dpag med rten dang brten par bcas pa'i skur lang pa dang / slar yang dbang lha spyan 'dren pa sogs bya mi dgos pa'i rnam dbye la mkhas par bya'o/ /de ltar rang nyid bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi thugs kha'i āḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar mahā gu ru tshe dpag med kyi ye shes kyi lha tshogs thams cad byon par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ tshe mda' la slob dpon rang nyid kyi mtho tshad bzung zhing / gong gi tshe gzungs brgya stong la sogs pa bzlas la mda' la phu btab cing /

tshe 'gugs pa ni/ mda' dar bzung la g.yob yang dbang bsgrub skabs 'dir mda' dar la tho reg mi gtong ba de ka la bzhag nas tshe 'gugs mdzad pa'i phyag len yang snang / bzhin pa dang bcas/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas tshe khug cig /khug cig khug cig tshe khug cig /stsol zhig stsol zhig tshe stsol zhig /ye shes tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /shar lho me lha'i lag nas tshe khug cig /gsham bu gong dang 'dra/ bcom ldan mgon po༞ lho phyogs gshin rje'i༞༞༞ bcom ldan mgon po༞ lho nub srin po'i༞༞ bcom ldan mgon po༞ nub phyogs chu lha'i༞༞༞ bcom ldan mgon po༞ nub byang rlung lha'i༞༞༞ bcom ldan mgon po༞ byang phyogs gnod sbyin༞༞༞ bcom ldan mgon po༞ byang shar dbang ldan༞༞༞ dbang po brgya byin lag nas༞༞༞ lha mo brtan ma'i lag nas༞༞༞ u rgyan pad+ma'i lag nas༞༞༞ man+da ra ba'i lag nas༞༞༞ shar rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /sku mdog ser mo mdangs dang ldan/ /phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams/ /'khor du sngon mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ /rdo rje rigs kyi tshe khug cig /lho rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /sku mdog sngon mo mdangs dang ldan/ /phyag na tshe yi༞ 'khor du ser mo༞ bcu drug lon pa'i༞ rin chen rigs kyi༞ gsham du gong gis 'gre'o/ /nub pad+ma rigs kyi༞ sku mdog dmar mo༞ phyag na tshe yi༞ 'khor du dmar mo༞ bcu drug lon pa'i༞ pad+ma rigs kyi༞ byang las kyi rigs kyi༞ sku mdog ljang ku༞ phyag na tshe yi༞ 'khor du ljang khu༞ bcu drug lon pa'i༞ las kyi rigs kyi༞ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i tshe khug cig /skyon gyis ma gos tshe khug cig /mi 'gyur brtan pa'i tshe khug cig /las kun 'grub pa'i tshe khug cig /ces brjod cing / 'dir yang gzungs lan mang du bzlas la tshe mda' la phu btab cing /

slob dpon rang gi mtho tshad brtags pas/ sngar las sor gang sogs chad na ngan zhing / sor bzhi lnga sogs lhag na mda' 'phel ba bzhin tshe 'phel ba'i rtags yin pas bzang ngo / /de nas dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ 'ja' lus bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ /ye shes rlung gi gsang dbang bskur du gsol/ /bde chen thig le'i sher dbang bskur du gsol/ /mngon sum rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyi gsol ba gdab la/ man+dza'i kha'i bum pa blangs la/ spyi bo/ dpral ba/ rna ltag g.yas/ ltag pa/ rna ltag g.yon rnams su reg cing / ngag tu/ tshe dpag med rigs lnga rnams rim pa bzhin rang gi spyi gtsug tu byon nas dbang bskur bar gyur/ nga ni sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mgrin gcig tu/ /lus la sangs rgyas tshe dbang bskur/ /bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol nas/ /bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel zhing / /srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bum chu 'og slob mar dbang bskur gyi tshe/ de ltar dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas nyon mongs pa gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te sems can gyi srog bcad pa la sogs pa'i sku tshe thung bar gyur pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs shing dag nas rnam snang tshe dpag med kyi tshe'i dngos grub thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /khar blud pas/ gti mug las gyur pa'i srog bcad pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag rnam snang gi tshe'i dngos grub thob/ de bzhin du/ nga ni mi bskyod tshe dpag med/ /ces sogs 'don pa bsgyur la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bum chu khar blud pa rigs 'gre/ zhe sdang las gyur pa'i srog bcad pa'i sdig sgrib dag

mi bskyod pa'i tshe'i dngos grub thob/ nga ni rin 'byung tshe dpag med/ /oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ ser sna las gyur pa'i srog bcad pa'i sdig sgrib dag rin 'byung gi tshe'i dngos grub thob/ nga ni pad+ma tshe dpag med/ /oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ 'dod chags las gyur pa'i srog bcad pa'i sdig sgrib dag 'od dpag med kyi tshe'i dngos grub thob/ nga ni don yod tshe dpag med/ /oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ bum chu khar blud/ phrag dog las gyur pa'i srog bcad pa'i sdig sgrib dag don yod grub pa'i tshe yi dngos grub thob/ ces rigs lnga'i dbang bskur/ de nas spyi bor tshe dpag med tshon gang pa gcig gsal btab nas/ de las 'od 'phros dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad hūm̐ yig dkar dmar gyi rnam par spyan drangs de nyid la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od du zhu nas spyi bo tshangs bug na mar zhugs snying gar 'og slob ma dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ 'dir skabs kyi dmigs pa ni/ rang rang gi snying ga'i nang du dbus su rnam snang tshe dpag med shar du mi bskyod pa/ lhor rin 'byung / nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa tshe dpag med rnams kyi skur gyur pa/ slar yang tshe dpag med rnams 'od du zhu nas lus thams cad la khyab/ 'chi med tshe'i rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa'i tshe chu de nyid gyen du 'phyur bas slob ma rnams kyi smin mtshams yan chad gang bas bum dbang / mgrin pa yan chad gang bas gsang dbang / snying kha yan chad gang bas sher dbang / gsang gnas/ rkang mthil yan chad gang bas tshig dbang dang / rig pa rtsal dbang thob pa'i mos pa dang / khyed rang ye shes tshe dpag med kyi ngo bor gyur pa de nyid brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ nga ni ye shes tshe dpag med/ /ces sogs brjod/ rigs lnga tshe dpag med kyi skur gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas lus thams cad la khyab pas 'chi med tshe'i rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur par bsam nas/

nga ni ye shes tshe dpag med/ /kun du nyes pa spang bar bya/ /'chi bdag chen po nga yis bcom/ /bu khyod tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ a ma ra ṇa dzi wan+ti sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ de nas mthar rten du rgyal srid sna bdun dang / bkra shis 'di gnyis kyi dbang tshig bsdus pas 'don na/ rten 'brel phun tshogs rdzas brgyad rin chen bdun/ /snang srid longs spyod mchod sprin dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ mahā sarba rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas len no/ /rdzas brgyad kyi dbang tshe dpag med lha dgu bzhin blangs la/ de yan bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi ngang nas byed pa yin/ de nas rang nyid tshe dpag med du gsal ba mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas bye la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlab la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro mthar oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā nā sa pa ri wā ra/ i dam̐ bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis mdun bskyed la phul/ mchod bstod 'dod gsol bya/ slob ma rnams bos nas gral la 'khod pa la/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes sogs kyi sems bskyed du gzhug gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis las/ rnying ma yin/ de la bka' ma/ gter ma/ zhal gzigs kyi chos dang gsum du yod pa las/ 'dir zhal gzigs nas brgyud pa'i chos yin/ de yang bod khams sems can 'di rnams kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen gcig pur gyur pa ni u rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas yin la/ de nyid kyis skal ldan gyi slob ma ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po nyid la dngos su gnang ba'i tshe dbang nye brgyud khyad par du 'phags pa yin la/ 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi nye gnas rje ras chen dpal 'byor bzang pos tsa ri zil chen phug dang / gnas chen za phu la sogs pa rnams su sgrub pa lo 'ga' mdzad pa la/

gsang sngags phyi nang gi yi dam gyi lha mang pos zhal gzigs/ khyad par 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rang zhal sgrib med du bstan nas tshe dbang khyad par can 'di gnang zhing / de nas rim par brgyud de/ da lta'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad pa yin no/ /de la slob dpon gyi bya bar 'os pa rnams da tshod nas grub zin/ slob ma la bya ba'i ngo skal du gyur pa ni/ da ltar gyi slob dpon 'di nyid mgon po tshe dpag med yab yum du gsal ba la tshe dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ do phul tshar ba dang / slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di gsung ba zhu/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis gsol ba btab/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin gnang ba zhu/ gnas khang 'di nyid ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ tshe dpag med lha bcu bdun ma'i lha tshogs la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i mahā gu ru ste u rgyan pad+ma'i rigs bdag dang bcas pa'i mtha' skor phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mtshams rnams dang / 'og gi cha la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad rang re rnams la dbang skur bar byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs rnams tshar gcod pa'i phyir hūm̐ phaṭ kyi sgra sgrog pa sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa ltar gsal btab la/ de dag rnams kyi spyan sngar gus 'dud drag po'i sgo nas yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad pa zhu/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs yongs grags tshar gsum dang / 'di rang nas bshad pa/ mahā gu ru u rgyan pad+ma dang / /nas/ bla med byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi/

/zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes zlos byar gzhug de nas dbang bskur ba la yang dpon slob kun gyis thun mong du bsgrub pa dang / dmigs pa 'di bzhin gnang ba zhu/ de yang / skad cig tsam gyis rdo rje chen po'i nang / /zhes pa nas/ 'di'i dug gsum rtog pa dag phyir rlung 'bud pa'i tshig bcad brjod pa'i rjes su dmigs pa spog nas dpon slob kun gyis rlung 'bud cing 'dzin/ yab yum zhal gyi snying po'i sngags 'di brjod/ /ces pa'i bar dang / de nas lha dang sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ /zhes pa nas/ 'chi med ye shes tshe yi ngo bor gyur/ /ces pa'i bar slob dpon gyi rjes zlos slob mas byas la/ tshar gcig brjod pas gsal btab la skabs 'dir gzungs thag slob dpon gyi thugs kar bzung zhing slob ma rnams kyi srin lag g.yon pa la snying gi rtsa gnas pas srin lag g.yon la brgyus nas 'dzin pa'i phyag len yang snang zhing / gzungs bzla ba yang dpon slob kun gyis mdzad pa'i lugs kyang 'dug gzungs gang 'grub bzlas/ tshe mda'i ltong nas mde'u'i bar la slob dpon gyis phu btab/ de bzhin slob ma rnams kyis kyang rim bzhin bya/ de nas slob ma rnams rim pa bzhin snyug ma'i rtsa ba nas ltong gi bar la lag pa'i mthos gdab la/ sor mtho'i tshad ji tsam byung ba de don la 'dzin du bcug bzlas pa grub pa dang rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni sems ma bcos pa spros bral 'od gsal chen po'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu zhes pa brda sprad la dpon slob kun gyis cung zad mnyam par gzhag yang gzungs gang grub bzlas la/ de nas slob dpon gyis mda' dar bzung la g.yob bzhin pa dang bcas bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas zhes pa nas/ las kun 'grub pa'i tshe khug cig /ces pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod la/ tshe khug cig ces pa'i tshe mda' dar g.yob/ de nas slob dpon gyis tshe sgrub kyi sngags de ci rigs bzlas rjes/

tshe mda' la sngags chus brdeg cing / de nas slob dpon gyis mda'i mde'u nas yar la mtho gdab pas/ snga ma las sor gang dang sor bzhi lnga/ rab tha las sogs pa 'phel ba 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du slob ma rnams kyis kyang tshe mda' la mtho tshad gzhal du bcug la/ tshe 'phel ba'i rtags gong du bshad pa bzhin ngo sprad/ de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi la/ thog mar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di gsung bar zhu/ 'ja' lus bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol/ /ye shes rlung gi gsang dbang bskur du gsol/ /bde chen thig le'i sher dbang bskur du gsol/ mngon sum rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyi gsol ba gdab la/ de nas slob dpon gyis man+dza'i kha'i bum pa blangs la/ slob ma'i spyi bo/ dpral ba/ rna ltag g.yas/ ltag pa/ rna ltag g.yon rnams su reg cing / khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa gnas rnams su tshe dpag med rigs lnga rim bzhin byon nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ tshe dpag med rigs lnga rnams rim bzhin khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug tu byon nas dbang bskur bar gyur/ 'dir skabs kyi dmigs pa ni/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas bye bar gyur pa'i skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnam snang tshe dpag med dkar po phyag na tshe bum thogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' gang ba byon nas de dag gis mgrin gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis/ nga ni rnam snang tshe dpag med/ /ces sogs skur tshig dang bcas pas dbang bskur bas lus kyi cha shas thams cad 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang bas khyed rang rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te sems can gyi srog bcad pa la sogs kyi sku tshe thung bar gyur pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs shing dag nas rnam snang tshe dpag med kyi tshe'i dngos grub thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/

nga ni sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mgrin gcig tu/ /lus la sangs rgyas tshe dbang bskur/ /bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol nas/ /bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel zhing / /srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing thog mar bum pa slob dpon rang gi spyi bor bzhag bum chu cung zad 'thung / de nas slob ma'i spyi bor bum pa bzhag cing bum chu sbyin pa'i phyag len yang 'dug slob ma'i khar bum chu byin la/ gti mug las gyur pa'i srog bcad pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag rnam snang gi tshe'i dngos grub thob/ de bzhin du/ nga ni mi bskyod tshe dpag med/ /ces sogs 'don pa bsgyur la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bum chu khar blud pa rigs 'gre/ zhe sdang las gyur pa'i srog bcad pa'i sdig sgrib dag mi bskyod pa'i tshe'i dngos grub thob/ nga ni rin 'byung tshe dpag med/ /oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ ser sna las gyur pa'i srog bcad pa'i sdig sgrib dag rin 'byung gi tshe'i dngos grub thob/ nga ni pad+ma tshe dpag med/ /oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ 'dod chags las gyur pa'i srog bcad pa'i sdig sgrib dag 'od dpag med kyi tshe'i dngos grub thob/ nga ni don yod tshe dpag med/ /oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ bum chu khar blud/ phrag dog las gyur pa'i srog bcad pa'i sdig sgrib dag don yod grub pa'i tshe'i dngos grub thob/ /ces rigs lnga'i dbang bskur/ de nas spyi bor tshe dpag med tshon gang pa gcig gsal btab nas/ de las 'od 'phros/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshe dang ye shes thams cad hūm̐ yig dkar dmar gyi rnam par spyan drangs de nyid la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od du zhu nas spyi bo tshangs bug nas mar zhugs/ snying khar rigs lnga tshe dpag med kyi skur gyur/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas lus thams cad la khyab pas 'chi med tshe'i rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur par bsam nas/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/

nga ni ye shes tshe dpag med/ /kun tu nyes pa spang bar bya/ /'chi bdag chen po nga yis bcom/ /bu khyod tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes/ /de nas rgyal srid sna bdun dang / bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnams tshe dbang lha dgu ma ltar bya zhing / de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a ma ra ṇa dzi wan+ti sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod cing / slob dpon gyi lag tu tshe bum thogs la/ slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag tshe ril dang tshe chang ster/ de nas gtso bos ji ltar/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ de rnams kyi sgo nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po la gnang ba'i tshe sgrub zab mo'i dbang bskur ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che ba mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo / /de nas slob dpon gyis yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskangs/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ras bris la brtan bzhugs bya/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar tshe sgrub zab mo mda' 'phel ma'i sgrub thabs dang dbang bskur bya tshul 'chi med lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang / dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi bran du gyur pa chos med rnal 'byor sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ chos kyi rje 'bum chen kun dga' dpal 'byor gyi drung du ji ltar thob pa bzhin bya lo zla ba bcu pa'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sa skyar skyes pa'i bsam 'grub lhas sbyin no/ /'dis kyang bdag gzhan thams cad tshe'i bar du gcod pa thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas/ 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//

༈ //thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /gzhan phyir bcu gcig zhal gyi lam bzang bsgom/ /oṃ swa bha wa sogs dang / oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na sogs dang / stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs/ pad 'dab brgyad pa dang zlar hriḥlas 'od 'phros 'dus pa las pad ser btso ma lta bu 'dab brgyad hriḥ yi ge'i mtshan pa las rang nyid bcu gcig zhal/ phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa/ thugs ka'i pad zla'i hri las 'od 'phros pas /ye shes pa rang la thim slar yang snying kha'i 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ snying khar zla gdan la rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang pa'i thugs kar sems dpa' hriḥdakar dmar gang rung la gzungs ring kha dog dkar pos bskor ba las sku mang po spros nas sems can de'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas byang sems gyi thugs rje byin rlabs bsdus/ dbang bskur bas 'od dpag med kyi bla mas rgya yis btab/ /ting 'dzin 'od kyis rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub/ /dge bas bdag cag dpon slob bde ba can bgrod shog /na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ na maḥ.ar+ya dz+nya na sa ga ra/ bai ro tsa na/ byu ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyaka sam bud+dha ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta te bh+yoḥ ar+ha te bh+ya/ samyaka sam bud+dhe bh+ya/ na maḥ.ar+ya a wa lo ke te shwa rā ya/ bo d+dhi satwa ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ i ṭ+wa bita tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su me ba te/ i li mi li tsi ti dz+wa la ma pa na ye swāhā/ 'di nyin re bzhin nam langs nas brgya rtsa re sogs ma chags pa ston pa'am/ bzlas na phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar gsungs/ dud 'gro 'chi ba'i rna ba la gzungs 'di lan bdun sogs btab na/

dud 'gro pho yin na bde ba can du skye zhing / dud 'gro mo yin na skyes pa pho lus thob nas byang chub sems kyi bag chags 'jog par gsungs/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //nang gi brag rdzong ma sgom tshul ni/ dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir srung 'khor bsgom/ /rang nyid nag po chen por gsal ba yis/ /tshogs zhing spyan drangs mchod cing bshags par bgyi/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i srung 'khor nang / /rang nyid gur mgon khro bcur gsal ba yi/ /spyi bo lte ba'i bar du rtsa dbu ma/ dmar po/ /snying khar dmar nag me 'phro ba/ brag rdzong lte bar khrag gi chos 'byung mtsho/ rba klong 'khrugs pa/ /de dag 'od kyis pho rgyud mo rgyud thim/ /brag rdzong lte bar babs pas rkyen byas nas/ /sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis dbus kyi mgon po'i mtshan par gyur/ /de yi 'od kyis gnyis med rgyud rnams thim/ /hūm̐ de nas rlung ro bus te hūm̐ yig la sems gtad cing rlung bum pa can bzung ba'i hūm̐ la sems gtad de/ ngag tu hūm̐ 'ba' zhig brjod kyang rung bar bshad pas/ 'og gi dmigs pa gsal 'debs grub pa'i rjes su bya'o/ /las me 'bar sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /chos 'byung rang gi lus kyi nang gang bas/ /nang gi dgra bgegs bar chad thams cad bsregs/ /de nas rim rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir thon te gnas khang lung pa sogs/ de nas rlung bum pa can bzung la hūm̐ 'ba' zhig brgya rtsa brgyad sogs brjod de/ bzhin srid gsum mer 'bar te/ /phyi yi de na/ dgra bgegs bar chad thams cad bsregs/ /srid gsum me 'od srung 'khor rang la thim/ /de nyid hūm̐ thim de yang 'od gsal thim/ /de yi ngang nas rang nyid mgon po'am/ /de yi ngo bo na bun lta bur gyur/ /dge 'dis gdon bgegs thams cad dbang 'dus shog /'di srod thun gyi rjes la bsgom na shin tu byin rlabs che bar gsungs shing /

shin tu zab pa'i lo rgyus rje mus chen gyi gsung las thos pas yid ches can gyi gdams pa yin no// ༈ //zab don nai gu chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ gnas 'og min chos kyi pho brang du/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bla ma rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud la byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas seng ldang 'khrigs pa'i nags tshal du/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bla ma rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud la byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas zhang zhong dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞༞ shangs lha bu rmog cog gi dgon pa ru/ /mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞༞ dbus stod lung skyer sgang gi dgon pa ru/ /dbon ston thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞༞ gnas yol bu ri gong gi dgon pa ru/ /gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞༞ gnas yol phu brag rtsa'i dgon pa ru/ /'gro mgron sangs rgyas ston pa la gsol ba 'debs/ ༞༞ shangs 'jag chung dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /mkhas grub gtsang ma shang ston la༞༞༞ mus mtha' gong dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang la༞༞༞ gnas gnyan khrod brgya rtsa'i dben gnas su/ /bla ma rdo rje bsod nams la༞༞༞ mus rdzang lung dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /mtshan ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la༞༞༞ byang rdo rje gdan gyi dgon pa ru/ /byang sems sbyin pa bzang po la༞༞༞ dpal ri bo che yi rtse mo ru/ /grub chen thang stong rgyal po la༞༞༞ gnas mang gar dgon gsar gyi dben gnas su/ /rgyud 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan la༞༞༞ gnas bul rong dben pa'i ri khrod du/ /mkhas grub dpal ldan dar po la༞༞༞ gnas zhig dgon dpal gyi ri khrod du/

/rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo la༞༞༞ gan bde stong mchog gi gzhal yas su/ /mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum pa la༞༞༞ gnas 'jig dben gnas dam pa ru/ /'jag chen byams pa dpal bzang la༞༞༞ rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i bzhugs gnas su/ /'jam dbyangs blo gros dpal bzang la༞༞༞ 'jag bde chen 'byung ba'i pho brang du/ /drin can bsod nams bzang po la༞༞༞ gnas dag pa rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /byams pa chos kyi nyi ma la༞༞༞ lo dga' ldan rtse yi bla brang du/ /spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags la༞༞༞ mus bde ba can gyi chos grwa ru/ /'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho la༞༞༞ gnas grub ri'i bsam gtan khang bu ru/ /skal bzang 'gyur med bde chen la༞༞༞ gnas bsam gtan phug gi dben gnas su/ /mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la༞༞༞ byang bla brang rjong gi bzhugs gnas su/ /mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags la༞༞༞ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du/ /sngags 'chang kun dga'i mtshan can la༞༞༞ gnas rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs la༞༞༞ gnas bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la༞༞༞ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog tu/ /chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la༞༞༞ sems dag pa'i mdun sa nges med du/ /mched lcam rdo rje'i spun grogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bla ma rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud la byin gyis rlobs/ /thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar du byin gyis rlobs/ /sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol du byin gyis rlobs/ /rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag tu byin gyis rlobs/ /'od gsal gti mug rang sangs su byin gyis rlobs/ /'pho ba ma bsgom sangs rgyas su byin gyis rlobs/ /bar do rgyal ba longs sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan ni gu ma/ /khyung po rnal 'byor brgyud pa rin chen bdun/ /la sogs bsgrub rgyud bstan pa mdzad pa yi/

/rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsa ba chos drug rkang 'thung lo ma'i nags/ /sdong po phyag chen 'khril shing mnyen lcug ldem/ /yal ga lam khyer lo 'dab gur khang mdzes/ /nyams len snying po longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar sna tshogs bkra/ /'bras bu mchi med dri ldan ro bcud smin/ /ni gu'i gser chos yongs 'du'i dpag bsam ljon/ /ci 'dod dngos grub long par byin gyis rlobs/ /a thung gtum mo'i me drod 'bar ba'i mes/ /bden snang bud shing sreg pa sgyu ma'i gar/ /nying 'khrul rang dag rmi lam grong khyer du/ /yul snang ngo mtshar lta bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khor yug 'od gsal 'byongs pa'i 'od lam nas/ /mkha' spyod 'pho ba'i khang bzang sgo phye ste/ /bar do'i 'grul thag chad pa thar pa'i lam/ /nyams len drod pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snang stong gsal stong bde stong zung 'jug rgya/ /gsum gyis bcing tshe 'khrul snang choms rkun nub/ /rang babs gsum ldan skyes bzhi las grol ba'i/ /phyag chen ye shes 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /cir snang bla ma yi dam sgyu ma yi/ /lam khyer rnam gsum btsan po'i go bgos pas/ /log 'dren bgegs kyi bar chad mtshon cha'i char/ /me tog char du 'bab par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' spyod dkar dmar gsum bsgril zung 'jug lam/ /mthar phyin mkha' spyod dbang mo'i lcags kyu yis/ /ma spangs lus 'di 'ja' ris mngon gyur te/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzung 'dzin shun pa bral ba rang gi sems/ /glo bur dri bral ston gnam zla ba ltar/ /rang sems 'chi med chos sku mngon gyur pa/ /stan thog 'di ru stsol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bar do'i 'phrang du grogs med shor srid na/ /skye gnas mngal sgo lha yi dkyil 'khor du/ /rang shar 'chug med rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /myur ba nyid du stsol bar byin gyis rlobs/

/las rlung 'gog byed btsan thabs rlung shugs kyis/ /ro rkyang nyi zla sgra can dhu ti'i khar/ /thims las ye shes rgyu skar rnam bkra'i gzugs/ /da lta nyid du stsol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phyag rgya bcing bkrol rlung gi sbyor ba yis/ /lus sems 'chi med 'khrul 'khor rnal 'byor las/ /myur mgyogs pho nyas 'ja' lus mngon gyur par/ /skad cig nyid la༞ /thugs rje che ldan nor bu pad+ma can/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med skur bzhengs nas/ /bar chad bdud dpung g.yul las rgyal ba yi/ /rnam dkar phyogs brgyar dar ba'i dge legs mdzod/ /ces pa zab don ni gu chos drug bla ma brgyud pa spyi la gsol ba 'debs pa dang lam rim smon lam du byas pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang / sa skya pa chos med sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis chos tshul 'di la snying nas dad pa'i dbang gi sprel lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes la bzhi thog bla brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis gzhung dang yi ge'i 'du byed la sbyangs pa shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ/ 'di skabs kyi yi ge pa bzang ldan pa nor bu bkra shis kyis bgyis pas rjes su 'dzin par shog /dge'o// ༈ //nai gu chos drug gi nyams len rnal 'byor gdeng thob bzhugs so/ /rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri sna tshogs pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po'i cha lugs su bsgom dgos pa ste/ dag byed a'i stong ra dang 'brel ba'i gnad kyis yin la/ thabs lam man phal cher sngon po bya'o/ /bzhugs la brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba la bdag gzhan sems can thams cad/ par skyabs su mchi/ /nai gu/ chos drug nyams su/ len par bgyi'o/ /'gro kun tshad med bzhi la 'god par gyur cig snyam pa'i bsam pas/

bkod/ /rtsa skabs 'gar brgyud 'debs gdangs dang bcas pa'ang bya/ brgyud bla mar gsol 'debs so bdag gi nad gdon 'byung ba'i rgyu/ sdig sgrib kun/ /dag nas nad gdon la sogs pa mi mthun bar chad thams cad/ ma lus zhi ba dang / /ting 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la/ skye zhing ting 'dzin dbang bskur bla ma rin po ches la bdag stsol/ /bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi gnas gsum du thim pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi/ dbang bskur bla ma thim pas sku bzhi thob/ / pa'am rtogs pa mngon du byas par bsam/ /rang gi thod pa dung khang gi nang gi klad pa mi dmigs pa chos 'byung gi rnam pa rtsa ba phra ba mgrin par zug cing zur gnyis rna ltag g.yas g.yon gyi gong tsam zur gcig smin mtshams su zug pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba stong seng nge ba'i nang du rang sems skye med kyi ngo bo/ a dkar rang sgrar sgrog bzhin pa dang / bcas/ /a yi bdud rtsis dkar la dwangs pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus kyi phyi nang kun bkrus nas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib rnams bshang gci'i lam dang ba spu'i bu ga nas nag bun thon par bsam la ngag tu a a zhes brgya stong sogs bzlas/ sbyangs/ spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po'i rnam par/ bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi lus la drod dang sems la/ bde stong skye bar mdzod cig bla ma thim/ /rang nyid mkha' spyod dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa thod skam rus pa'i rgyan can du gsal ba'i lus gnad tsog pu me thab drug bcing gi phyag rgya bcas pa'i/ lus khong stong / /dmar gsal rdza sol mes bsregs pa lta bu/ de yi lus kyi/ dbus su rtsa dbu ma/ dmar po sbom phra sba lcag 'bring po tsam/ /g.yas su ro ma dmar mo dang /

g.yon du rkyang mar bcas/ dkar mo gnyis gro sog 'bring po tsam/ /yas sna spyi bo 'i gtsug dang / mas sna lte bar zug pa'i/ /dbu ma'i yas sner ham̐ dkar po mgo thur bstan/ dang mas sne ru/ /nyi dkyil sran ma phyed bkas tsam gyi steng du ram̐ las byung ba'i/ me phung gla ba'i/ ril ma tsam/ dmar ril le ba dang sum mdor me dang bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can gsal btab nas rlung ro phyir song pa gcig bus la/ /'og rlung gyen du bskyod tsam byas pa'i/ rkyen gyis bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos sum mdo'i me sbar bas/ nyi ma dang / me ril ma tsam/ las/ /me lce phra mo gcig 'bar te/ dbu ma'i nang brgyud snying khar slebs/ /de yis ham̐ bzhu byang sems sor bdud rtsi'i rgyun thig thig byung nas rtsa dbu ma'i nang brgyud snying kha'i me'i rtse mor/ sgra bcas/ /snying khar babs pas lus la bde drod 'bar/ bar bsam la rlung bum pa can bzung gtum mo'i dmigs pa rgyun du 'di tsam gyis chog la yang dgun shin tu grang ba'i dus su lus gnad sngar bzhin la/ /yang ni rang nyid mkha' spyod mar gsal ba'i/ lus khong stong / /rdza gsar pa/ me la/ bsregs bzhin du dmar kha dog la tsha/ ba ste stong seng nge ba/ /de yi lte ba dang / lte ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi/ /mkhal khung gnyis/ rnams dang lte ba'i rgyab kyi rgal tshigs dang bcas pa'i gnas bzhi po de/ rnams su/ /me yi ril bu ngang pa'i sgo nga tsam/ drod kyi rang bzhin/ /'bar la khad par sems gtad bde drod 'bar/ bsam la rlung ro phyir song gi bus la rlung bum pa can ci thub bzung ngo / /rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/

bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag 'dzin blos thong dgos med rgyud la skye/ /sgyu lus rmi lam 'byong par mdzad du gsol/ /bla ma rang thim rang nyid lhag pa'i lha/ /bde mchog dkar po rdor dril thugs kar bsnol/ /rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de la sems cung zad gtad/ /rang nyid lhar gsal 'di dang phyi rol gyi/ /dgra sdang ba/ gnyen byams pa/ rang phyogs gzhan phyogs khang pa dang / /ri rdo rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs pa/ /'di kun rang sems 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam la don la med bzhin du yod par sgro btags nas rang gi blos bkod pa tsam/ /ma gtogs phyi rol tu/ don la logs su/ grub pa gcig kyang med/ /snang ni 'di dag kun snang bden ni 'di rnams/ kun mi bden/ /thams cad snang ba 'di/ rmi lam dang 'dra bas bag chags brtan mi brtan ma gtogs rmi lam yin/ sgyu ma 'dra/ bas sgyu ma yin/ /rang gi lte 'og tu/ chos 'byung phyi/ dkar la nang / dmar ba rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug cing gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa rgya khyon che ba zhig gi nang / /dmyal ba nas bzung rigs drug gi sems can rnams/ /rim bzhin 'khod cing rigs drug de rnams/ bde ba dang / sdug bsngal/ sna tshogs la/ /longs spyod pa'i/ ngang du gnas shing rdzi bi 'i tshul du gnas par bsam la/ re/ /a ma sems kyi 'khrul tshab la/ 'di rnams snang ni thams cad snang / /bden de thams cad/ mi bden pas/ rmi lam yin/ gyi snang ba 'dra bas/ sgyu ma dang 'dra ba sgyu ma/ yin/ rgyun du sgyu ma'i dmigs pa 'di tsam gyis chog /'og rlung skabs su 'di yang bsgom ste rang gis bskul tsam byas/ pas nga la gnod par/ byed pa'i gdon/ rnams/ /'og rlung dang bsdongs nas/ chos 'byung gi

nang du/ byung bar bsam/ de yang med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma dang 'dra bas/ sgyu ma yin/ /don la/ bden par grub pa cung zad kyang / med snyam du/ bsgoms pas gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs de dag gi gdug rtsub dang / /sdig sgrib dag nges snyam du bsam/ nas rang gi 'og rlung phyir phul la 'og rlung / gdong phyir thon gyur/ / par bsam la yid kyis/ gtor ma'am chang bu byin pas bu lon thams cad/ khyer/ /lan chags ma lus pa/ byang nas rgya mtsho'i pha mthar song / / bar bsam/ sngar skyes pa/ kun kyang / shi nas med pa yin la/ skye bar/ 'gyur ba/ kun kyang nges par/ 'chi/ / ba'i chos can las ma 'das/ da lta skyes pa rang gzhan kun 'chi bar nges/ ste/ /rang las rgan pa dang / gzhon pa dang / na zla dang / /rgyal khams kyi/ mi rnams skyes tshad/ shi nas mthar gcig kyang / med par 'gro/ nges pa yin pas/ /de phyir tshe 'di'i bya bas mi tshe stong zad la btang nas/ ci byed ang / / a tsa ma snyam du bsam/ don med tshe 'di'i bya bas mi tshe skyel ba/ de las rnam 'di phyi bar do gsum du phan par nges pa'i sems dang 'dres pa'i/ dag chos gcig rang / /nyams su long par bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma rang gi spyi bor/ rdo rje 'chang / 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yas pad+ma g.yon pa des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmi lam zin par mdzod cig bla ma rang la/ thim/ /rang nyid sngar bzhin yi dam 'khor lo/bde mchog gi skur gsal ba'i/ /spyi bo'i gnas nas thig le dkar po sran ma tsam gcig byung dbu ma'i nang brgyud nas/ byung / ba rang gi

/snying gar sleb cing yang ni gsang gnas nas/ /thig le dmar po gcig byung zhing snying gar thig le dkar po dang dmar po gnyis/ 'dzom/ /de gnyis 'gros pa dang / 'dod pa'i/ tshul gyis g.yas skor du/ /khra khyil li li/ 'khor bar bsam/ zhing de la sems gtad de/ 'di nyid rmi lam yin/ snyam du yang bsam/ /slar yang thig le gnyis/ drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad pas thig le snga bas je phrar song nas mthar/ yal/ song bar bsam la 'dzin med du bzhag de ltar/ /'dzin med bzhag pas rmi lam zin par shog dmigs pa ni nyin mo yang chag med du bsgom zhing khyad par tho rangs gnyid sad mtshams bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab cing 'di bsgom la gnyid thum chung re log yang sad na sngar bzhin sgom la gnyid phran bu bkug de ltar yang yang byas pas rmi lam zin to/ /nyin mo'i dus su'ang / gnas dang / grogs thams cad rmi lam la/ yin/ snyam du bsam zhing / /rmi lam la/ gang sbyangs/ sbyang yin par rang lus 'di/ /mkhar gyi rtser phyin la/ g.yang sa chen po/ la chad de gtang / la bar snang du/ /yal song / bar bsam ste 'di ka rmi lam yin/ /snang ba 'di thams cad/ rmi lam kyi snang bar 'dug cing / lus 'di yid lus su/ /'dug pas gang sbyang sbyangs dang gang rgyur gyu rang / yin snyam ri brag dang gyang la sogs pa/ la/ rang gi lus/ /phar thal tshur thal du 'gro ba dang yang / rang nyid mang por sprul/ / pa dang yang snang ba 'di rmi lam du 'dug pas gang spel spel yin snyam bsam la/ rang gnas khang de'am mdun du snang ba'i dngos po gang mthong de/ la sogs dngos kun mang por sprul/ /spel ba 'di ka rmi lam yin snyam du yang yang du/ bsgom/ / pa zab mo'i gnad go ba lags/ gzhan yang byi la dang /

khra dang spyang khyi stag /seng ge srin por sprul nas rim bzhin du/ /byi byi blar/ ba byi'u khrar sprul nas/ khyi spyang kir/ dang spyang khyi stag / dang seng ger sprul/ mi rnams rang srin por sprul/ phyag rdor sogs su sprul na shin tu legs so/ /'dul zhing gzhan yang sprul bsgyur ni/ /klu la rang / bya khyung du sprul pa dang gdon bgegs/ rgyal po 'i rigs la rang nyid/ rta mgrin dang / klu bdud dang / klu srin gyi rigs rnams la rang nyid 'phags pa/ spyan gzigs seng ge sgra/ /srin po dang / gnod sbyin la rang / phyag rdor sprul nas zhing spel nas phyag mtshan gyis lus dum bur gtub cing tshar bcad pas khos srog sngags phul bar bsam/ gdul bya 'dul byed thams cad sems snang rmi lam gyi rol rtsed du 'dug snyam du bsgom/ 'dul/ / sbyangs spel 'di rnams gdan thog tu thun gyi dus dang 'gro 'chag bza' btung sogs gnas skabs kun tu dran pas ci zin byas la bsgom/ rmi gnyid dus rmi lam zin pa na de ma thag las dang po pas tsab tsob mi bya bar a 'di rmi lam du 'dug chos thams cad 'di dang rmi lam gyi snang ba la bden par ma grub pas bde sdug chags sdang byed pa rang 'khrul pa yin snyam pa dang / de'i ngang nas sad 'byams dang 'khrul 'byams du ma shor na/ lam zin nas rang gang la nyams len byed pa'i/ lhar dran pa gsal lam btab la/ zhal phyag rnams/ /shin tu gsal gang thob bya ba gal che/ bar dran pas gsal theb ste/ de ltar rmi lam la rmi lam du shes shing / dus de nyid du bskyed rim gsal 'debs nus na bar dor 'bras bu 'grub par nges te/ nai gu ma'i zhal nas/ rmi lam zin nas lha yi sku/ /rang shar yud tsam byung gyur na/ /bar do zin par the tshom med/ /ces brgyud pa lam rim du gsungs pa la sogs/

/bar do lha skur 'tshang rgya dbang thob shog /mdor na da lta'i snang ba 'di dag dang / /rmi lam snang ba gnyis la khyad par cung zad kyang med/ snang ni 'di dag snang / ba cung zad kyang med/ don dam par ni/ bden ni gnyis ka mi bden par lung rigs man ngag gis grub pas med bzhin du snang ba/ sgyu ma'i rol rtsed do/ /bla mar rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje 'chang du bzhugs/ gsol 'debs bdag la nyid mtshan 'dre ba'i/ 'od gsal 'byongs par mdzod/ /bla ma rang nyid la gnyis med du/ thim rang nyid 'khor lo/ bde mchog gyur/ par bsam la lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa/ /de yi sku'i/ gsang gnas nas bzung dbu'i/ tshangs bug gi bar/ la/ /rtsa/ dbu ma kha dog dmar gsal sbub stong / phru ma phus btab 'dra/ /rtsa nang lte 'og sor bzhir rtsa dbu ma'i nang du/ rang gi sems/ /a yi ge dkar 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig bsam la a'i rang bzhin/ skye med du shes par byas la gsal stong 'dzin med/ ngang / du bzhag /klad rgya dang / thod pa'i bar du bdag med ma/ /dkar mo gri gug dang / thod pa/ 'dzin pa sku chung ngu zhig bsgom/ pa'i thugs kar yi ge āḥ dkar po/ /de las 'od 'phros klad pa thams cad/ mi dmigs par gtsang sing ste sbyangs par/ gyur/ par bsam la de nas/ /thod pa dung gi gzhal yas/ khang 'od kyi rang bzhin kha dog dkar po/ skya mer re'am ltem me bas/ khengs/ par bsam la yang / /rang gi snying khar bla ma rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ /sku mdog thig le'i rang bzhin dngul chu'i shin tu dwangs pa/ mdog lta bu bde ba'i rang bzhin can/ /bla ma de nyid kyi/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ dkar po de las/

'od 'phros pa de nyid/ kyis bla ma 'i sku/ gsal/ sing byas byung bar bsam/ /bla ma'i sku las/ 'od 'phros pa'i rkyen/ kyis rang nyid yi dam gyi skur bsgom pa de nyid/ gsal/ sing byas par bsam la/ de la dmigs pa gtad do/ /nyin de ltar bsgom pas rang gi mos gus kyi gnad zab mo'i rten 'brel gyis/ mtshan 'dres pa'i 'od gsal 'char bar shog rgyun du 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa gsum char thub na rab yin la/ 'bring thog mtha' gnyis/ yang na a la sems bzung ba'i dmigs pa tsam gyis kyang chog par gsungs pa lags so/ /rang nyid lhar bde mchog lhan skyes su/ gsal spyi bor seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad zla'i gdan la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang sngar bzhin/ bzhugs/ par bsam la/ /khyed shes khyed mkhyen snyam du mos gus snying gi dkyil nas dung dung ba bya/ 'pho ba theb par mdzod/ /lus nang dbus su dbu ma drang thal le/ zhes brjod na legs so/ /rang gi snying ga'i dbus kyi thad/ gar rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul nas phul bar bsam/ rang sems a dkar po/ gcig tu bsam/ /yar bla ma la mos gus byas pas/ tshangs bug rgya mthong bzhin kha/ phye ba bar bsam la/ lta bu 'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang / nas/ /spyi gtsug nas/ bla mas rigs kyi bu khyod yar la/ shog gsungs/ byung bar bsam la/ /de yi rkyen gyis rang sems/ a de rtsa dbu ma/ 'i nang / /brgyud nas yar la bya 'phur ba bzhin song ste/ bla ma'i thugs kar thim pa las/ /bla ma'i/ thugs dang rang gi yid gnyis/ gcig tu/ 'dres pa'i gdod ma'i gnas lugs gsal btab ste/ 'dzin med bde cham me/ /'dir/ bla ma je mtho 'og min gnas su bzhud/

/ ces brjod cing bsgom kyang chog go /slar yang rang sems/ a de bla ma'i thugs ka nas/ /thon te spyi gtsug nas/ byung ste tshangs bug nas zhugs dbu ma 'i nang na mar/ brgyud/ /snying khar sleb pa'i/ tshe chu shu'i kha tshang bzhin rang bkag tu song nas/ tshangs pa'i bu ga yang / /sra zhing brtan par 'gags par bsams/ te de nas spyi bo'i/ bla ma thim/ pa'am mi dmigs pa gang bde bya'o/ /nam zhig las la sbyor ba na rang sems bla ma'i thugs kar thim ma thag bla ma mkha' dbyings mthon por yud kyis byon nas 'og min du sleb song ba dang rang sems brjod bral du 'jog pa yin/ de ltar rgyun du dgos par bshad do/ /spyi bor sngar bzhin/ bla ma bzhugs par bsgom la de la/ gsol ba 'debs/ so bdag gi /bar do rgyal ba longs sku ra 'tshang rgya ba'i 'bras bu/ thob par mdzod/ snyam du gsol ba btab/ de nas /bla ma rang thim par bsam la/ a pa nga shi 'dug pa ang / /nga yi lus 'di ni gdos bcas ma yin/ bar do'i yid lus su/ /'dug cing zas dang / gos dang / gnas khang dang / grogs la sogs/ pa 'di/ /thams cad gdos bcas ma yin pa'i/ bar do'i snang ba rang 'ba' zhig du 'dug pa snyam du yang yang bsam la rgyu mtshan/ /de phyir bden par grub pa/ med sgyu ma dang / rmi lam gyi snang ba 'dra ba/ yin/ de phyir rmi lam dang 'dra gang bsgyur yin de bzhin du zhes brjod kyang legs/ /rang gi mdun du chos kyi/ 'byung gnas/ gru gsum gcig bsgoms nas de'i/ nang / du/ /rang sems hūm̐ du bsam la hūm̐ de/ las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phros/ /'das ma 'ongs da ltar te/ dus gsum gyi bsdus pa'i mngal skyes drod gsher skyes sgong skyes te/

skye gnas rnam pa bzhi'i/ /bag chags sems la bzhag pa'i lan chags kyi/ dri ma thams cad/ sbyangs nas 'od zer rnams/ hūm̐ yig la/ thim/ /pa yongs su/ gyur las rang nyid dpal ldan 'khor lo/ bde mchog yab yum gyi skur lam gyis gyur par bsam la zhal phyag rnams gsal btab la/ gyur/ gyi bar du dran pas gsal btab la/ /chags pa dang / sdang ba'i/ yul du/ gyur pa'i/ pho dang / mor snang ba kun/ /pho/ thams cad bde mchog dang mo thams cad/ rdo rje phag mor gyur/ / par bsam zhing / sgra rnams thams cad sngags kyi sgra dbyangs su bsam pa/ dang / /yid la 'gyu ba'i/ dran rtog thams cad gsal stong 'dzin med ngang / /gnad 'dis bar do longs skur 'tshang rgya bar/ shog /de ltar chos drug so so'i zab don zab mo 'di rmi lam du 'bad rtsol la ma ltos par bla ma'i thugs rje dran pa dang zab gnad/ thabs lam rtsol ba'i gnad/ sgyu lus bden med kyi gnad/ rmi lam mdun pa'i gnad/ 'od gsal mos gus kyi gnad/ 'pho ba rtse gcig gi gnad/ bar do skyo shas kyi gnad de dmigs pa tha dad kyi gnad de dang ldan pa'i don de rnams/ nyams su blangs pa la brten nas lam so so'i yon tan thams cad rang nyid kyi/ /rgyud la 'byor nas rang gzhan thams cad kyi 'di dang phyi ma'i don rnams yid bzhin du 'grub par bsam/ don kun gegs med mthar phyin 'bad med/ lhun grub shog de bzhin du 'gyur ba cig chog rgyal po bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen ces pa'i don de rang gzhan thams cad phyogs dus kun tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig 'di sogs nyams len snying po bsdus pa rnams kyi rgyab rten du so so'i yi ge rgyas pa dag yang yang du bltas pas phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ba zhig dpyod ldan rnams kyi dgongs par mdzad 'tshal lo//

༈ //rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma 'phrin las rab rgyas bzhugs/ dkon mchog la skyabs yan lag bdun pa bgyid/ /stong oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta sogs pa'i yab yum sbyor mtshams nas spros/ pa'i ngang las rang nyid khro bor gyur/ khro bos gdug cing / /bgegs sdang sems sogs dang ki la ya dang khro bcu'i sngags brjod/ bskrad srung 'khor mtshon cha me dpung 'bar/ /tshogs rang gi snying kha dang dkon mchog gsum sogs brjod/ zhing spyan drangs sdom bzung gnas khang dang / /sman sarba pañca sogs sngags gsum dang kī la ya brjod/ rag gtor gsum bsnyen phur byin gyis brlabs/ /chos kun gdod nas spros bral de bzhin nyid/ ting nge 'dzin/ /dmigs med snying rje'i kun snang zung 'jug ting 'dzin/ sems/ /hūm̐ du gyur pa rgyu yi ting 'dzin las/ /'byung bzhi ri rab chos 'byung gdan bcas kyi/ /sa bon chad cing so so'i dkyil 'khor e yam̐ wam̐ ram̐ sogs nas gdan gyi sngags kyi bar du brjod/ gyur/ /de nas chos 'byung dbus su pad nyi dang / /zla ba dbang phyug pho mo'i gdan steng du/ /sngar gyi hūm̐ babs don byas gyur 'od zer spro bsdus gnyis/ pa las/ /rang nyid kā li ya brjod/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /dbu gsum phyag drug gshog pa yum dang bcas/ /phyag mtshan rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs pa/ /phung khams skye mched skra dang ba spu rnams/ /rang 'dra'i rdo rje gzhon nus rab gtams shing / /sems dpa' sum brtsegs dang bcas me phung gi /dbus na bzhugs pa shin tu gsal bar gyur/ /rang gi oṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ/ snying ga'i 'od kyis snod bcud rnams/ /kun kyang lha dang gzhal yas khang du gyur/ /yang ni sam̐ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs thim/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sogs dang oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi sogs brjod/

/rang gi gnas gsum yig 'bru'i 'od zer gyis/ /rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs te/ /gnas gsum thim pas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta sogs brjod/ rdo rje gsum du gyur/ /dbang lha spyan drangs khro bo rigs lnga'i/ dbang bskur rgya yis btab/ /chos 'byung e s+pha ra ṇa sogs brjod/ dbus su sras mchog rab gsal ba/ /spyi bo bskyed pa rtse mor oṃ hriḥphaṭ/ /ye shes pa mahā sur+ya sogs lag pa byin rlabs kyi sngags rnams dang / phur pa bzung nas dip+ta tsakra sogs nas tsit+ta a bhi hūm̐ gi bar dkyus bzhin brjod/ thim dbang bskur rgya yis btab/ /ye shes 'khor phur bu sogs brjod mchod pa so so'i sngags rnams brjod cing phul bar bsams/ spyan drangs gdan dang mchod pa phul/ /phyi nang gsang ba yongs dag bsgral mchod dang / /rak+ta gtor ma bstod pa'i mchod pas mchod/ /ye shes sems dpa' yum hūm̐ badz+nyā na sogs brjod/ med mdun du byon/ /de dang rang nyid sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi/ /snying kha'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng byung ba bdag mdun gyi sna bug g.yas g.yon nas 'thon pa'i bzhugs pa'i hūm̐/ dang sngags phreng rgyun chad med par 'khor ba'i/ 'od zer gyis/ /dgra bgegs tshar bcad sems can thams cad dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /byin rlabs rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur byas nas/ /rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra/ sogs dang / dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /sogs kyi smon lam dang / zhes brjod cing bsam la/ kī la ya dang / dip+ta sogs ci mang bzla/ de nas ma raka mo sogs phreng ba mgo thog tu bzhag cing bde bar gshegs pa sogs brjod/ skye med chos sku'i sogs bkra shis dkyus bzhin bya'o// ༈ //rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs tshig bcad ma 'phrin las rab rgyas bzhugs/ mchan mi 'dra ba/

dkon mchog la skyabs yan lag bdun pa bgyid/ /stong pa'i oṃ mahā shu n+ya ta/ ngang las rang nyid khro bor gyur/ /bgegs ki la ya brjod/ bskrad srung 'khor dbus su pad nyi dang / zla ba dbang phyug pho mo'i gdan steng du/ /rang nyid kī la ya brjod/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /dbu gsum phyag drug gshog pa yum dang bcas/ /phyag mtshan rgyan dang cha lugs yongs rdzogs pa/ /phung khams skye mched skra dang ba spu rnams/ /rang 'dra'i rdo rje'i gzhon nus rab gtams shing / /sems dpa' sum brtsegs dang bcas me phung gi /dbus na bzhugs pa shin tu gsal bar gyur/ /rang gi oṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ/ snying ga'i 'od kyis snod bcud rnams/ /kun kyang lha dang gzhal yas khang du gyur/ /yang ni sam̐ ha ra na hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li ki la ya/ 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs thim/ sarba ta tha ga ta sogs dang / oṃ yak+ṣi ṇi sogs brjod/ /rang gi gnas gsum yig 'bru'i 'od zer gyis/ /rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs te/ /gnas gsum thim pas rdo rje gsum du gyur/ /dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur rgya yis btab/ / khro bo rigs lnga'i/ chos 'byung dbus su sras e s+pha ra ṇa sogs brjod/ mchog rab gsal ba/ /spyi bo skyed pa rtse mor oṃ hri phaṭ/ /ye shes pa thim dbang bskur rgya mahā sur+ya sogs lag pa byin rlabs kyi sngags rnams dang / phur pa bzung nas dip+ta tsakra sogs nas tsit+ta a bhi hūm̐ gi bar dkyus bzhin brjod/ /yis btab/ /phyi dang nang gis mchod cing gus pas bstod/ /snying kha'i hūm̐ dang sngags 'phreng 'od zer gyis/ /dgra bgegs tshar bcad sems can thams cad dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi/ /byin rlabs rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur byas nas/ /rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ kī la ya dang dip+ta sogs ci mang bzla/

/sogs kyi smon lam dang / /ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ sogs kyi dngos grub blang / /oṃ shrī badz+ra ku ma ra/ sogs dang / dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /skye med chos sku'i sogs kyi bkra shis dkyus bzhin bya'o// ༈ //ye shes khyung nag sgrub thabs bzhugs/ /dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir khyung nag bsgom/ /oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i klong nyid du/ /yam̐ las rlung dkyil sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ /wam̐ las chu dkyil dkar zlum lbu ba 'khrigs pa/ pa'i phung po dpag tu med pa/ /lbu ba gcig 'dus lbu ba chen po waṃ gyis mtshan par gyur pa de rlung gis dkrugs/ /gyur las rgya mtsho'i steng du sa'i dkyil 'khor/ /gser gyi mig mang ris kyi dra bas sbrel ba can gru bzhi pa/ /de steng rang sems k+ṣiṃ yig sngon po 'od sngon po 'od 'phro bas/ /sems can gyi klu nad zhi ba'i don byas 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi nus mthu bsdus/ /'od zer sngon po rnams k+ṣiṃ yig la thim pa yongs su gyur las rang nyid rdo rje nam mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil/ pa sku mdog sngon po/ /rwa dang mchu sder gnam lcags las grub pa/ /spyan gsum nyi zla ltar 'khyil phyag g.yon pa'i/ /sor mo lnga la thugs kar gdengs pa'i mthe bong sogs la rim pa bzhin oṃ pa k+ṣi swāhā/ /de las klu lnga 'dul ba'i khyung dkar po/ dmar po/ sngon po/ ljang gu/ ser po/ rigs lngas/ phyag gnyis kyi klu /rgyal rigs rje rigs khyab byed rigs ldan dang / /bram ze'i rigs dang gdol ba dmangs rigs klu'i/ /ngo bo sbrul zhags dkar dmar sngo ser ljang / khu'i kha dog can/ /gnyis gnyis kyi sked pa nas 'gyangs 'phyar stabs su/ /'dzin pa'i mgo bo gnyis gnyis bsnol ba zhal du gsol/

/mjug ma bsnol ba gnyis zhabs kyis mnan pa rgyan dang cha lugs rnams gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ /rang gi phyag g.yas chu bdag klu'i rgyal po/ /sngon po thal sbyar sbrul mgo'i gdengs kha bdun dang / /ldan pa nor bu'i rgyan can ro stod lha lus can thal mo sbyar ba'i sked pa nas/ /'phyar stabs 'dzin zhing ro smad sbrul mjug tu/ /gnas pa zhabs gnyis kyis mnan sgro dang spu thung rnams/ /gnam lcags ral gri dang 'dra rin chen gyi/ /rgyan dang rwa dbar yid bzhin nor bu dang / /dbu yi gnas lngar gser gyi 'khor los mdzes/ /bskal pa'i/ me dpung dbus bzhugs sku las sprul pa yi/ /pho nya dang ye shes kyi me tshogs 'phros pas gnod byed thams cad thul thul bsregs/ par bsam/ rang gi /thugs ka k+ṣiṃ sngon 'od kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i shāka thub nyid/ /spyan drangs spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i steng du bzhugs/ /rtsa sngags lan gcig brjod pas brtan par gyur/ /oṃ pak+ṣi rā dzā/ bya'i rgyal po/ na mo ga ru ḍa/ nam mkha' lding / e bha/ sarba nā ga bha ya ka ra sarba bi sa na klu thams cad 'jigs par byed pa hūm̐ phaṭ/ k+ṣiṃ sa oṃ swāhā/ oṃ pa k+ṣi swāhā/ pa k+ṣi oṃ swāhā/ swā pa oṃ hā k+ṣi hā pa oṃ swā k+ṣi de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni bskyed rim de nyid la dmigs pa gtad de/ gong gi rtsa ba'i sngags de mi'i tshig gis bar ma chod par 'bum phrag gsum bzla ba las 'grub pa'i bsnyen tshad do/ /de nas sgrub pa ni rang gi mgo bo mgrin pa snying kha dang / /lte ba gsang gnas rnams su oṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ/ swāhā lnga las yi ge'i kha dog dkar dmar/ sngon po/ ser po/ ljang gu rnams las 'od 'phros snod bcud kyi/ /dgu sman nus mthu 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs bsdus/

/rang gi mgo bo sogs kyi yi ge lnga la/ thim pas sor mo la bkod pa bzhin gnas lngar khyung chen rigs lngar gyur/ / par bsam la gong gi rtsa sngags kyi hūm̐ phaṭ yan 'dra ba la/ oṃ pa k+ṣi swāhā/ mgrin pa la pa oṃ k+ṣi swāhā/ snying kha la/ k+ṣi oṃ pa swāhā/ lte ba la/ swā.oṃ k+ṣi swāhā/ gsang gnas la/ hā.oṃ k+ṣi swāhā/ zhes pa ste hā dang / oṃ dang / pa dang / k+ṣi dang / swā ste yig 'bru lngas 'go drangs pa'i sngags tshan lngas/ rtsa sngags la btags pa rim bzhin khri tsho lnga zhig bzla ba/ bsgrub pa'i sngags kyi bzlas tshad do/ /las sbyor rnams ni yig rnying du blta'o/ /dge 'dis mkha' lding dbang po gser mig 'khyil/ /'byung po 'ur 'ded myur du 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi blo mtsho las so/ /yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub bo/ /bkra shis// ༈ //rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs kyi dzam dmar yab yum gyi man ngag zab mo khyad par can gyi nyams len snying po khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs pa dge dkon mchog la skyabs su mchi'o/ /gzhan phyir nor lha bsgrub/ /rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum mam yi dam gang yang rung ba'i/ skur gsal ba'i/ /mdun du pad ma/ dmar po/ 'dab brgyad zla ba'i steng / /bh+rum̐ las/ gter gyi/ bum pa/ nor bu rin po che kha g.yas g.yon nas/ 'chang gsham gnyis/ bskrad pa de'i steng du/ nyi dkyil gyi/ dbus/ /dzam̐ dang bam̐ las nor bur sa bon gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ nor lha yab yum ni/ /yab ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /phyag g.yas rin po che/ dbang gi rgyal po dang / g.yon pa ne'u le/ rin po ches gang pa/

/rin chen skyug pa bsnams pas yum bde ba rgyas byed ma/ la 'khyud/ /zhabs/ g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pang na nor sbyin yum/ /bde ba rgyas byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /phyag g.yas rin chen 'od 'bar bsnams pa yis/ /sgrub la nor char 'beb cing g.yon pa yis/ /thod pa bdud rtsis gang bsnams yab la nas/ stob pa'i tshul du/ 'khyud/ /g.yon brkyangs g.yas bskums zhabs can yab yum gnyis/ ka /sku mdog dmar po bde ba chen po la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis khro zhing chags pa'i nyams can thabs shes sbyor zhing yum gyis bskul ba'i nyams bskyed pa/ dar dang rin chen sogs rgyan thams cad kyis/ brgyan/ pa/ /yab kyi dbu steng rin chen 'od 'tsher ba/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod/ /ye shes pa thim dbang bskur rdor sems dbu brgyan/ brgyan/ /rang gi sprul pa'i lha mos phyi dang / nang gis/ /mchod cing bstod do rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i/ /thugs kar nyi dkyil dbus su yi dam gyi/ /sa bon nyid dang dbyer med dzam+bha la/ /yab yum thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /yi dam sa bon yab yum sku'i tha mar/ /yi dam sngags 'phreng gis bskor de rnams kyi/ /'od kyis mdun gyi nor sbyin yab yum bskul/ /de yi thugs kar nyi dkyil dzam̐ bam̐ mthar/ /sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /khams gsum snod bcud nus mthu ji snyed dang / /ji ltar 'dod rnams bsdus nas dngos grub stsal/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ /oṃ dzam+bha la dza lan+t+ra ya dha nam̐ mi ti hrīḥḍā ki nī dzam+bha la sam̐ ba ra swāhā/ sngags 'di brgya stong la sogs pa nyin re bzhin ma chag par bzla bar bya'o/ /skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na sku ban nam gang rung byin gyis brlab la sngags a ka ro btags la 'bul/ mchod cing 'dud do nor sbyin yab yum gyis/

/khams gsum che btsun thams cad dbang 'dus mdzod/ /mdun bskyed rang yang dmigs med ngang / /dge 'dis dmigs yul dbang du rab 'dus nas/ /sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rab rgyas shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ skabs 'gar gong gi dmigs pa'i rjes su 'di ltar yang sbyar te/ yang ni mdun gyi nor sbyin yab yum las/ /khro bo khro mo dmar mo lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa thogs pas rang la nyer mkho ba'i/ /mi nor zas gos la sogs gang 'dod pa/ /thams cad myur du khyer nas bdag la stsal/ /zhes brjod cing bsam la sngags bzla ba man chad gong dang 'dra'o/ /dmigs pa phyi ma 'di ni las sbyor yin pas/ dmigs pa snga ma de nyid kyi ngang nas sngags mang du bzlas pas/ gzhung nas bshad pa'i grub pa'i rtags rnams rmi lam du byung ba dang / las sbyar gyi dmigs pa 'di tsam pas tshegs med du 'grub nges pa'o/ /dge zhing bkra shis byon// //shu bham̐ mastu sarba dza ga tam̐// ༈ //nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi sgrub thabs bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ya/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /'brel tshad don ldan bla ma la btud nas/ /chos mthun zas gos nor sogs stsol ba'i lha'i/ /sgrub thabs bsam don kun 'grub bshad par bya/ /de la nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi sgrub thabs la rnam pa mang yang / /'dir chang bu dang rgyun du bzlas pa la brten nas sgrub pa'i tshul 'di lta ste/ dang po chang bu la brten nas bsgrub pa ni/ snod gtsang ma zhig tu chang bu gsum bzhag la chab kyis bran te/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum brjod/ de nas gong du bshams pa'i chang bu 'bru gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ rang nyid thun mtshams lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i/

/mdun du sna tshogs pad gdan gsum gyi steng / /nor gyi lha mo dbyug gu mched gsum po/ /sku mdog mthing dmar ljang ba'i dkar dmar ser/ /yang na gsum ka sngo bsang rab dwangs pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa rin po ches/ /rab mdzes bum pa nor bus gang ba dang / /g.yon pas nor bu 'bar bas sangs rgyas la/ /mchod cing 'gro la dgos 'dod stsol ba 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs dbu skyes can/ /zhal 'dzum sha rgyas nu 'bur zung gis mdzes/ /rab dkar rab 'jam dar gyis smad g.yogs shing / /sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub du ma gsol/ /yid 'ong rin chen rus pas spras pa'i sku/ /rnam gsum mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur/ /ces brjod la bsam/ de nas/ oṃ a na le kun dha kuṇ+ḍa'i zhes pa'ang snang / lam̐ mahā ghīrna gh+rih+ṇa zhes pa'ang 'dug bhin bhan+tu zhes pa'ang snang / dha ye swāhā/ oṃ gh+rīrna gh+rih+ṇa zhes pa'ang snang / bhin dha bhan+tu zhes pa'ang snang mahā pi sha tsi mahā pi sha zhes pa'ang 'dug ye swāhā/ oṃ shu tra mu khe mar+dha shi sha tsi na ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags gsum po 'di lan gsum mam bdun brjod la chang bu phul/ de nas yid kyis sprul pa'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lngas mchod par bsam la/ ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐/ pa d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ dur khrod shing drung nags tshal chen po ru/ /lhag pa'i gnas bcas sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /sgyu ma'i skur ston 'phrin las mdzad pa'i dpal/ /sna tshogs skur ston yid bzhin nor 'dra'i lha/ /dpag bsam shing ltar dgos 'dod re ba skong / /mi zad gter las grub pa'i bum pa 'dzin/ /'dod yon ci 'dod 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin sha za mkha' 'gro khyed gsum gyis/
