/bdag gis dngos bsham yid sprul 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gzhan don du byang chub bsgrub pa yis/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin 'bras bsod nams ni/ /yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa'i don slad du/ /bdag gi zas nor longs spyod rab 'phel zhing / /de nyid log pa'i 'tsho bar ma gyur pa/ /chos bsgrub grogs su 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ de nas lha mo mched gsum bdag la shin tu dgyes pa'i ngang nas mi snang bar gyur par bsam la/ dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa rgyun du bzlas pa la brten nas bsgrub pa ni/ tad+ya thā oṃ tsha me u le ni du kha than swāhā/ tad+ya thā oṃ tsha me ru wain tu kha tham swāhā/ zhes pa'ang snang / zhes pa'i sngags 'di srod kyi cha la bzhi brgya tsam re dus rgyun du ma chag par bzla'o/ /nor lha mched gsum gyi sgrub thabs rnams nyams su blang ba'i phan yon ni/ chos dang mthun pa'i zas gos nor gsum gyis mi 'phongs shing / dge bshes dang mi chen sogs dbang du 'du ba dang / mi thams cad gus par 'gyur zhing / tha na khyi la sogs pas kyang byams par byed pa dang / 'byung po thams cad kyis kyang mthun grogs byed par 'gyur bar bshad cing / chang bu la brten nas bsgrub pa 'di dus rgyun du ma chag par bgyis na 'chi ba bslu ba'i mchog kyang yin par gsungs so/ /zhes pa 'di ni sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sbyangs pa mthar phyin nas rab 'byams smra ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa dge 'dun 'od zer dang / dul ba'i sems ldan rab 'byams pa dge slong tshul khrims bzang po dang / brtan pa'i sems ldan dge tshul byams pa bzang po rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor rab 'byams rgyal ba'i rnam sprul khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen mtshan thos par dka' ba rje btsun mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos chos skor 'di'i yig cha rnying ma rnams la shin tu 'dris par byas nas bla brang phun tshogs gling gi thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal gyi kun gsal bde chen pho brang du bris pa'o/

/sngon nas shes bya'i gnas la legs sbyangs pas/ /tshe 'dir rab gsal blo gros dang ldan phyir/ /gdams pa zab mo yi ger bris 'di la/ /'gal dang 'khrul ba'i nyes pa med snyam sems/ /'on kyang sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas phyir/ /nongs pa mchis na bla ma mkha' 'gror bshags/ /'dir 'bad dge ba chos dang mthun pa'i don/ /thams cad ji bzhin 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ //dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi man ngag tsakra la brten nas dbang bsdus zab mo'i lag len gsal bar bkod pa'i yi ge bsam 'phel nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /nor gyi lha mo dbyug gu mched gsum gyi/ /tsakra la brten dbang bsdus zab mo yi/ /lag len bsam 'phel nor bu 'dir spel lo/ /'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su rin po che la sogs pa'i snod bzang po gsum du gtor ma dkar gtor zlum po gsum chang gis sbrus pa la dkar dmar gyi rgyan ci mdzes kyis brgyan pa kun gyis mi mngon par byas la bshams/ snod gzhan zhig tu mtshams ma grol bar gyi thun gtor gso chas kyi chang bu lag g.yon gyis bzos pa mang du bcug la bzhag gtor ma'i rgyab tu maṇ+ḍal la nas kyi tshom bu lnga'am bcu bkod pa la ro ras sam/ shing shun sogs la bris pa'i dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi bris sku rab gnas can bzhugs so/ /gtor ma'i mdun du mchod pa'i bye brag 'byor tshad bshams te/ rgya dpangs mi chung bar byed pa rten 'brel gyi gnad yin no/ /dbang bsdus kyi tsakra lag len ltar bris pa'am sta gon bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni rang stan bde ba la rten la kha phyogs pas 'dug ste skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun pa lan grangs nyer gcig la sogs pa byas la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs dang /

sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyis sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me 'bar bas yongs su bskor ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su pad+ma nyi ma drag po dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can la phub 'dzin pa/ mgo bo g.yon phyogs su bstan pa 'gyel ba'i steng / rang gi sems yi ge hūm̐ sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu rnams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkhar 'phyar te 'dzin pa/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas rdo rje zhags pa/ phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis rang gi phyag rgya thugs kar bsnol ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / dbu skra dang / smin ma dang / sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / sbrul chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sku che zhing yan lag rags pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu mam̐ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag la sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad rang la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ bhu ta ḍā ma ra bhu ta a ti pa ta ya/ ak+ṣo bh+ya ki ri ṭi na sarba bhu ta pre ta pi sha tsa na ut+pa dā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭ/ ces pa'i sngags ring thung gnyis brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas la/ de nas bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pas 'dod don gsol ba btab la/ gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ de nas maṇ+ḍal gyi steng gi bris sku la dmigs te/ ngag tu/ rang nyid khro bo'i dbang po'i skur gsal ba'i/ /mdun du sna tshogs pad gdan gsum gyi steng / /nor gyi lha mo dbyug gu mched gsum po/ /sku mdog mthing dmar ljang ngam dkar dmar ser/ /yang na gsum ka sngo sangs rab dwangs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa rin po ches/ /rab mdzes bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang / /g.yon pa nor bu 'bar bas sangs rgyas la/ /mchod cing 'gro la dgos 'dod stsol ba 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs dbu skyes can/ /zhal 'dzum sha rgyas nu 'bur zung gis mdzes/

/rab dkar rab 'jam dar gyis stod g.yogs shing / /sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub du ma gsol/ /rab mdzes rin chen rus pas spras pa'i sku/ /rnam gsum mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam la/ de nas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub mtshams kyi dur khrod nas nor gyi lha mo dbyug gu ma mched gsum badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim pas ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam la/ de nas lha mo de gsum gyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing rang gi bka' nyan par bsam la ngag tu/ gsung gi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo'i sngags/ oṃ i li ki li bi li ki ki li swāhā/ zhes dang / sku'i mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu'i sngags/ oṃ a na li kuṇ+ḍa li grih+ṇa paṇ+ḍa pi sha tsi na ye swāhā/ zhes dang / thugs kyi mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo'i sngags/ oṃ na ma shu k+ṣa na bha su mu kham̐ mahā pi sha tsi na ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags gsum po 'di dus rgyun pa'i skabs su ci nus bzlas pas rung la/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su sngags gsum pa 'di lhan cig tu zhag nyer gcig bzla ba'am/ yang na sku gsung thugs kyi sngags so sor byas la/ zhag bdun bdun du bcad de bzla bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i zhag nyer gcig tu bya ba 'di ni bsnyen pa rab kyi dus kyi tshad yin la/ 'bring zhag brgyad/ tha ma zhag gsum gyis kyang chog par bshad cing / de gnyis la yang sngags gsum lhan cig tu bzla ba'am/ so sor bzla ba ni gang bde yin no/ /de lta bu'i bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir thun gsum gyi bya bas nyams su blang bar bya ste/ thun las ldang ba dang / gong du bshams pa'i gtor ma gsum chang gis sbyangs la ngag tu/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ mang du brjod pas byin gyis brlab la/ de nas/ oṃ i ling ki pi ling ki ki ling ki a na le ku dha li ghi na sid+dhi pi sha tsi ni/ oṃ na ma shuk+ṣa na bha su mu kham̐ mahā pi sha tsi na ye/ i dam̐ bha liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul lo/ /de nas bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ ngag tu/ hūm̐/ dur khrod shing drung nags tshal chen po ru/ /lhag pa'i gnas bcas sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /sgyu ma'i skur ston 'phrin las mdzad pa'i lha/ /sna tshogs skur ston yid bzhin nor 'dra'i dpal/ /dpag bsam shing ltar dgos 'dod re ba skong / /mi zad gter las grub pa'i bum pa 'dzin/ /'dod yon ci 'dod stsol la bstod par bgyi/ /gnod sbyin sha za mkha' 'gro khyed gsum gyis/ /bdag gi mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gzhan don du byang chub bsgrub pa yis/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin 'bras bsod nams ni/ /yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa'i don slad du/ /bdag gi zas nor longs spyod rab 'phel zhing / /de nyid log par 'tsho bar mi 'gyur bar/ /chos bsgrub grogs su 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ de nas yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol te/ nor lha mched gsum gyi bris sku la brtan bzhugs byas la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nor lha mched gsum 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro kun dbang du 'du ba dang / /kun kyang chos la spyod par shog /ces sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis rgyas par byas la spyod lam la 'jug go /thun gnyis pa man chad la gong du sta gon byas pa'i chang bu nas gsum gyi gtor ma gsum po kha gsos la chang gis sbyang bar bya'o/ /de ltar nyams len la brtson par byas pas/ bud med tshul bzang zas ster dang / /rtags bzang 'thon nas las la sbyar/ /zhes 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sha za mo rig pa 'dzin pa'i rtog pa las phyung ba nas gsungs pa ltar/

dngos sam nyams sam/ rmi lam du bud med mang pos phyag dang bkur bsti byed pa dang / bud med mdzes mas bdag la zas nor ster ba dang / gter rnyed pa sogs byung na 'grub pa'i rtags yin la/ bud med kyis 'thab pa dang / nor 'phrog pa la sogs rmi na bar chad 'ong ba'i rtags yin pas/ yi dam gyi bzlas sgom sogs dge sbyor la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa rab 'bring tha gsum gang rung sngon du song nas/ de nas dbang bsdus kyi tsakra bsgrub pa'i tshul 'di ltar bya ste/ gong du sta gon byas pa'i tsakra lag len ltar bris pa rang gi mdun du gos dar sogs gzhi dmar po'i steng du bzhag nyi ma gsum du thun gsum gyi bya bas gong du bstan pa ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung rang nyid khro bo'i dbang po dpal phyag na rdo rje bsgom zhing bzlas pa bya ba/ mdun du nor lha mched gsum bskyed de ye shes pa gzhug cing thugs rgyud bskul ba'i bzlas pa/ gtor 'bul/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis yan chad rdzogs par shar bsgom gyi tshul du byas la/ de nas/ oṃ aṃ pa kaṃ pa zhi pa a/ oṃ ma pe la dum pa zhi swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di thun re la brgya stong la sogs bzla zhing / yongs dril nyi ma gsum po de'i bar la khri phrag gcig rdzogs par bzla'o/ /sngags bzla bar la rang gi mdun gyi tsakra la ha yang yang btab/ yi ge rnying ma las tsakra la dmigs yul dgug gzhug gzer gsum bya ba bshad kyang / oṃ am̐ pa sogs sngags bzla bar la bsgrub bya dmigs yul de yid gzugs kyi rnam pas 'khor lo la thim par yang yang bsam zhing / dmigs yul de myur du dbang du 'dus par mdzod cig snyam pa'i nor lha mched gsum la yid kyis 'phrin bcol drag tu bya ba 'di tsam gyi don tshang bar sems so/ /thun las ldang ba dang / dge ba 'di yi bsod nams kyis/ /dmigs yul dbang du rab 'dus nas/ /bde skyed ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/

/bde gshegs bstan pa rgyas par shog /ces sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis rgyas par byas la spyod lam la 'jug go /de ltar 'khor lo sgrub pa mthar phyin nas 'khor lo de legs par dril la dar dmar pos btums te rang gi gos kyi gong pa g.yas pa'i nang du mi mngon par byas la btsems te bcangs so/ /de ltar byas pas bsgrub bya dmigs yul de dbang du 'dus nas sbyin bdag tu 'gyur ba yin te/ yi ge rnying ma las/ des kha mchu zug pa'ang dbang du 'du na gzhan la lta ci smos/ zhes 'byung ngo / /tsakra 'di ni cha mang po dus gcig la bsgrubs nas gos mang po'i gong par re re bcug kyang rung la/ gos rnying pa rim kyis 'dor ba dang tsakra gos gsar pa la spos kyang rung gsungs/ gal te dbang du ma 'dus na/ yang tsakra lag len ltar bris la/ rab gong ltar zhag gsum du thun gsum gyi bya bas sngags khri phrag gcig bzla ba'am/ de tsam ma grub na/ oṃ am̐ pa sogs brgya stong tsam bzlas ste tsakra la ha btab la/ de nas tsakra de la chas dril la rab bsgrub bya dmigs yul de'i them 'og tu sba/ de ma grub na rang gi bsgrub khang gi them 'og tu sbas kyang rung / mchod gnas dbang bsdus yin na sgo'i ya them la sba ba yin/ de ltar byas pas bsgrub bya dmigs yul de dbang du mi 'du mi srid par bshad pas yid gnyis mi byed pa gal che/ de ltar dbang bsdus zab mo'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin nas/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ nor lha 'di'i sgrub thabs la rnam pa mang yang / rgyun du bzlas pa dang chang bu la brten nas bsgrub pa'i tshul kho bos logs su bris pa ltar chag med du nyams su len pa dang / 'di bsgrub pa dang 'grub rtags rnams gzhan la gsang dam par bya zhing / rang gi zas phud nas gzhan la mi ster/ rgyun par yi dwags la chu sbyin dang / zas bza' khar su ru pa ma chag pa bya/ zas nor longs spyod ci byung yang ser sna drag pos bdag gi 'dod rlom mi byed par yar bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa dang /

mar sdug phongs la sbyin pa gtong ba dang / rang chos bsgrub pa'i chos rgyags byed pa sogs log 'tshor ma song ba bya/ rgyal po sogs stobs ldan dbang du 'dus na gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde chen po 'dzugs pa sogs la 'bad par bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi tsakra la brten pa'i dbang bsdus zab mo'i man ngag nyams su blangs pa'i bye brag gi phan yon ni gong du bstan pa ltar yin la/ spyir nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi man ngag zab mo rnams nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon ni/ bdag mthong ba tsam gyis mi thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / dge bshes dang mi chen sogs pho mo gang yang bdag gi dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ba dang / tha na byis pa chung ngu dang / khyi la sogs pas kyang byams par 'gyur ba sogs brjod mi lang ngo / /de ltar shes par byas nas bstan pa dang sems can la phan sems drag pos kun nas bslangs te/ man ngag zab mo 'di lta bu nyams su len pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar gong du bstan pa'i nor lha mched gsum gyi tsakra la brten nas dbang bsdus zab mo'i man ngag nyams su len pa'i sngon du med thabs med pa'i 'gab 'dre gnon tshul gyi lag len ni/ shog bu la gnod sbyin spyang mgo can gyi gzugs mi'i lus la spyang mgo can gan rgyal du 'gyel ba'i lag mgo gnyis pus mo'i thad kar slebs pa'i gre mo gnyis dang sked pa lcags sgrog gis bsdams shing / rkang pa yang lcags sgrog gis bcings pa bris pa'i dpung mgo gnyis su dzaḥhūm̐ dang / nu ma'i bar du dza tri bri/ tri de dang nu ma g.yon pa'i bar du dza yig klog pa bri/ pho bar ma ra ya/ lte bar rbad/ brla gnyis la baṃ hoḥ pus mo gnyis la brang brdungs zhes pa bris/ gzugs de'i mgo bo'i thad nas bzung g.yon bskor du yig phreng gnyis rim gsum rim gang rigs kyi sarba na ṭi ni hūm̐ dza sha ṭi ni hūm̐ dza/

ka ṭi ni hūm̐ dza/ ṇi tri ni hūm̐ dza dzaḥ gnod sbyin mo spyang mgo can staṃ byas nan/ laṃ nan/ hūm̐ nan/ ma ra ya nan/ gnod sbyin mo nor la 'phrang ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi gdug rtsub ma ra ya nan/ staṃ byas nan/ zhes bri/ 'di'i lus la bkod pa'i sngags rnams yi ge gzab chung du 'bri dgos shing / mtha' bskor gyi sngags dang bod skad gnyis yi ge dbu chung du bris pas chog la/ mtha' bskor gyi sngags bod skad gnyis ka tshag med yig mgo nang bstan du bris pa de mdun du bzhag la/ rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas ngag tu/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi༞ khyad par du nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyi deng 'dir nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum bsgrub cing 'grub pa la rjes su 'brangs shing 'khu bzlog pa dang / sgrub pa po'i 'khor g.yog sogs la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rten 'di nyid la thim par gyur/ zhes dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang yang du brjod pas dgug gzhug byas la/ gzugs de'i ske'i mtshams nas mar bcag rkang mgo nas yar bcag de nas sked pa nas bcag pa'i gzugs de'i mgo bo phyogs su shog bu bslab rim gsum dang / rkang pa phyogs su gnyis yong bar byas pa'i mgo bo phyogs kyi shog bu'i mtha' phyi dang / rkang pa phyogs kyi shog bu'i mtha' nang du bcug la bslab pa sked pa nas bcag pa skud pa sngo dmar sne 'brel bas rgya gram du bsdam mo/ /de yang zhi ba gtso bor byed na dmar po nang la byas te 'phred la bsdams/ de'i phyi la sngon pos dkyus la bsdams/ drag por byed na de las go ldog te bsdam mo/ /de nas gzugs de rang gi mal 'og gam/ sku rten gyi 'og tu mnan/

dbang bsdus sogs shin tu myur bar 'dod na mchod rten nag po'i 'og tu mnan pa zhes bya ba/ 'jim pa nag po la tsha tsha btab pa'i khog tu gzugs de bcug la grog po mgo btum du sba bar bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i 'gab 'dre gnon pa'i lag len sgrub pa po su zhig gis byas pa de'i slob rgyud bdun tshud chad kyis 'di'i lag len ma byas kyang nyes skyon med ces gsungs so/ /de ltar 'gab 'dre gnod sbyin 'di gnon dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum po 'di rgya gar lho nub mtshams kyi dur khrod du bzhugs nas 'jig rten nor rdzas kyi bdag mo'i tshul bzung ste/ sgrub pa po la zas nor sogs gang 'dod pa'i re ba yid bzhin du stsol bar mdzad pa la gnod sbyin spyang mgo can 'dis gegs byed pas/ de'i bar gcod zhi bar byed pa'i zab yig 'di yang med thabs med pa'i man ngag yin no/ /gong du dbang bsdus zab mo'i tsakra lag len ltar bri bar bshad pa'i lag len ni 'di yin te/ rgya shog la mtshal gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ rtsibs kyi rtse mtha' dang rtsa bar mu khyud re re yod pa bris la/ rtsibs kyi rtsa ba'i mu khyud kyi nang 'khor lo'i lte bar gang dmigs pa'i ming bris pa'i mjug tu rus brgyud dang bcas pa dbang du sdus shig ces pa bri/ de'i yi ge'i dbu phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang po la oṃ dang / de'i 'og tu am̐ pa kam̐ yi ge de gsum gyi 'og tu pa bris/ g.yon bskor gyi rtsibs gnyis pa la/ zhi pa a zhes pa bris/ rtsibs gsum pa la am̐ dang / de'i 'og tu ma pe la/ zhes pa bris/ rtsibs bzhi pa la duṃ dang / de'i 'og tu pa zhi swāhā/ zhes pa rnams bris/ rtsibs kyi rtsa ba'i mu khyud la lte ba'i yi ge'i dbu phyogs nas dbu bzung ste g.yas bskor du mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dbang du sdus shig ces pa dang / khyad par gang dmigs pa'i ming dang rus rgyud dang bcas pa dbang du sdus shig ces pa bris/

rtsibs kyi rtse mtha'i mu khyud la lte ba'i yi ge'i dbu phyogs nas bzung / g.yas bskor du tsakra sha ni tsakra sha ni/ kro sha ni kro sha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri swāhā/ zhes pa dang / de'i mjug la gang dmigs pa'i ming dang rus rgyud dang bcas pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dbang du sdus shig ces pa bris/ mu khyud gnyis srub ma lus par yi ges khengs par byed/ yi ge thams cad gzab chung du 'bri zhing / bri rdzas mtshal kho nas bya'o/ /de ltar tsakra bris grub pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma byas la/ rten 'brel snying po nas la bsngags te tsakra la gtor zhing / su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod pas rab gnas dang bkra shis rgyas par bya ba ni dam pa gong ma'i phyag len du snang bas ma chad pa gal che ba legs/ de rnams kyis dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos nor gyi lha mo dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi man ngag tsakra la brten nas dbang bsdus zab mo'i lag len zhar byung dang bcas pa bstan zin to// //'dir smras pa/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgyal srid chen po la/ /dbang bsgyur chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i ngo mtshar rnam thar la/ /shes nas dad pas kun tu phyag bgyi 'o/ 1 /tshad ldan gong ma'i gsung rab chu gter las/ /bdag blo dad brtson ldan pa'i ded dpon gyis/ /legs par btus nas tshar du dngar ba 'di/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bsam 'phel nor bu yin/ 2 /dpal ldan sa skya pa yi rjes 'jug ces/ /ming stong tsam gyis chog par 'dzin rnams la/ /'di lta'i ngo mtshar rnam dbye lta zhog gi /zab chos 'di yi ming tsam thos pa med/ 3 /kho bo skyes stobs blo yi mig gsal zhing / /yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan gyis bskyangs pas/ /deng dus sa skya'i rje btsun mchog rnams kyi/ /bzhed gzhung zab rgyas chos kyi bka' babs pa/ 4 /tshul 'di 'dzam gling 'gro ba'i legs byas kun/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i mthu las grub min nam/

/'on kyang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bdag skyes pas/ dper na phyugs dag 'tsho ba'i rdzi bo bzhin/ 5 /blun po brgya phrag 'tshogs pa'i do ra ru/ /shes ldan mkhas pa gcig pur gnas pas na/ /gang la'ang rmongs pa'i nor ldan skye bo dang / /khyad par med pa blun po 'ga' yis 'dzin/ 6 /de ltar na yang blang dor 'byed shes pa'i/ /dpyod ldan mkhas rnams gcig tu dad mod kyang / /dus ngan skye bo'i bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyis/ /chos mthun bsam don 'grub pa dka' ba 'di/ 7 /sngon las zhes bya'i dregs ldan de yin lo/ /'on kyang dam pa'i bka' drin snying la zhugs/ /skal ldan tshogs na legs bshad spel bas chog /gcig pur 'dug na sems la bltas pas chog /ji ltar byas kyang bde ba bla ma'i drin/ /drin lan 'khor mtha' med pa'i mus pa rje/ /da dung byang chub bar du thugs rjes skyobs/ /zhes pa dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos nor gyi lha mo dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi man ngag tsakra la brten nas dbang bsdus zab mo'i lag len gsal bar bkod pa'i yi ge bsam 'phel nor bu zhes bya ba 'di ni nged rang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa/ de rnams yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde lag tu 'grub pa'i man ngag rgya mtsho lta bu la dbang 'byor ba yin mod kyang / ding sang gi rjes 'jug rnams don gnyer zhan pas lag len gyi 'phrang la bsgugs shing / gzhan phyogs kyi grub mtha'i srol 'dzin don gnyer can 'gas ngom zas byed pa mthong nas/ sa skya pa la zhen pho rus dang ldan pa'i rjes 'jug rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs shing / lhag par man ngag 'di la don gnyer gyi blo mchog dang ldan pa shākya'i dge slong rat+na'i mtha' can gyis yun ring po nas yang yang bskul ba la brten nas snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rgya gar lugs la sid+dha zhes pa don 'grub dang /

rgya nag lugs la sa mo lug gi lo'i phalgu ni kaḥ zhes pa dbo zla ba'i rdzogs pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang gi yang rtser sbyar ba 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /yang smras pa/ bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis/ /zab don ma sbas gsol bar bshad 'di la/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzad nas kyang / /khams gsum dbang du 'du ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //bcom ldan 'das so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma'i sgom bzlas bya bar 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig tsam brjod pa'i mthar/ thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma'i sgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum sems bskyed pas sems bskyed do/ /rang skad cig gis so sor 'brang mar gsal ba'i thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pa phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ oṃ mahā pra ti sa re sa pa ri wa ra oṃ badz+ra ar+gham̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ zhes sogs nas shap+ta swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs brjod/ rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pram̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcos ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog ser mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal gser btso ma'i mdog can/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ rgyab zhal sngo ba/ zhal re re bzhin zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na ral gri 'khor lo/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na rdo rje/ zhags pa/ dgra satwa/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza'i stod g.yog dang smad g.yogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po can 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ de nyid la/ oṃ mahā pra ti sa re sa pa ri wa ra ar+gham̐/ sogs kyis gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/

de la/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐ sogs kyis mchod/ dbang gi lha de la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ thugs khar sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim par bsam la/ sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ni mahā pra ti sa re swāhā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa'am ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /so sor 'brang ma 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing spyod lam la 'jug go /zhes pa 'di yang stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i pho brang chen po bsam 'grub rtse'i shar steng du/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos myur bar sbyar ba'i skul ba po ni/ sa skyong dkon mchog nam mkha' mdzod kyi dbang mo dang / bsod nams dpal 'dzoms bu khrid kyis bgyis so/ /'di bskul ba po'i bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //'jam dpal nā ga rak+ṣa'i sgrub thabs ma rig mun sel bzhugs/

na mo mañju shrī tsa saṅgu ru ye/ 'dir 'jam dpal na ga rak+ṣa'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun pa nyer gcig la sogs pa byas la/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'jam dpal nā ga rak+ṣa'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pas sems bskyed/ de nas swa bha was stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las phe rak+ṣa bh+rum̐ las zhes brjod pas/ rang gi rig pa phe nag po gcig tu gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rgya mtsho chen po shar nas zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ lho nas nga rgyal gyi ri gzengs pa/ nub nas 'dod chags kyi chu khol ba/ byang nas phrag dog gi rlung 'tshub pa/ 'og nas gti mug gi mun pa 'thib pa/ steng nas ye shes kyi nyi zla shar ba/ snang srid 'khor 'das lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang rgya mtsho kun tu dwangs pa/ me tog sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ klu chen brgyad kyis ka ba byas pa/ gnam sa steng 'og thams cad sbrul gyi ka gdung gi thog phub pa/ klu gnyan thams cad zas su bza' zhing sgrol ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i pho brang chen po'i dbus su klu rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ dmangs rigs/ bram ze'i rigs/ gdol pa'i rigs la sogs pa klu 'bum sde sa bdag stong sde/ gnyan 'bum sde rnams gcal du bkram zhing / gdan du bting nas zas su bza' ba'i steng du rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rigs pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+ṣa nag po ti pa tsa ya zhes bya ba klu bdud mgo dgu pa/ sku stod srin po'i gzugs can/ sku rgyab ri rab la bstan pa/ sku smad sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i gting du 'khyil ba/ rtsa zhal srin po'i zhal can rab tu gdangs pa/ sbrul mgo 'bar ba dgu bar snang la 'phyo ba/ sbrul mgo dbus ma la rin po che'i prog zhu gsol ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad kyis gri gug dang / g.yon brgyad na sbrul zhags thogs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs khar bsnol zhing /

'og ma rnams kyis phyag mtshan rnams bsgrengs te 'dzin pa/ sku mdog rdo mdung rtse'am/ dug ha la'i mdog lta bu 'tsher zhing 'od 'phro ba/ zhal rnams nas i sha i sha zhes sgrog pa/ klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad 'dar zhing dngangs par byed pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i sbrul mgo dbus ma'i steng du/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog nam mkha'i mdangs ltar dwangs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: gnyis su med par thim/ spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la gus 'dud dang bcas pas/ bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las/ yi ge de 'dra ba gsum chad de rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas nad gdon ma lus pa dbang po'i sgo rnams nas thon par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la rang 'jam dpal nā ga rak+ṣa sku che zhing rags pa shin tu 'jigs pa'i ngang tshul snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de/ ngag tu/ oṃ phe lam̐ hūm̐/ zhes sngags yig 'bru bzhi pa ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ nag po ti pa tsa ya na ga rak+ṣa oṃ phe lam̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa'i yi ge bcu pa yang nyer gcig tsam bzlas la/ ar+gham̐ sogs kyis mchod/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ sngags kyi nus pa brtan pa'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nā ga rak+ṣa 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs kyi bsngo ba dang bkra shis byas la/ thun mtshams thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i gong gi sngags gnyis bzlas pa la brtson par byas na/

yi ge rnying ma nas 'byung ba ltar gyi nad gdon thon pa'i rtags rnams nyams dang rmi lam du 'byung ngo / /bsnyen pa'i tshad ni gong gi yi ge bzhi pa la 'bum phrag bzhi bzla'o/ /zhes pa 'jam dpal na ga rak+ṣa'i sgrub thabs 'di yang / rang gi rig ma u rgyan bsod nams rgyal mo'i kha don du/ sa skya pa chos med sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sa skyar skyes pa'i bsam 'grub lhas sbyin no/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan bde rgya chen po 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bya tshul ma rig mun sel bzhugs/ na mo mañju shrī tsa saṅgu ru ye/ 'dir 'jam dpal na ga rak+sha'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun pa nyer gcig la sogs pa byas la/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pas sems bskyed/ de nas swa bha was stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las phe rak+sha bh+rum̐ las zhes brjod pas/ rang gi rig pa phe nag po gcig tu gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rgya mtsho chen po shar nas zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ lho nas nga rgyal gyi ri gzengs pa/ nub nas 'dod chags kyi chu khol ba/ byang nas phrag dog gi rlung 'tshub pa/ 'og nas gti mug gi mun pa 'thib pa/ steng nas ye shes kyi nyi zla shar ba/ snang srid 'khor 'das lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang rgya mtsho chen po kun tu dwangs pa/ me tog sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ klu chen brgyad kyis ka ba byas pa/ gnam sa steng 'og thams cad sbrul gyi ka gdung gi thog phub pa/ klu gnyan thams cad zas su bza' zhing sgrol ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i pho brang chen po'i dbus su klu rgyal rigs/

rje rigs/ dmangs rigs/ bram ze'i rigs/ gdol pa'i rigs la sogs pa klu 'bum sde/ sa bdag stong sde/ gnyan 'bum sde rnams gcal du bkram zhing / gdan du bting nas zas su bza' ba'i steng du rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+sha nag po ti pa tsa ya zhes bya ba/ klu bdud mgo dgu pa/ sku stod srin po'i gzugs can/ sku rgyab ri rab la bstan pa/ sku smad sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i gting du 'khyil ba/ rtsa zhal srin po'i zhal can rab tu gdangs pa/ sbrul mgo 'bar ba dgu bar snang la 'phyo ba/ sbrul mgo dbus ma la rin po che'i prog zhu gsol ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad kyis gri gug dang / g.yon brgyad na sbrul zhags thogs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs khar bsnol zhing / 'og ma rnams kyis phyag mtshan rnams bsgrengs te 'dzin pa/ sku mdog rdo mdung rtse'am/ dug ha la'i mdog lta bu 'tsher zhing 'od 'phro ba/ zhal rnams nas i sha i sha zhes sgrog pa/ klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad 'dar zhing dngangs par byed pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i sbrul mgo dbus ma'i steng du/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog nam mkha'i mdangs ltar dwangs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la gus 'dud dang bcas pas/ bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las/ yi ge de 'dra ba gsum chad de rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas/

sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas nad gdon ma lus pa dbang po'i sgo rnams nas thon par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ rang 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha sku che zhing rags pa shin tu 'jigs pa'i ngang tshul snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de ngag tu/ oṃ phe lam̐ hūm̐/ zhes sngags yig 'bru bzhi pa ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ nag po ti pa tsa ya nā ga rak+sha oṃ phe lam̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa'i yi ge bcu pa yang nyer gcig tsam bzlas la/ ar+gham̐ sogs kyis mchod/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ sngags kyi nus pa brtan pa'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod de/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nā ga rak+sha 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs kyi bsngo ba dang bkra shis byas la/ thun 'tshams thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gong gi sngags gnyis bzlas pa la brtson par byas na yi ge rnying ma nas 'byung ba ltar gyi nad gdon thon pa'i rtags rnams nyams dang rmi lam du 'byung ngo / /bsnyen pa'i tshad ni gong gi yi ge bzhi pa la 'bum phrag bzhi bzla'o// ༈ //'di'i rjes gnang byed na/ btegs mdzes pa la dkar gtor zlum po che ba rgyan can la dar sngon po btsugs pa dang / 'bul gtor chung ba/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang bcas pa bsham/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro nas dge ba bsngo ba'i bar gong du bshad pa ltar gyi bdag bskyed bsgom la/ de nas mdun gyi gtor ma la dmigs te/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phe rak+sha bh+rum̐ zhes pa nas/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin nyams su blangs la mdun bskyed bsgrub la/ de la ar+gham̐ sogs kyis mchod pa dang / bstod pa ci shes pas bstod nas/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ 'jam dpal dang chos skyong sogs la phul bar bsam zhing / a ka ru'i sngags lan bdun gyis phul la/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ de nas gzhi bdag dang gnod byed la/

lo ka pa la sa pa ri wa ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas bkug la/ sngags de nyid la a ka ru btags pa gsum mam lngas gtor ma byin nas/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams/ /sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ badz+ra muḥs rang gnas su btang la/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba'i phyir sngags ring thung gnyis po ci nus su bzla zhing / de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas la gral la 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon chos rgyal chen po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i dus su/ 'brug gi lo dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nyi ma ri rtse la shar ba'i dus tsam na/ khye'u chung gzugs mdzes pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sbrul gyi zhags pa sked pa la dkris pa/ phyag na thod pa sngo sangs gser gyis bkang pa'i steng na gsor gyi pa tra bzhag pa/ 'od zer sna tshogs su 'phro ba gcig rgyal po'i drung du byung nas gser phul te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kyai chos rgyal chen po lags/ bdag ni mal gro'i klu'i ded dpon te/ nag po klong rdol zhes bya ba'i gnas nas 'ongs/ bsam yas lha'i gser rnams bdag gis 'bul/ zhes zhu ba la/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dpang du bzhag ste/ klu gser 'bul ba dang / rgyal pos klu'i pho brang bzhengs par zhal gyis bzhes te grogs mched du gyur to/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la/ khye'u chung 'di la 'di bas gzhan pa'i sbrul mgo dang bcas pa zhig yong thang snyam nas/ khye'u khyod kyi gzugs mthar thug pa de nged la ston cig gsungs pas/ de na re/ nangs par khyed rang la dug gis phog nyan yod pas lcags 'bag la gla rtsi'i chu byugs pa gdong la gyon la yak+sha steng 'og tu bzhugs la nyi ma ri rtse la shar dus dbu rtse la ltos shig zer ba la/ rgyal pos de ltar mdzad pas/

dbu rtse chen mo la sbrul chen po 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba gcig gi lan gsum du dkris te/ sbom phra ni 'dom bzhis 'khyud pa zhig la/ ring thung dbu rtse la lan gsum dkris nas mjug ma thang nas ma rdzogs pa/ dug gi kha rlangs na bun tsam dbu rtse'i mtha' thams cad khyab pa zhig gzigs pas/ der rgyal po nyid dngangs shing skrag nas klu'i dug gis phog par gyur te/ zla ba gcig la rgyal po la mdze rigs bco brgyad kyis btab par gyur nas/ klu'i dug de rtsa mig rnams su khrag dang 'dres te/ rgyal po'i sku lus kyi gnas rnams su srog chags 'dra ba'i sha 'khrig pa dang / tsha tshag tsag pa dang / na dkar dkar ba dang / grang lhang pa dang / tsha ber ba dang / sbrid chil ba sogs mi bzod pa'i nad kyis btab nas/ rang gi gdan la yang mi chags shing nyam thag par gyur te/ sngar rgyal po byas pa la/ da 'bangs kyang mi lo ba 'dug snyam thugs mug pa na/ de dus bsam yas 'phying phu'i yang dben na slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhugs pa gdan drangs nas sngar gyi rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ nga 'dug nas rgyal po nad kyis nyen par ga la mchi/ thugs mi bde mi 'tshal lo gsungs nas/ kyai rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste/ sngon 'das pa'i dus rgya gar gyi yul bha la tri ta zhes bya ba na/ rgyal po rat+na 'bar ba gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba la/ bu mtha' yas 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal bu de lo bcu gcig lon pa'i dus su/ sa bdag dmangs rigs kyi nad kyis zin par gyur te/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon gnyis sbrid cing sha ros thebs/ stan las 'gul mi nus par gyur te/ de'i dus su rgyal po de la bla mchod dge slong tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gcig bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i zhal nas dge slong bdag gi bu sdug nad kyis zin pa 'di las sos par mdzad du gsol gsungs so/ /de nas dge slong des lha la gsol ba btab pas/

rmi lam du yi dam lha'i zhal nas ri bo chen po mgrin bzang zhes bya ba'i rtse la sangs rgyas 'od srung gi rab gnas mdzad pa'i mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang na/ klu rgyud 'bum gyi ti ka zhes bya bzhugs/ de'i nang na gdug pa klus zin ma zin brtag thabs dang bsrung ba gso thabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /des rgyal po snyung nad las sos par byed do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bla mchod dge slong des man ngag ji lta ba bzhin gdan drangs nas/ rgyal po'i bu snyung nad las dwangs par byas so/ /de yang ngas 'di ltar bshad par bya'o/ /de'i dus kyi rgyal po gtsug gi nor bu'i rgyal bu de ni rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan khyed nyid yin no/ /rgyal bu snyung nad kyis thebs pa de ni mu tig btsan po 'di nyid yin no/ /bla mchod dge slong de ni nga nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs te 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i gdams pa 'di rnams rgyal po la bstan pas rgyal po klu nad las grol lo/ /de lta bu'i zab chos/ de nyid dus phyis gter ston rin po che zhig po gling pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis dar rgyas su mdzad pa/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bgyid 'os rnams grub zin nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la bla ma dang 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha tha dad med pa la rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ tshogs zhing gsal btab la/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ de nas slob dpon dang mdun gyi gtor ma dar gyis brgyan pa 'di gnyis ka tha mal gyi snang ba 'di lta bu ma yin pa/ ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i rgya mtsho chen po shar nas zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ zhes pa nas/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po'i bar gong bzhin brjod pas gsal btab la/ khyed rang rnams kyang slob dpon gyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum dang bcas pa gsal lam te byung ba'i mos pa mdzad nas/

me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sku'i byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma 'jam dpal nā ga rak+shar gsal ba'i dbu'i steng gi bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i yon tan bsdus/ slob ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag lus 'jam dpal sku rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni bum pa'i dbang yin la/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i gsung gi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma 'jam dpal nā ga rak+shar gsal ba'i dbu'i steng gi bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi yon tan bsdus/ slob ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag ngag 'jam dpal gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni gsang ba'i dbang yin la/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ bla ma rin po che bdag la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma 'jam dpal nā ga rak+shar gsal ba'i dbu'i steng gi bla ma'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi yon tan bsdus/ slob ma'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ sems kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag sems 'jam dpal thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang yin la/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/

bla ma rin po che bdag la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi gtor ma 'jam dpal nā ga rak+shar gsal ba'i dbu'i steng gi bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge rnams las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros/ slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad du thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum 'jam dpal gyi sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni dbang bzhi pa yin la/ de nas khyed rang rnams gong du 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i skur gyur pa de nyid gsal 'debs dgos pas/ slob dpon gyis phe rak+sha bh+rum̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid phe nag po gcig tu gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rgya mtsho chen po shar nas zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba zhes pa nas/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po dang bcas pa re gsal lam te gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ de nas slob dpon gyis me tog 'thor bzhin pa dang bcas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ de ni sku'i rjes gnang yin zhing / slar yang khyed rang rnams slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ bla ma 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha dang dbyer med pa'i thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ rnam pa dbyangs gsal la sogs pa yig 'bru'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar thim pas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mos pa byas nas/ de nyid 'jam dpal gyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rang ngo shes par byas la de'i ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/

de ni thugs kyi rjes gnang yin la/ slar yang khyed rang rnams slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ bla ma 'jam dpal nā ga rak+shar gsal ba'i thugs kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung / zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying kha nas zhugs/ g.yas skor du 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di gnyis kyi rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad par zhu/ zhes dang / gsang sngags yi ge bzhi pa dang / bcu pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum re byed du bcug la/ de ltar bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa ni gsung gi rjes gnang yin no/ /zhes ngo sprad la/ de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi dang 'dra/ de rnams kyis 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i rjes gnang gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la mchod bstod byas la/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang / nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs shing / dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya'o/ /de ltar 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i rjes gnang bya tshul 'di yang / dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal pa mus pa chen po sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi bran du gyur pa/ chos med kyi rnal 'byor sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can gyi drung du ji ltar thob pa bzhin/ bya lo zla ba bcu pa'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sa skyar skyes pa'i bsam 'grub lhas sbyin no/ /'dis kyang bdag gzhan thams cad lnga phung bro nad dang bral te/ 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o//
